[note]The second module of the Godforge, Helioflux Melting Core allows processing EBF recipes by directly outputting molten metal when possible. This may not always be as efficient as other methods, but the time and scaling saved from Vacuum Freezer steps often more than makes up for this.[/note]

[note]Usage of this module requires the FDIM upgrade.[/note]

[warn]Helioflux Melting Core <3[/warn]
The Gold barrel has 81 slots.
No Description

Wanna see how your LSC is doing but don't want to run to it or your information panel every time? Get yourself a pair of §6§oPower Goggles§r to see your energy storage straight from the HUD!

By §adefault§r the goggles are §cunlinked§r and will monitor the amount of energy in your wireless network.

To link the goggles to an LSC, §cRight+Click§r the controller with the goggles in your hand. §cShift+Right Click§r air to unlink.

If you wish to move or modify the display you can do so by opening the power goggles config menu!

[warn]Make sure to check your keybinds! There's also a keybind for toggling the power chart!

Or, if you don't wanna deal with that, you can use the /powergoggles command[/warn]

UEV energy hatches? Great! Time for stargate trophy number two.
Once again, to get your trophy you have to submit two stargates' worth of materials.

§3Trophy number two brings us to chapter two of our journey through GTNHs past, the early UEV era.

The year 2022 has just begun and the UEV tier, albeit still quite empty, has become more useful than before. UEV-UMV energy hatches now have proper recipes (although with UEV parts) and optical SMDs are a thing now, hooray.
There finally are better powergen options than regular plasma turbine spam, namely naq fuel and compact fusions + XL plasma turbine spam. Technically dyson too, but that is horribly bugged and its 'legit' power output reasonably can't exceed around 6 billion EU/t (around the same as a compact MK4 running helium plasma).
Some useful newly introduced multis are the PrAss, MCR & Mega Oil Cracker and overclocks past MAX voltage are possible on megas now.
Stargate has once again become a distant goal, as it now requires exorbitant amounts of infinity catalyst and bio circuits, requiring the player to utilize the new tech to its fullest.

Two players, §aPhineasor§3 & §aGDCloud§3 were determined to be first to completing this goal, and after months of a close friendly race, the winner had been decided. §a
GDCloud§3 won the race and conquered this round of nerfs on the §a27th of May, 2022§3.

P.S.: Once again, if you want to be faithful to the challenge, try completing it without these additions:
-PCB Factory, Space Elevator, Component Assemblyline, AAL, EEC, EIG, MABS
-Any bee related GT machines
-Any UEV or above multis (except weak dyson and naq refineries)
-LEG
-Sub 1-tick OC, Batch Mode, inbuilt Void Protection on multis
-Level Maintainer, AE Fluid Crafting, Stocking Buses/Hatches, Crafting Input Buses, ME Output Hatches

P.P.S.: Again the chaotic capacitor banks have been left out for the same reason as stated in the UV gate quest. Oh and the stargate parts used to be UXV recipes, but since UMV hatches are not craftable in UEV anymore, they have been downtiered to UIV to make them craftable in UEV.

display:10.Name:8: Obtain this item to get your trophy

betterquesting:10.desc:8:
There are more kinds of ItemSink modules in NEI. Feel free to look through them to find the ItemSink module that suits your needs.

How they sort items and assign inventory spaces are mostly explained by their item names.

Comparators are wonderfully useful devices, but their need to be directly next to whatever they are comparing is quite limiting. If you could do so remotely that would free you from one major constraint.

Remote Comparators allow you to do just that. Sneak-right-click with a crystalline eye to bind the block you want to watch, and place the eye in a remote comparator to start monitoring the block remotely.

Given the extra distance, though the range of the remote comparator is quite limited, you should expect the §otiniest§r amount of signal lag compared to a direct comparator. You're doubtful that is ever going to be a limiting factor, though.

The §eExotic§r§r Spacetime Compression Field Generator allows for up to §lT6§r recipes which produce §l18432L§r of Black Dwarf Matter per successful batch.

The §eExotic§r Time Dilation Field Generator grants a §296.875%§r time reduction for any recipe ran in the EoH, but reduces the likelihood of success by §c46.25%§r.

The §eExotic§r Stabilisation Field Generator will boost the success chance of the EoH by §225%§r, but will decrease the yield by §c25%§r and increase the power cost by §c15%§r.
This new Space Elevator module can be used to make lapotron orbs more easily, and to make the raw components for optical circuits.

Being able to pump steam with twice the throughput is great, but what if you also want to regulate it with that same 32x range? Well, look no further than the Steam Regulator.

This allows you to set the regulator's precise transfer rate in L/t.

[note]Like the valves, Steam Regulators also have MV, HV, EV, and IV versions.[/note]

You might find yourself setting up complicated systems involving many storage buses with differing priorities. To make it less tedious, grab a priority card!

This tool allows you to set many buses to the same priority with a single click... but better yet, it also features §nincrement and decrement modes!§r Every time you click on a bus, the priority will be set to one higher/lower than the previous bus you clicked, so setting up large arrays of descending priorities is a breeze.

The §9Stable§r Spacetime Compression Field Generator allows for up to §lT3§r recipes which produce §l18432L§r of White Dwarf Matter per successful batch.

The §9Stable§r Time Dilation Field Generator grants a §275%§r time reduction for any recipe ran in the EoH, but reduces the likelihood of success by §c18.5%§r.

The §9Stable§r Stabilisation Field Generator will boost the success chance of the EoH by §210%§r, but will decrease the yield by §c10%§r and increase the power cost by §c30%§r.

Each crop has a set of preferred biome tags. These can be viewed in NEI along with the other growth requirements.

Having the proper biome tags will provide a significant Nutrient Point boost to your crops (§l+14 Points§r per tag).

You can only benefit from up to 2 biome tags (§l+28 Points§r).

It is possible to emulate a single preferred biome tag by planting your crops in a high-humidity location. The bonus scales linearly with humidity between 50% and 80%. Values below 50% provide no bonus, while values above 80% will hit the cap at an equivalent of 1 preferred biome tag (§l+14 Points).

§l§rIf any favored biome tag is present in the current biome, the high humidity bonus will be ignored.


§4§n§n§r§4The Nature's Compass will allow you to view the tags of each biome as subtext within its menu. Sorting biomes by tags is the simplest method.

To play with Binnie's Genetics with bees, you'll need some Larvae, and a Hatchery block inside an Alveary is the only way to make them. There's a little side perk for having them: they produce at a much faster rate than you'd get from any one species' drones. Those leftovers can feed into the Gene Pool for extra raw DNA. Just remember to keep a few Larvae on standby for the actual genetic modification!

The bee you use in the Alveary should be whatever you intend to modify. It can be any kind if you intend to overwrite all the traits, but you probably should have it either be:

1. Some new species which will have everything else overwritten.
2. Some existing superbee that you want to switch to a new species.

The Larvae will eventually be hatched in an Incubator into a modified drone based on whatever genetic traits you have inserted into it.

TL;DR: The casing amount in this quest is for the best Solar Tower, which generates around 2 LuV amps and is a major Stainless Steel, Titanium and HV circuit sink, amongst other things.

Have you ever laid eyes upon a solar panel? You might have built a few of them here. What do they all have in common, I ask you... they generate either Steam or EU directly from sunlight, and that is not efficient. There's something that everybody forgot!

Singleblock solar panels are best to insert anywhere that has sun, and provide constant power to a machine. However, EU storage and transport are easy here, so why not build something better? Instead of generating energy directly, send those warm beams of sunlight into a central structure with circles of Solar Reflectors, and bask in the eternal power of the biggest fusion reactor in the Solar System!

(If you end up making a bigger one, don't come arguing to me about this. Be quiet.)

The whole idea is that the energy of the Sun's rays is directed towards a fluid that can retain the energy, a Solar Salt that does it far better than water. The Solar Tower transfers heat to all the fluid inside it, but watch out! If there's too much cold Solar Salt inside, it will drain away all the heat and slow down the entire process.

In more detail, the Solar Tower has a heat value that ranges from 0 to 100000, and it only heats up Solar Salt at 30000 or above. The amount of heat gained per cycle depends on the number of Reflectors, but also the current heat value: this process is optimal at exactly half the maximum, so 50000 heat. To get a perfect tower setup, you have to slowly feed cold Solar Salt to maintain this heat value, taking away just enough heat to keep it there. I'll let you figure out what the flow rate is, given that it depends on how many Reflectors you have.

From there, generate Steam or SH Steam by heat-exchanging in the same way as Hot Coolant does it. If you want this setup to truly be optimal, do place it in your personal dimension for permanent daylight.
betterquesting:10.name:8: §9§lI'll teach you... how to Praise the Sun!

betterquesting:10.desc:8:
Unrouted Transport Pipes by themselves aren't useful.

Time to use some of them to craft some Basic Logistics Pipes.

The Basic Logistics Pipes can connect to adjacent inventories and blocks. They also have item routing capabilities, so you can use them to form junctions.

But they also cost some diamonds...

There are currently only a few augments available in Tier 3, but they are very powerful.

-Energy Grid Defense (§6Protection§r, Chestplate): Gain a forcefield that can completely block most damage at the cost of a huge amount of EU.
-Gravitational Control Module (§aMovement§r, Chestplate): Creative flight.

At this scale, moving condensate is no longer a matter of pressure or pipe capacity. Every connected conduit becomes part of the same quantum network, allowing its contents to be observed and extracted from anywhere. What you need is a way to impose direction upon something that does not particularly care which way it travels.

Like the theoretical demon whose name it bears, the §5§lMaxwell Gate§r separates one state from another. Networks connected to its output may observe and pull condensate from the input, while the input remains blind to everything beyond the gate. A filter in the controller can further restrict this passage to a single type of condensate.

There is one exception: the Entanglement Apparatus sees the gate backwards. It may only push condensate from the output network toward the input network.

[note]The Maxwell Gate is optional. It does not move condensate by itself; it only controls which side may access it.[/note]

[note]The Gate consumes a constant 1A of UIV power whenever active, even when no condensate is passing through it.[/note]

As you've noticed, UXV components are extremely expensive compared to the amount of Universium you can currently produce.

The Astral Array Fabricator allows you to run EOH recipes in parallel. You can review the math in the second page of the tooltip.

For a direct answer, you can use this spreadsheet: [url]https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1FTFdfmY_UWbTbFOyNzARKeI90pbHvPBH6M3JHJmaC-E/edit?usp=sharing[/url]

[warn]Be aware that the EOH will use Raw Stellar Plasma instead of Hydrogen and Helium if you use Astral Arrays.[/warn]

[note]Make sure you are generating enough power.[/note]

In your research on §b§lProject Godforge§r, you determine that you need a new type of fuel to create a neutron star. Naquadah Fuel possesses some of the properties needed, but isn't enough. Stabilizing this fuel with Exotic Catalyst, and drastically increasing the density of the fuel with other things leads you to something that may just work.

During this synthesis, you realize that this fuel could be used to make [note]Dark Matter[/note], something you previously had only seen on the Mehen Belt in the Amun-Ra System.

[note]Dark Matter Shards can be found in the Mehen Belt and mined manually, if you don't want to synthesize it.[/note]

The §5§lPrimordial Armor§r is the final evolution of the Fortress armor line, built by upgrading a full set of Shadow Fortress armor with primal power. This is a very powerful set, allowing for great defense and a plethora of useful mobility options for getting around.

By shift right-clicking any piece in your hand you can switch its primal alignment which grants unique abilities, some of which are powerful enough to require multiple pieces of armor to be aligned to one aspect: 

§6§lAer§r
1 Alignment: Projectiles shot at you are reflected back at the shooter. In practice, this has an inconsistent minimum range of several blocks.
2 Alignments: Gain creative flight.

§2§lTerra§r
Boots: Gain knockback resistance.
1 Alignment: Gain Regeneration (2 + number of Terra-aligned pieces) whenever you take damage, except damage from the Sacrificial Knife.

§c§lIgnis§r
Helmet: Gain Night Vision when it is night or when the brightness level is less than 4, which also works underwater.
1 Alignment: Fire is automatically extinguished, and gain 25% resistance to explosion and fire damage. Further, whenever you take damage from a non-undead source, light it on fire for (5 * number of Ignis-aligned pieces) seconds.
2 Alignments: When fully submerged in lava you gain Fire Resistance, becoming immune to its damage, and can see without the normal red filter, but you also gain Blindness which limits your range of visibility.

§9§lAqua§r
Helmet: Gain Water Breathing and, when underwater, Night Vision.
1 Alignment: Cure Blindness, Poison, Wither, Confusion, Taint Poison, Mining Fatigue, Hunger, and Weakness.

§7§lOrdo§r
Any piece: Reduces the Warping level from 10 to 5, and increase the vis discount from 6% to 10%.
1 Alignment: Gain Regeneration I, and any negative effects from warp (Vis Exhaustion, Thaumarrhea, Unnatural Hunger, Blurred Vision, Sun Scorned, or Death Gaze) have their potency reduced by the number of Ordo-aligned pieces and their duration reduced by 1/(1 + number of Ordo-aligned pieces).

§8§lPerditio§r
1 Alignment: Whenever you take damage from a non-undead source, afflict it with Slowness IV and Blindness for (10 * number of Perditio-aligned pieces) seconds.

While it can't produce certus quartz crystals, it will give you plenty of the relevant nether crystal dusts as well as straight nether quartz.

§2Only needs netherrack soil, no sub-soil necessary here.

Welcome to Logistics Pipes! This questline is dedicated to this automation mod, which is placed in the MV tier to help manage your chests, crafting and even fluid crafting. It's quite similar to ProjectRed: Transportation, but with some differences, particularly in fluid crafting.

Here, you can connect chests and machines to a central location, but before you build that central location, you have to get some pipes for connection. The Unrouted Transport Pipe is the first pipe you will ever need in Logistics Pipes.

They only connect to other pipes and don't have any item routing capabilities, but you will need a ton of them.

§cWarning: Do NOT form junctions with the Unrouted Transport Pipes. Items going into an unrouted transport pipe junction will come out of a random exit of the junction.

When crops breed, the resulting stats are the average of the parents' stats plus a random value between -2 and 4.

Essentially, the variation in stats is a fixed (-2 -> +4). If all parents have fertilizer in them, stat loss is prevented in all cases (0 -> 4). 

Deterministic breeding is similar to how bees work, where you must bring the right species together. Some situations require more than two parents.

[note]Advanced crops (§5MV§r and above materials) will require the breeding machine.[/note]

Most crops will also have access to breeding pools. Breeding pools are like a set of tags associated with each crop. When breeding, if none of the parents produce a deterministic mutation, but some share one or more breeding pools, a random mutation may occur. The resulting offspring will always be a species tagged with one of the shared pools.

[note]Once you've obtained your first 31/31/31 seed, it can be helpful to use these random pool mutations to collect many different types of crops.[/note]

Introducing the bigger (and better) Implosion Compressor, the Electric Implosion Compressor.

The §5§lElectric Implosion Compressor§r does not need any explosive and only needs electricity, isn't that very nice!

Furthermore it gains extra parallels §6§l4^(Tier - 1)§r based on the containment block used in the middle.

Tier 1: Neutronium Block
Tier 2: Infinity Block
Tier 3: transcendent Metal Block
Tier 4: Spacetime Block
Tier 5: Universium Block

[note]The minimum allowed energy hatch tier is one tier below the recipe tier, so you'll want to start with at least 2 UHV energy hatches for now.[/note]

Nothing turns solids to liquids faster than the Large Fluid Extractor - not yet, anyways. You'll need to make both Heating and Solenoid Coils for this multiblock.

[note]This multiblock is technically EV, but it will demand a lot of tungstensteel.[/note]

Sometimes, a recipe has some extra outputs but the crafting module only has 1 output slot.

That is where the Crafting Byproduct Extraction Upgrade comes in. You can assign a byproduct of the recipe and this upgrade will make the module extract the byproduct as well. Now they won't clog the output buffer.
Less blue blueberries. Thauminite oreberries!

At UV you unlock the ability to automatically refill turbines with rotors.

XL turbines do it by default much earlier...

After you've managed to grab some §2Prismarine§r, you must process it with §2Industrial Strength Hydrofluoric Acid§r and §2Hydrogen Peroxide§r in the §5§lDissolution Tank§r. Using these ingredients you can make your very first batch of §3Prismarine Solution§r.

[warn]After you've created your first batch of Industrial Strength HF, it's highly recommended to check the Chemical Plant recipes for further creation of it![/warn]

The §5§lHeliocast Reinforcement§r (HR) module is the final §nExo-Foundry§r module unlocked in §9§lUIV§r. 

The HR module finally allows you access to §9§lUIV+§r Fluid Solidifier recipes. Now you can cool higher tier materials or create advanced reinforced glass types using the Foundry.

The HR module is also unique in being able to pair with itself, at a cost. Installing three or more §5HR§r modules on your Foundry will unlock "§6Entropic Core§r" and produce these effects:

- Processing values are randomly increased by a factor of §6Entropy§r, which is rolled independently for each value.
- §6Entropy§r is a value from 0 to the number of HR modules present (inclusive) and is rolled at the start of every recipe.
- §6Entropy§r can either severely slow down processing or speed it up, making this pairing random.
- The average §6Entropy§r values are S=1.5 with 3 HR modules and S=2.0 with 4 HR modules.

At 3 HR, processing values are as follows:

+§6(S*8)§r Parallels per Voltage tier
+§a(S*100%)§r Speed
-§b(S*15%)§r Total EU/t
+§d(S*0.05)§r OC Factor

At 4 HR:

+§dS§r Overclocks

[note]Never gonna know what yer gonna get![/note]

A feat of human engineering at your disposal!

This machine allows you to filter 9 items, and will only output set batches. This allows you to automate processes such as electrolyzing that require different amounts of inputs that may clog the system otherwise.

[note]This will be particularly useful in MV once you unlock more electrolysis recipes![/note]
Ardite oreberries!

Regular Netherite Nanoparticles alone don't have enough density to compress into Netherite... they require a strong and somewhat magical binding agent. 

§4Hellish Metal§r should be the perfect candidate, you can either fabricate it in the §5§lElectrolyzer§r or §5§lInfuse§r it.

[note]The Infusion recipe is much cheaper, but can only be used by those who have been proactive in their magic infrastructure.[/note]

Weeds will show up from time to time on empty single or double crop sticks. They will spread from there and sicken all your precious crops, so clear weeds with your spade (or fist) before you start desiring to reload the last backup. 

Using smaller fields will make things a lot easier, at least until you can make Weed-Ex, so if you forget about them you only lose one or two seeds. If your crops have already become sick, you'll need Plant-Cure to heal them. Otherwise you'll just have to risk breaking them if you want the seeds back before then.
Same as 1k.

Plant Cure is used to cure sickly crops. Crops will get sick in two scenarios:

1. A weed has grown and overtaken the crop.
2. A crop does not reach minimum environmental requirements.

You must spray the cure manually, it will apply a minimal amount of fertilizer so that crops don't immediately become sickly again.

§5§lPrismarine§r is an ancient material long rumored to have originated from structures found deep within the ocean. Learning how to create this is extremely important, and may lead to advancements in technology with further exploration into the substrate.

You can get Prismarine in a few different ways as shown resource-wise by the optional tasks:

§31. Through Botania by transmutating §nNether Quartz§r§3 directly to §nPrismarine§r§3 via an §nAlchemical Catalyst or the Fountain of Alchemy§r
§r
§22. Using §nRed Algae Biomass§r§2 and §nCertus Quartz§r §2dust in an §nAutoclave
§r
§c3. Using §nRed Algae Biomass§r§c and §nPrismatic Combs§r §cin an §nAutoclave.
§r
Which method you choose is entirely up to you and dependent on what infrastructure you have setup thus-far. Either way you would be wise to make a robust setup as you will be needing a decent amount of Prismarine in the future.

[warn]Hold 64 Naquarite Insulator Foil to skip the Prismarine line Quests.[/warn]
betterquesting:10.name:8: §b§lPrismarine!? What Do I Need That For?

betterquesting:10.desc:8:
Transcendent Metal is the primary metal used in UIV components.

This metal is a bit different from the ones you have been processing so far. You need to macerate your tesseracts to get the dust and then blast it at such high temperatures that you'll need a coolant to help manage the heat.

Due to the impossible nature of the tesseract particles, you'll need a medium to enable them to form 3D shapes. Tungsten, for some reason, works very well for this purpose.

The ingot itself is also not very stable; therefore, a coating of titansteel must be applied during the cooling process.

[note]Consider passively generating it. This process is slow.[/note]

[note]You may proceed to UIV now. Best of luck.[/note]

Now that you're in EV tier you now have access to the Quadruple input hatches. These hatches can hold four different fluids in the one hatch which saves valuable spots in your multiblocks.

Perfect to be placed in your EBFs.

Finally, you can now reduce your permanent warp.

The chance to reduce your permanent warp is 10%, increased to 25% if you have the Warp Ward effect and further increased to 40% if you're standing in Purifying Liquid. 

[warn]This soap has some side effects. Make sure you have a way to remove your normal (and temporary) warp.[/warn]

With Field Generators you can make your first Quantum Chests or Quantum Tanks. But the first two should be for your T2 rocket.

[note]Note that the Assembler recipe is more resource efficient.[/note]

§5§lInfused Seeds§r are very slow growing magical crops. Each seed is associated with a Thaumcraft aspect, and a fully grown plant can produce resources related to that aspect. Some of these drops are surprisingly useful. For example, a fully grown Venenum Infused Seed will drop 16 Quicksilver, an Iter Infused Seed will drop Arcane Bricks, and a Herba Infused Seed will give you random saplings.

You can see the products of different seeds using NEI.

There is a catch: the Infusion Altar can only directly create seeds for the six primal aspects. To create seeds for compound aspects, you'll need to combine their component aspects through the farmland itself.

Let's make a §cVenenum Infused Seed§r as an example. §cVenenum§r is composed of §3Aqua§r + §dPerditio§r, so begin by crafting both an §3Aqua Infused Seed§r and a §dPerditio Infused Seed§r.

Plant the §3Aqua Infused Seed§r on ordinary vanilla farmland and allow it to grow. As the seed grows, it leaves some of its aspect behind in the farmland. Once the farmland has been infused with §3Aqua§r, remove the §3Aqua§r seed and plant your §dPerditio Infused Seed§r on the same block.

The §dPerditio§r from the seed will combine with the §3Aqua§r already stored in the farmland, producing §cVenenum§r. The farmland and seed will become infused with the new aspect, and once the §cVenenum§r seed reaches maturity, it can be harvested.

Naturally, waiting for these things to grow isn't particularly exciting. The Hoe of Growth works on Infused Seeds and can greatly speed up the process, although each use consumes 25 durability. With a sufficiently durable or repairable Hoe of Growth, you may even find some interesting ways to automate the process.

[warn]One warning before you dive too deeply into magical agriculture: reaching and researching Infused Seeds involves a lot of Warp. Consider yourself warned before deciding that unlimited magical wheat sounds harmless.[/warn]

Now that you have started using Vis in the form of Essentia, a warning about Taint.

Vis in the state of Essentia is unstable if not stored properly. Left alone too long, or emptied out of the Crucible, Essentia will break down. But not into Vis. Rather, it will turn into Flux.

Flux manifests as a liquid or a gas, but is, itself, only a nuisance. Thaumaturges exposed to the stuff can end up getting Flux Flue, a condition which makes it harder to channel Vis, but it is only temporary.

Larger concentrations of Flux will solidify into Thaumic Slimes, bizarre creatures that try to merge with each other to grow larger. They can be dangerous, but are no less susceptible to crossbow bolts than most things.

However, if too much flux is allowed to linger for too long, it will corrupt the land and solidify into tendrils. This is a manifestation of the blight called Taint. Fibrous Tendrils (as well as condensed blocks thereof) spread the Tainted Lands, feeding on the magic it twists. Nodes are especially vulnerable, becoming Tainted themselves if exposed to this twisted magic.

Destroying the tendrils stops the spread, but unless §oall§r are destroyed this is only temporary. A more effective solution is to destroy the Tainted Land itself, as outside this specific biome tendrils quickly starve and die off.

If you are §oexceedingly§r careless with your Crucible you can, in fact, create Tainted Lands. So you would be wise to try wasting as little Essentia as possible, and clean up any you do waste.

You already transcended dimensions, but as your power demands spike to absurd levels, maybe it's time to transcend matter!

Using the unbreakable stability of Proto-Halkonite, harnessing the power of [warn]Chaos[/warn] becomes a reality. The  Semi-Stable Antimatter Stabilization Sequencer introduces the concept of Semi-Stable Antimatter, created from Protomatter.

But it's a cruel mistress... fail to manage it, and antimatter could void itself into nothingness.

The Semi-Stable Antimatter is produced in 1 second cycles, the amount generated is based on the total of antimatter currently stocked in its 16 Antimatter Hatches and consumes equal amounts of Proto Matter.

Each cycle, the base production of antimatter per hatch is:
(1/16)*(§3Antimatter§r)^(0.5 + §6§nC§r).
Then each hatch will pull a random number from a normal distribution of 0.2 + §b§nA§r and a variance of 1, multiplying the base production with it, meaning the total antimatter change may be negative.

This causes an imbalance between the hatches. To properly automate the antimatter production, it's vital to always re-balance the amount of antimatter in the hatches. At the end of each cycle, the lowest amount of antimatter present in hatches is recorded, and any hatch that contains more than the lowest amount loses half the difference!

Proper use of stabilization fluids can significantly reduce energy usage and boost production:

It consumes 10,000,000 + (§3Antimatter§r * 1000)^(1.5 - §2§nM§r) EU/t passively
Magnetic Stabilization Fluids can mitigate the passive instability and have its §2exponent§r reduced:
Molten Purified Tengam Exponent = §2§n0.1§r
Tachyon-Rich Fluid Exponent = §2§n0.2§r
Molten Magmatter Exponent = §2§n0.3§r

For each cycle, the SSASS uses (§3Antimatter§r * 10000)^(1.5 - §5§nG§r) EU
By regulating the gravity containment of the forge, this §5exponent§r can also be reduced:
Molten Spacetime Exponent = §5§n0.05§r
Spatially Enlarged Fluid Exponent = §5§n0.10§r
Molten Eternity Exponent = §5§n0.15§r

By containing the antimatter more compactly, it is possible to generate larger gains per cycle. Containment Stabilization fluids alter the §6exponent§r in the production formula:
Molten Shirabon Exponent = §6§n0.05§r
Molten MHDCSM Exponent = §6§n0.10§r

By inserting fluids with high energy potential, it's possible to alter antimatter's flow in chaos, making their randomness more favorable. Activation Stabilization Fluids alter the §baverage§r of the gaussian distribution, lowering the risks of negative changes in antimatter and favoring better gains.
Depleted Naquadah Fuel Mk V average = §b§n0.05§r
Depleted Naquadah Fuel Mk VI average = §b§n0.10§r

Using purified water, you can use an §5§lOil Cracker§r to convert the Nefarious Gas from the previous step into §4Nefarious Oil§r.

[note]If you are proactive and setup grade 2 water production, you unlock a recipe that produces much more oil, with much less water, in much less time. §[[/note]

Definitely consider making one.

The Transcendent Plasma Mixer is a powerful asset for all your DTPF catalyst needs.

The base processing time is always 5 seconds. You can specify the number of parallels the machine can run in the GUI.

Each parallel additively increases the power requirement, so you don't lose any efficiency while increasing production!

[note]Most of your power will go here. Consider upgrading your naquadah fuel or creating the Dyson Swarm.[/note]

2 077 795 200 EU/t at 12s per liter. A truly immense amount of power, with a hefty cost. You will need a lot of infrastructure to run the refinery, but doing so will reward you with trillions of EU/t.

The astral titanium and celestial tungsten for alternate recipe can be sourced from laser engravers or the Plasma Fuel Line.

The tritanium can be sourced using fusion reactors, or by mining in the Deep Dark.

The shirabon will require an immense amount of fusion reactors and DTPFs to sustain.

After Eye of Harmony, condensed raw stellar plasma can be used to improve the yield for even more power.

You will also want to consider the Tachyon Rich Temporal Fluid to get the most out of the Mark VI.

Hyper-Acceleration cards are a faster version of the basic acceleration cards. 

[note]Hyper-Acceleration cards can only be placed in:[/note]

§cME IO Port (3)
ME Fluid Import Bus (4)
ME Fluid Export Bus (4)
ME Import/Export Bus (4)

§rIn an IO Port, the Hyper-Acceleration Card will transfer items at a rate of: 

§61x Cards: 4,096 items/tick
2x Cards: 32,768 items/tick
3x Cards: 262,144 items/tick

§rIn ME Fluid Buses, the Hyper-Acceleration Card will transfer fluids at a rate of:

§61x Cards: 4,096,000 mb/tick
2x Cards: 32,768,000 mb/tick
3x Cards: 262,144,000 mb/tick

Still want more? Consider doing another run! Maybe even with some restrictions if you want to spice it up a bit. Check the first quest chapter for some recommendations!

There's also roles to be earned for completing the pack two or even three times if you want an extra incentive.

[note]This quest and “The Factory Must Grow!” are mutually exclusive; completing one will lock the other.

If you are going for 100% questbook completion, don't panic, finishing either quest still allows the tab to receive a green check (much like the previous XOR quests).[/note]

A source of iridium.

Iridine leaves will 4x your iridium ore.

The §5§lObservation Array§r is less an assembler than an enormous quantum router. It draws condensate from every Containment Field visible to its network, supplies power to its linked Teleportation Nodes, and presents those Nodes with the nanites demanded by each stage of their recipes. Up to sixteen Nodes may be linked to one Array, with their combined energy cost paid here.

The nanites are never consumed, but they must be exchanged constantly. Providing a higher tier than requested actually slows processing, while mixing nanite types causes the entire collection to behave as the lowest tier present. Precision, not brute force, is the key.

[warn]More than three unrequested condensates on the network will immediately fail every active recipe. Even fewer contaminants significantly reduce processing speed.[/warn]

[note]Running the same recipe across synchronized Nodes is strongly recommended. Different recipes may request incompatible nanites and contaminate one another's condensate network.[/note]
No Description
The Obsidian barrel holds as many items as the Diamond one, and is also immune to explosions.

This upgrade will allow you to create fuel even faster than before and with an alternative recipe for MKVI fuel!
...but do you really need it?

The ultimate gas inhaler in GTNH. Check the XL Steam Turbine quest above for an explanation of the mechanics shared across all turbines.

[warn]This turbine does not accept Benzene.[/warn] To use it with your Benzene setup, you have to upgrade it to Nitrobenzene. Further changes will be made to this turbine to favor more high-tier gases, instead of spamming Benzene, Methane or other trivial options.
Easy spruce wood!
Radioactive alert! The Uranus bee allows you to obtain resources from Uranus and its moons.

Carefully treating raw computer parts with purified water allows you to make optically enhanced chips. These use light waves to do computations at a speed you previously couldn't imagine. Making them is quite an involved process however.

At last... behold the power of the Runeforged Thaumaturge's Ring.

It grants an unbelievable §5§l10%§r discount on all primal aspects, along with additional runic shielding. Only the most powerful thaumaturges could even hope to wield it.

The shielding is so strong that it naturally blocks the effects of Poison and Wither.

[warn]Unlike before, the pearl will be consumed when crafting these rings.[/warn]
These caps are even better than thaumium!

This is the end of the mk3 fusion chain, and the three chains altogether. After 14 fusion recipes on top of Helium Plasma, you hold in your tanks the elusive Celestial Tungsten Plasma, whose fuel value of 720M makes it immune to XL Plasma penalties all the way to spacetime!

Upscaling plasma powergen up to endgame, and the Dyson Swarm, is most likely reliant on either this or Americium Plasma, which is 1-step but not as powerful on a per-reactor basis. This can net you above 8 billion EU per tick, for every Mk3 compact that you have running Celestial Tungsten at 64 parallels, with Infinity turbines. Upscaling this is not so difficult, if you keep in mind which recipes will bottleneck you the most, as long as you have the resources for it.

There are no plasmas that build off Celestial Tungsten Plasma just yet, but it's possible that some might be added in the future, especially for GT++ materials such as Dragonblood. Congratulations on finishing this fusion chain! May the power be with you.
betterquesting:10.name:8: Celestial Tungsten Plasma - The Mk3 Finale

betterquesting:10.desc:8: There are many plants that can provide you with Glowstone Dust. But the best one might just be Glieonia. This magical plant, once matured, can be harvested for two Glowstone Dust directly.

The Timewood Clock is a special block that can be obtained in The Twilight Forest. It can be used to accelerate vanilla crops in a 16 block radius, making farms significantly faster and more efficient.

To get one, you must explore inside the massive Twilight Forest trees and search the loot chests hidden within them. There is a small chance to find a Tree of Time sapling. The clock generates hidden inside the tree after it grows.
[warn]
After growing the tree, you will need a Silk Touch tool to obtain the Timewood Clock itself.[/warn]
[note]
If you break it without Silk Touch, it will instead drop several vanilla gold clocks.[/note]

The §5Ritual of Gaia's Transformation§r is the Blood Magic way of changing biomes. It consists of 116 Ritual Stones, including the Dusk ones, and requires an §9Awakened Activation Crystal§r.

To use the ritual, simply activate it, and it will transform an area up to §221x21§r.

If you want to change the biome you get from the ritual, use Arcane Plinths. The ritual starts from 0.5 humidity and 0.5 temperature, then consumes the items placed on the plinths to increase or decrease those values. It also starts by assuming a range of 0.1 is acceptable in both directions.

The items that modify these values are as follows:
- Sand -> Humidity -0.1
- Sandstone -> Humidity -0.2
- Netherrack -> Humidity -0.4
- Lapis -> Humidity +0.1
- Water Bucket -> Humidity +0.2
- Lapis Block -> Humidity +0.4
- Coal -> Temperature +0.1
- Coal Block -> Temperature +0.2
- Lava Bucket -> Temperature +0.4
- Snowball -> Temperature -0.1
- Snow Block -> Temperature -0.2
- Ice Block -> Temperature -0.4

Once you have used the items to reach your desired environment, the ritual will give you a biome from it. If there are multiple biomes with that humidity and temperature, you can use wool to determine the exact one, for up to 17 conflicting biomes. If the ritual cannot find a valid biome, it will default to Plains.

Some cool ones include, but are not limited to:
- Sky (also known as End) -> Orange Wool
- Eldritch -> Cyan Wool
- Eerie -> Light Gray Wool
- TF Forest -> Pink Wool
- Sacred Springs -> Yellow Wool
- Tainted Land -> Purple or Blue Wool
- Moon -> 0% Humidity, No Wool
- Mars Flat -> 0% Humidity, White Wool
- Asteroids -> 0% Humidity, Orange Wool
- Space -> 0% Humidity, Magenta Wool
- Toxic Everglades -> 70% Humidity, No Wool

[note]For the biome change to show up properly on the client, you may need to relog.[/note]
While surveying species in the wild, you found some unique sproutlings reaching from a corpse. I wonder what these will provide.

Now that you've unlocked the neutronium energy cell, you can combine it with other objects to make powerful upgrades to your AE capabilities.

Combining with an ME controller gives you a controller with infinite energy.

Combining with a cable anchor & quartz fiber gives you a replacement for the quartz fiber cable that has infinite energy.

Combining with an advanced card will give you an energy card that will allow you to upgrade your wireless terminal to have infinite energy, wherever you go.

[note]It is HIGHLY recommended you use these tools wherever possible on main-nets and sub-nets as they are huge TPS savers[/note]

Even Refined Components begin to fail near the final tiers of the EoH. Only something far greater than stellar matter will suffice.

By incorporating MHDCSM into their structure, Resplendent Components can withstand the most extreme conditions your EoH can create.

Directly dissolve and chlorinate lanthanide ores in Digester to get the concentrated solution of the corresponding ore. Then use the corresponding Extracting Nano Resin to extract the main material in the solution. The rest (Chlorinated Rare Earth Concentrate) is still rich in useful lanthanides.

You can use any type of Extracting Nano Resin to extract the useful things in the rest. What Nano Resin you use, what lanthanide you'll get. Every bucket of Chlorinated Rare Earth Concentrate can do this extraction 3 times. First Concentrate to Enriched Solution, then Enriched Solution to Diluted Solution, then waste liquid.

After extracting, the Nano Resin will be "Filled". Put them "Filled" into Electrolyzer then nanites will transfer the "Particles" out from the resin under the influence of electric field. And you can get the Nano Resins and let them go into the next work round, again and again without breaks.

Yes, Rare Earth will not be Rare. Bless the Nano Tech.
A passive mana generating flower that can produce a never-ending torrent of mana.

Now that you've stolen the food from your harmless neighbors, or found it in nature like a considerate person, you must now plant these carrots onto crop sticks. Wait until the crop is §3fully grown§r and left-click it for the best chance to obtain the seeds.

No, the undomesticated Wild Carrot won't work. What are you, a rabbit?

§3Livens§r will increase your Incense from §9800§r to §91500§r.
§aViridis§r will increase it even further from §91500§r to §92400§r.

The Fountain of Alchemy as you may guess, is functionally just like the Mana Fountain, except it can handle the recipes that you would typically need an Alchemy Rune underneath a Mana Pool for.

If you need any further details about its functionality, check out the Mana Fountain quest or the Lexica Botania.

[warn]This cannot do regular Mana Pool recipes, only Alchemy recipes.[/warn]

[note]If, for whatever reason, you needed an abundance of prismarine in the future... perhaps a quad Fountain of Alchemy would be an excellent aid in obtaining that.[/note]
It holds over 32GL.
No Description

The Super Stock Replenisher is an incredibly useful item, especially for those pesky loop automations!

To use, put a storage cell in the empty slot (item vs fluid & type amount do not matter) and you can set up to 63 items & 9 fluids to be stocked by the machine. The total quantity of both items and fluids are determined by the byte size of the storage cell.

When an item / fluid is stocked, it will pull it from the ME network it is attached to and those items / fluids will become invisible to your network. You can then use a storage bus to make these items visible to a subnet. Items will not be able to re-enter the SSR once pulled out. The SSR will automatically replenish its inventory from your AE network whenever the internal stock reaches less than 50% of the configured value.

[note]When an item or fluid is erased from the stocker or when the stocker is broken, everything will return to the network the stocker was attached too, so no need to panic about losing items.[/note]
You get the idea, these ones do 64A!

The portable equivalent of the Obsidian Barrel that retains it's explosion-proof qualities.

Has §n108§r slots.

[note]Can be dyed![/note]

Finally, a use for all of these coins!

The §5§lVending Machine§r is a unique multiblock that allows you to exchange coins for valuable resources. You will progressively unlock new trades as you complete quests. Quests that unlock Vending Machine trades upon completion will show this information under the section labeled "§lAssociated Vending Machine Exchanges§r".

Alternatively you can click "§2U§r" on the Vending Machine in NEI to see all available trades and what quests they are unlocked by. If an item can be traded for it will show up when clicking "§2R§r" under the Vending Machine tab.

You can put your coins directly into the input and they will appear in the internal storage. Additional inputs §3(including non-consumable)§r should be placed here as well. There is also a button for ejecting the coins if you need to reclaim them. Breaking the Vending Machine will not cause the coins to fall out or get deleted, they will be there when you replace it.

You can also share coins between a team. Using the §3/gtnhteam§r command you can team with other players and switch at will between using either your personal wallet, or your team wallet. Additionally, while in a team you can purchase VM items on behalf of a teammate.

[warn]Be aware, some trades have much longer timeout periods between claims![/warn]
No Description

After significant progression, you'll be able to upgrade the QFT to tier 2 by replacing the §3Neutron Pulse Manipulator§r casings with §3Cosmic Fabric Manipulator§r casings. Once installed, the QFT can perform the §6monaline skip§r, the §6first two naqline skips§r, and the §6netherite line skip§r.

These casings require more advanced materials, including §3Hyper-Stable Self-Healing Adhesive§r, which can only be crafted in a tier 1 QFT. This adhesive isn’t just excellent at sticking things together - it’s also built to withstand the intense energy flow of a tier 2, 3, or even tier 4 QFT! §o

Who knows what kinds of materials you’ll need after this?!
This bad boi can handle 18 modules at once.
The Moon bee allows you to obtain resources from the Moon.

Remote requests aren't always convenient. As long as you are in range with a request pipe, the remote orderer can take the order and send it to a request pipe the orderer binds to.

Pretty handy if you have an ender chest and an ender pouch...

[note]Author's note: Too bad ender chests and pouches are gated behind IV and thaumcraft... And why people would use an LP system at that point is really beyond me...[/note]

At this point, you may have noticed that these higher-tier metal combs can't be extracted with a centrifuge. Instead, you need to pass them through a chemical reactor with some hydrochloric acid. This will leave you in a pickle. Here you are, trying to reach post-scarcity, and now you're limited by chlorine.

Speaking of pickles, hydrochloric acid is kind of like a pickle, right? After all, you make both with salt! The salt bee is perfect for this. Well, the apatite bee line can get you some salt and also some phosphorus for phosphoric acid, but you have to start on ash bees first. Meanwhile, you'll likely take care of the salt bee's pre-requisites on your way through getting all the major ores.

Breed them from clay and aluminium bees on top of a block of salt.

They will produce salt combs, borax dust, slag combs, and trace lithium combs. The salt combs will require at least an MV-tier centrifuge, but at least it doesn't require processing with acid in a chemical reactor!

[note]Breeder's Notes:

There are two challenges with this bee:

1. The 5% chance of mutation. You may consider trying the escritoire minigame to get a boost to this chance. If so, favor aluminium drones because you're probably on your way to the other bees derived from aluminium ancestry, and they all only have a 5% chance anyways. They could all use a little boost.

2. The humidity swing between clay and aluminium species. Clay bees want it wet, and both aluminium and salt bees want it completely arid. If you can't manipulate the climate or the tolerances of any of the bees, consider starting by plugging clay drones into a modest princess. This has a good chance to get you a clay princess that prefers a dryer climate. You can then do all your breeding exclusively in an arid biome.[/note]

Most of the recipes are made in all kinds of machines. While a crafting logistics pipe works, it can only hold 1 recipe per pipe.

It is not an issue for logistics crafting tables as it can only hold one crafting table recipes, but it is wasteful to assign only one recipe for one machine.

For machines, use chassis. Preferably a higher tier. A Mk1 chassis with a crafting module is basically just a crafting logistics pipe.

You can't shift-click recipes from NEI so you have to drag the recipe from it. Don't worry, you can drag ghost items from NEI into the slots in the module to configure it.

You notice there are 3 gray slots at the right. They are for satellite logistics pipes. We will talk about it later.

§cNote: do NOT use the output face of the machine. The output side blocks all interactions unless you hit it with a screwdriver.

Also do NOT use auto-output, or else the machine will output the item into the pipe and the network will treat the product as an item inserted into the system rather than an item requested by the system and will send it to its storage. Every other face except the cover works.§r

The check mark means you have read the whole thing and should know how machine automation works using LP. The reward of this quest is the knowledge of how to automate GT machine recipes

So you've chosen the §5§nWetware and Bioware Package§r for your newly purchased NAC™. A wise choice, as these are some of the most important circuits you will make. See the attached owner's manual for installation instructions.

§oGet it while you can! A two-for-one deal on circuit lines!§r

§n§lAccelerated Biological Coordinator Owner's Manual:§r

The NAC™ will track the most recent 100,000 circuits crafted, and can be calibrated to a specific circuit type by reaching a certain percentage of circuits of this type. At 60% (60,000) wetware circuits crafted, the NAC™ will become "fully calibrated" to wetware circuits, and the same applies to bioware circuits.

Depending on which calibration has been achieved, the Biological Coordinator will provide one of two bonuses:
- If calibrated to §nWetware§r, usage of Growth Catalyst Medium is reduced to zero
- If calibrated to §nBioware§r, usage of both Growth Catalyst Medium and Bio Catalyst Medium is reduced to zero

If you've built the Source Chamber already, you may have noticed that particles aren't produced as items, like GT++ ones are.

Instead they're transmitted through Beamline Pipes from multi to multi, similar to real life.

Each stream of particles transmitted, or "beam", has four properties:
- §6Particle§r: the type of particle carried by the beam
- §4Energy§r: the amount of energy the particles have
- §9Focus§r: out of 100, how focused the beam is
- §dAmount§r: a measure of the number of particles in the beam

Note that you can see info about a multi's input and output beams by using a Tricorder on the controller.

For the recipes you'll be interested in, i.e. the ones that actually produce items, there'll be a threshold for allowed input beam energy, a minimum focus value, and an amount value which determines recipe time (more on that in the Target Chamber quest).
Take a look some TC recipes for an example of this.

Have a Higgs Boson. To hang on your wall.

Now that you have a Matter Manipulator... why not make it better?

These upgrades will give huge quality of life improvements when using should you choose to craft them. 

[note]Pay attention to the applicable tier of MM before you do so![/note]

Shadow Metal is an extremely useful metal in the early game. It can be easily made via the crucible and refined once you unlock the vacuum freezer. 

Its high durability makes it a fantastic candidate for handheld tools, prospector scanners, turbines, and even wand caps later down the line.

Start off by making 5 ores, and doubling that using a macerator.

[note]Hint: You can find the research early on in the Maleficia section of the Thaumonomicon[/note]

[quest]The Solar Factory![/quest]

The structure has tiers, each of which allow greater production than the previous tier. 

Recipes in NEI display the minimum wafer tier required. 
Wafer Tiers: 

§6Monocrystalline
Phosphorous
Naquadah
Europium
Americium
Photonically Prepared
Photonically Enhanced§r

Machine parallels are based on Precise Casing Tier:

§6MK-I: §c8x§r
§6MK-II: §c16x§r
§6MK-III: §c32x§r
§6MK-IV: §c64x§r

§lTier §b2:§r

§aSupports Multi-Amp energy hatches§r
§c25%§r more outputs for every Wafer tier §oabove§r the minimum required.
The bonus to outputs occurs after parallels, but §9cannot be greater§r than §c100%§r
LV-LuV Solar Panels can be made without the previous panel, but at a higher cost.

§lTier §b3:§r

§aSupports Laser Energy hatches§r
Bonus per increased wafer tier is increased to §c50%§r
ZPM-UV Solar Panels can be made without the previous panel, but at a higher cost.

Do you know how much Zinc you have in your body? Very little, but it's important. Now imagine it's all plasma!

This is a very fast recipe, like Niobium Plasma. The only caveat is that it uses Tritium (not Trinium), a rare isotope of Hydrogen that you can obtain from Deuterium, a less rare isotope. You can pump it directly from Neptune, through the Space Elevator or simply by centrifuging the Deuterium you already automated for Helium Plasma.

You are not done with wafers. Ok well, now you are, kind of.

Infinite Wafers are the final tier of raw wafer, forged directly in the God Forge. Who knew silicon could hold up for this long?

Yocto Power ICs are used in Magmatter Nanites, MAX circuits, and UXV Energy Hatches.

[note]You'll need a UXV Laser Engraver to cut these.

Yocto Power ICs need to be coated in Quark Gluon Plasma in an Exo-Foundry, overclocked to reach the MAX voltage required. This step cannot be done in a Mass Solidifier.[/note]
This bee produces Barnarda dust.

§2Enriched fertilizer§r allows you to advance to the next stage of crop technology! 

It is used in countless ways moving forward, for example:

- Apply it to your crops for more efficient fertilization.
- Used to breed novel crops in the §dCrop Breeder§r.
- Used to replicate seeds in the §dSeed Generator§r.

§2Enriched Fertilizer§r is 10 times more potent than regular Fertilizer when applied.

- With a §dCrop Manager§r, a single unit of fluid adds 10 fertilizer units to the machine's internal storage.
- With an §dIndustrial Farm§r, you only need to provide 1/10th of the amount indicated on the tooltips. (Except when using a Fertilization Unit.)

It will always be superior to the item based Fertilizers of the past, so moving forward you should be using it whenever possible.

When using the §dCrop Breeder§r or §dSeed Generator§r, the §2Enriched Fertilizer§r recipe costs scale with the stats of the resulting seeds. [warn]Keep this in mind as early tier machines all have a lower than usual fluid capacity.[/warn] You'll need at least §5HV§r machines in order to create maxed seeds. By default NEI shows you the costs for a maxed seed, so keep this in mind when looking up recipes.
The Glowstone Princess isn't as picky as her peers. There are no breeding requirements besides the species being Gold and Redstone. Hooray!
Do you really need this?

To do anything in CropsNH, you first need crop sticks. These will act as the supports for your plants to grow upon. Empty crop sticks can be doubled by right-clicking another crop stick onto them. These double-crop sticks allow you to breed any adjacent mature crops.

As new species grow on your crop sticks, you can harvest them by right-clicking, which won't remove the seed. Left-clicking harvests the crop and removes it, potentially dropping a seed depending on the resistance. Spades will help you improve your chances of obtaining seeds when you do this, as will the Resistance trait.

§r§r[note]§l§r§lThe chance to drop a seed from any crop §nwithout a spade§r§l is measured
as resistance/31. §rSo crops with a maxed resistance stat will always drop a seed when broken.§r[/note]

[warn]Note in NEI the varying types of soil, sub-soil, and environmental requirements for different crops![/warn]

§oIf you're already an experienced farmhand, collect a single stonelily seed and I'll let you skip subsequent introductory trainings for now.

A single stargate pair wasn't enough for you?

Well then, time to build a network.

Welcome to the post-stargate tier! 

Now that you successfully managed to make a stargate, what about crafting them in industrial quantities? Try to craft 5 pairs of gates in the least amount of time, then come in #screenshot-brag and post your time to see where your infrastructure stands in the community!

[note]This quest and “See You Next Time!” are mutually exclusive; completing one will lock the other.

If you are going for 100% questbook completion, don't panic, finishing either quest still allows the tab to receive a green check (much like the previous XOR quests).[/note]

§dEnjoy your round of Minesweeper!

A cell of antimatter! Contained in a cell made of matter! Surely this is safe.

Antimatter is exactly what you may imagine, the opposite of matter, for every atom in the universe, an "anti atom" exists, and when both meet...

They annihilate themselves, releasing a lot of energy!

But how could you capture this energy?
betterquesting:10.name:8: §9§l§n"Semi-Stable" doing a lot of work in here

betterquesting:10.desc:8:
Celestial Gateways are a bit expensive, but they provide very convenient travel within a dimension.

Shift-click with a celestial pearl on a celestial gateway to attune the pearl to that specific gateway and insert that pearl into the slot of another.

Shift when standing above a celestial gateway to get the teleportation menu. It makes sense to name the pearls in an anvil if you want to easily identify the different locations.

An engine is required to accelerate your Mothership. There are two different tiers of engines and bases, and you can attach between 1-10 engine bases to a single engine in a §nhorizontal line§r. Each additional base additively increases thrust. You may use multiple engines if desired, but their bases must be separate, and all engines should face the same direction for maximum efficiency. The engine and its bases will combine into a single clickable entity that can be filled with fuel.

The Mothership determines its fuel consumption and total travel time based on the available thrust and the distance being traveled. However, the Mothership will not allow departure if the travel time exceeds one in-game day, meaning you must have sufficient thrust to reach your destination.

The minimum configurations required to reach the Ra system using each engine tier are listed below:

A §5Rocket Engine Jet§r (T1) will produce §22MN§r of thrust per §5Rocket Engine Base§r and require §32L/t§r of §6Naquadah Based Fuel MK-II§r during travel. At minimum, to make it to the Ra system you will need §n9§r Rocket Engine Bases and 92,440L of fuel.

An §5Ion Thruster Jet§r (T2) will produce §225MN§r of thrust per §5Ion Thruster Base§r and require both §31L/t§r of §6Xenon§r and §c10EU/t§r of power during travel. At minimum, to make it to the Ra system you will need §n7§r Ion Thruster Bases, 20,970L of Xenon, and 31,970EU.

Note that for both configurations, when starting from the Overworld, you must first stop at Proxima Centauri to refuel before continuing on to the Ra system.

[note]It's highly recommended to go with the T1 route since the required materials are much cheaper![/note]
The §2Prismatic Crystal§r will then be processed in a §5§lVacuum Furnace§r with §2Boron Plasma§r in order to successfully convert it to the highly sought after §3Prismatic Gas§r.

You can't use this rocket to go to any planet or moon §oand§r it's the most expensive one - a bad deal? Not quite! The Shuttle Rocket is used to create and access a §1§lMothership§r.

The Shuttle Rocket needs the same fuel as the T8 Rocket.

The Dynamism tablet is a block that simulates the functionality of a left and right-click autoclicker. It can be obtained fairly early in the game (early-mid MV), and is a useful tool for simple automation.

Upon placing, the tablet will target the block that it's facing (the direction is indicated by a small dot on the overlay) and will start once you give it an item in its slot. If it holds a block/seed/sapling, it can also place it on the block below it.

It can be configured to either left/right click and also has an option to only be active when it receives a redstone signal. Hoppers or item pipes of any sort also allow the tablet to receive items.

Note that some special mob drops or special interactions (like BM sacrificial knife) are disabled for the Dynamism tablet. However, they do work with Tinkers Tools.

[note]This item has received a rework in 2.8 and has had most of its bugs fixed. If you still encounter any bugs, feel free to report it on our GitHub page or discord server.[/note]

We get it; The early-game of Thaumcraft requires a lot of research and you don't want to throw every one of your 1000 items on the ground and scan them for aspects. That's why we added 2 cool QoL features which makes this tedious task very quick and easy.

1. You don't actually have to throw the item on the ground. You can scan it directly from your inventory! Simply hover your Thaumometer over the item you want to scan, and after a short duration it will be scanned.

2. You've probably accumulated dozens of double chests full of junk that you don't want to sift through and scan, so there's a second feature now: Scanning entire chests! Simply shift right-click while hovering over a chest with your thaumometer and it'll scan EVERY item inside of the chest. Though before you can do so you have to learn a bit more about deconstruction in the Thaumonomicon.

[note]Hint: To unlock the research to scan entire chests, go to your Thaumonomicon, open "Basic Information" (the first tab), and complete this research path: Research -> Research Expertise -> Deconstruction Table -> Container Scanning.[/note]

Metallic crops are probably the most useful crops for late game. Thanks to the leaves harvested from these species, you can create tons of raw resources and even multiply the yield of your ores.

Most metallic crops can be thrown into a forge hammer with some acid to create raw resources, or used in a chemical reactor with dirty crushed ores in order to increase your ore yields by up to 400%.

§4Netherite Nanoparticles§r can be made from §5§lMacerating§r your newly attained Brittle Netherite Scraps.

[note]Almost seems too easy doesn't it?[/note]
This new species will present a more direct route to the Chrome you need for Stainless Steel production. Just don't make any pies with it.
The Diamond barrel has 108 slots.

How do you compress things in the Steam Age? Simple, putting a lot of steam in one place, under high pressure, can apply a force to compress things...

Let's just make it bigger. With the Steam Squasher, you can have a Compressor in a much larger scale, similarly to the other Steam Multiblocks. If you feel like compressing recipes are taking too long, which they probably are, this is a good solution to your problems.

Once the multi forms, provide lots of steam to get lots of compressed items.
The Shulker can spawn in the Lich or Ghast Queen Tower in the Twilight Forest. You can also optionally obtain its spawn egg either with the crafting recipe or through the Vending Machine.

Ore Berries are a shockingly diverse and useful set of crops, a number of which you'll have already received from previous questbook rewards. However, they can give more than just the basic minerals.

All of these crops will only grow in dark enviroments, with a sub-soil of their related material whether block or ore.

The §5Large Molecular Assembler§r is exactly how it sounds; a very quick molecular assembler with a much bigger inventory for crafting patterns. 

This can handle up to 1024 crafts per second at the maximum energy usage making it up to 100x faster than a molecular assembler. Check out the Wiki for specifics: [url]https://wiki.gtnewhorizons.com/wiki/Large_Molecular_Assembler[/url]

The LMA controller hooks up directly to your main network in order to function, and all recipes must be placed inside either an input bus or a Crafting Pattern Provider bus in order to be recognized. Will not require an output bus.

Additionally, you must place a §2Data Orb§r inside of the controller or else it won't function.

[note]It's recommended you use a Crafting Pattern Provider bus since it has more pattern slots and gets recognized by an interface terminal unlike a regular input bus.[/note]

[warn]This machine can absolutely wall-share, but be careful about the placement of your input bus or all machines may not be used.[/warn]
Papyrus represents one of the easiest ways to automate paper production in the game, if you needed that for some reason.

Now that you've stolen the food from your harmless neighbors, or found it in nature like a considerate person, you must now plant these potatoes onto crop sticks. Wait until the crop is §3fully grown§r and left-click it for the best chance to obtain the seeds.

You've probably drained quite a few of them at this point.

[note]Have you heard about YOTTanks?[/note]
Same as 1k.

Combining diamond chest with obsidian allowed you to create a chest that is blast proof!

[note]Just as with the previous chests you can also upgrade with a fitting upgrade item.[/note]

Now that you are starting to find more and more copper, you feel your wood chests are too small to hold all the stuff.

[note]It's time to upgrade your wooden chests to copper chests! Higher tiers of chests can be upgraded cheaply by using upgrade items, but not all tier chests can be upgraded directly this way. You can also try the "Wood to Copper Chest Upgrade", but upgrading from wood to a tiered chest will not be any cheaper.[/note]

[note]Upgraded chests cannot be connected into double chests.[/note]

Eternal coils? Perfect time for stargate trophy number three.
You know the drill, you give 2 stargates' worth of stuff, you get your trophy. Simple as that.

[note]Our journey through time continues onwards, entering the UMV, aka DTPF era.

Surprisingly, it still is the year 2022, but there have been a huge amount of changes since our last stop in the UEV era. The DTPF exists now, hypogen & eternal coils included, and machine parts up to UMV thus are craftable. Wireless energy is a thing now too, both the LSC and the regular hatch kind, and AE2FC is in the pack, allowing direct fluid crafting (meaning no more volumetric flask shuffling).
The power situation hasn't changed much since the UEV era, except for dyson being even more bugged and giving free uncapped infinite power (abusing this was obviously labeled as bugabuse).
Some other new useful things are the MABS, Integrated Ore Factory, Space Elevator, UIV and UMV singleblocks, EIG, EEC, industrial & mega apiary, yottanks, stocking buses, data bank chaining and the Draconic Fusion Crafter.
The stargate's cost has now skyrocketed far more than ever before, marking the beginning of this new era of GT:NH endgame, the era of expansion.

This time around the leading §aGDCloud§r was challenged by the team §aNeo Caelestia§r, who were progressing at a staggering speed, inching ever closer to being first to gate, but ultimately weren't able to fully catch up and thus §aGDCloud§r once again was first to conquer the challenge on the §a19th of November, 2022§r.

P.S.: You know how this works, right? Here's the list:
-PCB Factory, Component Assemblyline, AAL, Transcendent Plasma Mixer, EOH, QFT
-Multi-Amp wireless hatches
-Sub 1-tick OC, Batch Mode, inbuilt Void Protection on multis
-Level Maintainer, Stocking Hatches, Crafting Input Buses

P.P.S.: Chaotic capacitor bank? What's that?[/note]

display:10.Name:8: Obtain this item to get your trophy

betterquesting:10.desc:8:
To actually produce some light for photolithography, you'll need to accelerate your electrons in a Synchrotron. Like with the LINAC, providing it with coolant is necessary to keep it running.

You can increase the energy of the produced photons by increasing EU/t, or increasing the tier of all four Antenna Casings inside.

To improve focus, you can use a better coolant, and the output amount increases with both EU/t and antennae tier.

Yes, you need all four energy hatches.

As additional rings are placed closer to the star at the center of the Forge, the gravitational stress drastically increases on the structure. Graviton shards alleviate these stresses while also creating localized spacetime bridges to link the two rings and their modules' respective upgrades.

[note]Adding a second ring to your Godforge allows for 4 additional modules, as well as allowing you to pick a second path in the split paths part of the upgrade tree.[/note]

[note]Usage of a second ring requires the CD upgrade.[/note]
betterquesting:10.name:8: §c§l§nA Second Ring has Hit the Godforge

betterquesting:10.desc:8: A great source of nickel, and a horrible source of auditory stimulation. Nickelback leaves will 4x your nickel ore.

The final, and by far most expensive tier of Borosilicate glass is Universium.

Enjoy the bonus for gathering 32 ;)

The name §oAmericium§r is similar to §oEuropium§r; both are named after the continents where they were discovered. The USA smashed particles together to initiate proper controlled fusion reactions that allow us to continue this immense powergen chain. This is Americium Plasma, remember that!

This is actually the plasma that is probably the best choice for XL Plasma Turbines as a 1-recipe powergen setup. However, compared to Helium and Tin Plasma's previous state, it loses out a lot on speed on a mk3 compact, because it doesn't have the 192x/128x parallels, not to mention its recipe time is already 8x as long as Tin for the same amount of plasma.

It will also demand huge amount of Pu-241 for a UEV/UIV base to be sustained, but this fusion chain greatly reduces the amount needed, even if both inputs actually need Pu-241.

This step takes more than half the time of the final step, so it's one of the major bottlenecks: if you upgrade the final step to a compact, you would need 37 mk3 reactors to match speed here.
No, they won't produce Bonsai scale apples as well.

The HV Field Generator isn't used frequently, but it does have something to offer for those who prefer upgraded Super Chests or Super Tanks. It can also be used to make the Grandmaster Magic Energy Absorber if you're deep enough into Thaumcraft.

[note]Don't forget to look closely at NEI when choosing your recipe.[/note]

The speed at which a crop grows is based on its Nutrient Score. There are a number of different ways to obtain Nutrient Points for your crops, but to keep your crops from getting sick try to make sure they are always receiving at least a couple of the below bonuses:

§l- +10 Points§r can be gained from having water in your crop sticks (scales 1-10 based on hydration level).
§l- +10 Points§r can be gained from having fertilizer in your crop sticks (scales 1-10 based on fertilizer level).
§l- +2 Points§r can be gained from allowing the crop to see the sky.
       - Crops in the Industrial Farm will always have this bonus.
§l- +28 Points§r can be gained from preferred biome tags
       - [warn]If no preferred tags are found[/warn], high humidity will §rgive up to §l+14 Points.§r 
       - See more on this in the Environmental Preferences quest.

All crops have a base Nutrient Score of 5.

You can check the Nutrient Score of a crop by using a Portable Scanner on any crop sticks or Industrial Farm controller, even if it's empty.

Crop tier determines the Nutrient Score requirements for growth. 
The following cutoffs apply:

§lTier 4 §r- Last tier where crops can be planted anywhere

§lTier 5 §r- Last tier where crops can be planted anywhere as long as they can see the sky

§lTier 11 §r- Last tier where crop can be anywhere as long as crops are in an 80%+ humidity biome

§lTier 12 §r- Last tier where crops can be anywhere as long as crops are in a 80%+ humidity biome and can see the sky

After many hours of grind, blood, sweat, tears, and a little bit of transcendent metal...
You are now finally able to solve mankind's hardest puzzle ever: clicking boxes randomly.

The §cUncertainty Resolution§r, §oa Dyson user's wet dream§r, will allow you to completely skip that annoying puzzle when you need to set some (probably many) Quantum Computers up.
betterquesting:10.name:8: §9§l§nThe Cat is Out of the Box

betterquesting:10.desc:8:
Upon reaching the land of IV machinery, you can put together even more multis and speed up your automation!

Many of the multiblocks from IV tier onwards use special alloys, which either need to be cooked like any ingots you've used before (in a Furnace or EBF), but there are also alloys which have to be made in the Alloy Blast Smelter (ABS), as a fluid, which then needs to be solidified.

The multis that need ABS alloys are further down. To unlock their quests, you will first need to craft the ABS itself. However, there is a large assortment of machines you can craft without it, just by having the respective IV singleblock equivalent and some other resources.

Those will be here... but you might be able to find some more, if you look closely through NEI. Good luck!

The Beam Splitter allows you to sort your particle beams. The LHC produces output particles randomly, and this machine allows you to sort them into different lanes using the Filtered Beamline Output Hatch. It also divides the Amount of any particle packet by the number of valid output spots.

[note]For example, if you set one output to protons and two outputs to electrons, then a mixed input beam (with all particles having an Amount of 100) will be sorted into 3 beams - one of protons (Amount 100) and two of electrons (each Amount 50).[/note]
Easy dark oak wood!

The second half of this process is a bit unusual: first, we have to melt the raw dust in an EBF with some molten Magnesia to get molten Unformed Fluorophlogopite. Then, we find that a fluid solidifier isn't good enough, so we need to use our Vacuum Freezer to solidify the molten material in a plate mold.

You can simply use your new HV Bender to bend the plates into a foil, and there we have it! No more scouring the planet for rare Mica veins every time you want to make more coils!

Primitive Components are no longer strong enough to make the parts needed for a better EoH. Time for an upgrade!

By incorporating White Dwarf Matter into their structure, Reinforced Components can maintain their shape beneath far stronger spacetime compression fields.

The §5L§raminated §5A§rpplication and §5T§rhermal §5E§rnclosure e§5X§rocoater (§5L.A.T.E.X.§r) is a multiblock dedicated to coating cables.

You will be making a LOT of cables during your playthrough... Why bog down your assembler when you can use the LATEX instead? The LATEX gives §2§l2x§r the speed with a §3§l15%§r EU discount, and generously offers §6§l8§r parallels per voltage tier.

If that's not convincing enough, you also get an additive §2§l6.25%§r rubber discount per Item Pipe Casing tier.

[note]Once you eventually reach UV, you will be able to create an Elastic Singularity for additional perks![/note]
This extremely powerful magical combination augment will grant you increased speed, jump boost, and built-in step assist - normally only accessible in IV. A must-have for any aspiring technomancer.

The §5§lSentient Overclocker§r (SO) module is the sixth module of the §nExo-Foundry§r, and the only one unlocked in §c§lUMV§r.

The SO module, as you might imagine, increases the overclock factor of the Foundry by §20.35§r. This means that for every overclock provided to this machine, it will give a §235%§r speed boost. 

For example, if your Foundry has 1 overclock it should run at §32x§r base speed. However with this module it would instead run at §22.35x§r base speed (235%). This then compounds if another overclock is added, so instead of running at §32x§r the speed of the first overclock, it will run again at §22.35x§r the speed of the first overclock, bringing it to a total of §25.52x§r speed (552%).

Additionally, this module can pair with the §5Proto-Volt Stabilizer§r (PVS) module to unlock "§6Harmonic Efficiency§r" giving the Foundry a §c50%§r EU discount and an additional §20.1§r overclock factor (2.45x§r instead of 2.35x).

[warn]Only one of these modules may be installed per Foundry.[/warn]

The §5§lMiniature Wormhole Generator§r uses Quantum Entangled Singularities to transmit power over any distance, including across dimensions.

To use it, you must link two generators together using AE2 Entangled Singularities by placing one in each controller. Once linked, both wormholes must be started by placing a full (non-entangled) AE2 Singularity into an input bus on each machine. The wormhole will continue running as long as power is being transferred between them. If power transfer stops, the link will shut down and must be restarted using another Singularity on both ends.

Power is transferred through Laser Source Hatches and Laser Target Hatches. Each wormhole can support up to 4 laser hatches. These must be placed in the center block of one of the side faces, excluding the controller side. Hatch pairs link based on relative position between the two wormholes, not cardinal direction. For example, a Source Hatch placed on the top of the sending side must connect to a Target Hatch placed on the bottom of the receiving wormhole.

Additionally, unlike AE2 P2P tunnels, this does not come with a 5% power loss but rather a much more manageable 0.5% loss. 

[note]The glass and input hatch must be tiered accordingly with the tier of the laser hatches. But remember, there is no amperage limit on this machine, so use whatever makes it cheapest for you.[/note]

You need Atto Power ICs for Dyson, UMV -> UXV transformers, UIV Energy/Dynamo Hatches, and Pico Circuits.

[note]You'll need a UIV Cutting Mac- Wait what?[/note]

From now on, your Cutting Machine is not going to cut it, §l§oliterally. §rThose giant sawblades cannot cut up wafers this complex.

Using your HILE is the next best thing, however you seem to burn most of the biological parts off of the wafer, causing you to gain less chips.

[note]Perhaps we could focus these lasers with a new powerful lens.[/note]
No Description

This bee lets you produce molten Infinity in the DTPF!

[note]Faster than an Infiniti drives on the road![/note]

Ever wanted to order 10 million billion billion chests and noticed that your crafting storage was just not big enough?

Well, here is your solution, provided to you by the good folks over at GTNHCorp (Name Pending).

The §cSingularity Crafting Storage§r has a storage of 9,223,372,036,854,775,807 Bytes, which, if you can't read numbers, is a lot.

Enjoy crafting one :) You'll need to kill some Chaos Guardians for it.

So you choose the quick two step processing option?

Great choice.

To get started you will need to create a Titanium tier Chemical Plant with §nat least HV tier machine casings.§r It can be HV tier casings as two HV tier energy hatches will overclock the multiblock to EV.

Once completed, place in your Borax Dust. Then in the second step feed in your Thorium Dust with some Distilled Water.

Then you have your Thorium 232 Dust, nice and easy.

Weeds are a constant threat, whether in large automated fields or small crossbreeding plots.

Let's deal with them.

The Crop Breeder is a single-block machine that allows you to breed new crops deterministically. It will consume the parent seeds, some §2Enriched Fertilizer§r and a catalyst item for material-based crops.
