The stats of an offspring created by the breeder will always be the rounded down average of seeds that were consumed to create it. [note]Breeding two or more maxed-out crops will always give a maxed-out offspring.[/note]

The §2Enriched Fertilizer§r cost is 144L per tier of the offspring crop + 72L for each stat point on the new seed. So a 31/31/31 tier 5 offspring would cost roughly 7.4KL to breed.

Some crops require a minimum machine tier to be bred:
- Iridine, Osmianth and Stargatium are all §5IV§r recipes
- Titania is §5EV§r
- Bauxia is §5MV§r
- An §5HV§r machine is required to breed 31/31/31

[note]Success chance starts at 40% and increases by 10% for every tier past §5LV§r, meaning that at §5ZPM§r, it's guaranteed. A failed breed will void the parent seeds used.[/note]

As a final note: when two crops share breeding requirements (ie Tearstalks and Evil Ore), be careful to insert the seeds in the proper order as to not trigger the mutation with fewer parents.

§r§oYou only need one of the machines for this quest.
No Description
Easy jungle wood!

Infernal bees are mundane: you get them from hives, and they have no ancestors.

Infernal hives are in The Nether, surrounded by nether quartz. Avoid large nether quartz blobs in ore chunks. Instead, look for little pockets of nether quartz. Any ghast-infested, open area will show a few dabs of them. Alternately, if you're tunneling around, you'll inevitably bump into some of these small pockets.

Zombie pigmen will get mad if they spot you nibbling on their quartz, so consider just breaking away the netherrack around the quartz to see that it's a solid cluster that could surround a hive. If so, you are just one or two mining hammer swings away from a likely infernal hive.

There's another way to get these hives: §obuy them with coins! Ka-ching!
§o§r
Their molten combs are nice for a mundane bee. They centrifuge down to refractory wax, which can be used for fireproof wood and refractory capsules.

[warn]Infernal bees have an aggressive trait, so they'll damage entities--namely, you--when you are within their territory. You want an apiarist's suit before you start working with them. Alternately, if you set them up in an isolated spot, you can just run real fast. This isn't sustainable for all types of aggressive bees, by the way.[/warn]

[note]Breeder's Notes: You can run these bees in the Overworld if you can find a hot/arid climate. When in doubt, place an apiary and look at what it claims the climate is in the upper right of its GUI. Even if the bee isn't jubilant, but you can get drones out of them for breeding. Then you don't have to run back and forth to The Nether to run a cycle with a fussy queen while cross-breeding.

Use nether wart to keep them happy, and don't forget some soul sand!

They don't cross breed with other mundane bees into stuff like Common and Cultivated bees, so you can convert another mundane princess to an Infernal princess if you have the drones. Just take some care with this. For example, if you try this with an Arctic princess, you could wind up with an Infernal princess that needs a scorching/arid climate, but also needs snow to pollinate.[/note]

Netherite Scrap is an integral part of the Netherite refinement process and fortunately you don't need very much of it. Technically you §nonly need two§r pieces of scrap, as they will constantly cycle from hot to cool while never actually being used up in the process §3(though, having more scrap handy could improve your setup efficiency).§r

You can obtain Netherite Scrap by either §5smelting§r Ancient Debris or using a §5§lForge Hammer§r on it. Though considering the forge hammer offers a §2§l25%§r chance at gaining an additional scrap, you would be a little crazy to choose the former.

If you're wondering where you can find Ancient Debris, try scouring the Nether. It's more likely to spawn lower near the lava, and is found sporadically like small ores are rather than being in large veins like usual GT ores. §3Miners can also collect it!§r

[warn]If you don't feel like leaving home, or are lacking blocks within your nether dimension, there is also a §lmeteor§r that can alleviate your Ancient Debris woes.[/warn]

Welcome to the BEC Line! It's recommended you read the wiki for full context on these machines: [url]https://wiki.gtnewhorizons.com/wiki/Bose-Einstein_Condensate_Line[/url]

Until now, manufacturing has been a matter of imposing order upon matter: heat it, compress it, shape it, and force its atoms into the arrangement you require. But the materials ahead of you have become too complex for such crude methods. No amount of mechanical precision can control every particle individually.

At temperatures approaching absolute zero, another possibility emerges. As a cloud of bosons loses its thermal motion, the quantum waves describing its particles spread and begin to overlap. Enough of them eventually occupy the same low energy state that the cloud ceases to behave like a collection of independent particles. Instead, it acts as a single coherent quantum system: a Bose-Einstein condensate.

The first step is using the §5§lEntanglement Apparatus§r to convert ordinary fluids into entangled condensate by brute-forcing this delicate state on an industrial scale. It cannot overclock; instead, it expands the experiment across unlimited parallels, processing as much material as the supplied power can sustain. Multi-amp and laser energy hatches will be necessary if you intend to feed the rest of the BEC Line at any meaningful rate.

Different fluids may be entangled simultaneously, although the entire batch runs for the duration of the slowest active conversion.

[note]Insert ordinary fluids through the input hatch at the front. Entangled condensate leaves through the BEC Hatch at the rear and is pushed into the connected Containment Field network.[/note]

[note]The Apparatus does not check whether sufficient storage is available before processing. Use a BEC Detector Hatch to disable it before your Containment Fields overflow and begin voiding condensate.[/note]

Once you get your first Hypogen from Fusion, you can easily duplicate it in your DTPF.

It is a loop, though, so be cautious.

betterquesting:10.name:8: Trigger: Electric Boots of the Traveller Skip

betterquesting:10.desc:8:
The portable equivalent of the Iron Barrel.

Has §n54§r slots.

[note]Can be dyed![/note]
They have limited durability. So either put them on a pedestal to avoid durability loss, or use a thaumic restorer.

I promise you won't be dissapointed, so try some coffee. Yes, more than one at a time.

[warn]Just, don't drink too much[/warn]

Don't want to spend your Salis Mundus on Litmus Paper anymore? This device can significantly reduce your Litmus Paper usage!

While holding this item, you gain a HUD Icon on the top left of your screen, which tells you how much warp you have. It does not tell you the exact warp values, but it helps you estimate it.

Here's how to read it:
Your §5§lPermanent Warp§r is displayed as a dark purple bar
Your §5Normal Warp§r is displayed as a light purple bar
Your §dTemporary Warp§r is displayed as a pink bar

The bar is full at 100 total warp.

A well organized storage system is crucial for a logistics system.

With the ability to use modules through a chassis, we can now prepare for storage modules.

Logistics Pipes uses ItemSink modules to assign storage spaces.

This ItemSink modules can be used in 2 ways:

1. Assign the storage of a connected inventory with at most 9 different kinds of items by setting 9 items as filter on the module.

2. Assign a connected inventory as a default route. The default route is a destination for items that have no other valid storage spaces.

§cNote: remember to always check if the default route has additional spaces because items that are stuck in the pipes without a destination will eventually YEET themselves out of the pipes.

In order to obtain more exotic particles than simple protons, neutrons, and electrons, you will need the Large Hadron Collider. You can use any charged particle as input, sourced from any other beam-like multiblock such as the Source Chamber.

The LHC's four modules can each produce a different set of particles. For a specific particle to start appearing in the outputs, the §bCollision Energy§r must be greater than the particle's §dRest Mass§r, shown on its tooltip in NEI.

The LHC has two modes: §lAccelerator§r and §lCollider§r. 

First, in §lAccelerator§r mode, it accelerates the input beam to a higher energy. It does this in 1-second cycles, with the beam energy increasing once per cycle by a fixed amount based on how much EU is consumed that cycle. The power draw increases quadratically as the §9Number of Completed Cycles§r increases, and linearly if the §cAmount§r increases. 

You can set a target §6Beam Energy§r and a maximum §9Number of Cycles§r in the UI. If your beam reaches the target §6Beam Energy§r before reaching the maximum cycle count, further completed cycles will repeatedly multiply the beam's current §cAmount§r by 1.1, which also increases your power draw. Once the maximum §9Number of Cycles§r is reached, the LHC automatically switches to §lCollider§r mode.


In §lCollider§r mode, the beam is collided with itself to generate all kinds of particles. Each LHC Module is able to detect and capture a certain subset of particles, depending on which Fundamental Force the particle can interact with. This also means some particles appear in multiple modules. You can blacklist particles from appearing by using the Filtered Beamline Output Hatch.

§l[note]§lThe §b§lCollision Energy§r §lis §l2x§l§  the accelerated §6§lBeam Energy§r.[/note]

[quest]Equal Distribution, Fake Crafting, Locking, and Advanced Blocking Cards![/quest]

§6Equal Distribution Card:§r

The Equal Distribution Card will evenly divide a cell's capacity between types or partitions.

§6Fake Crafting Card:§r 

The Fake Crafting Card will tell your ME System to complete a craft without expecting the final resulting item. 

This can be handy for creating fake patterns for entire multiblocks or setups by collecting the individual items needed in one craft.

The card can only be inserted into:

§cME Dual Interface
ME Interface
P2P Tunnel - ME Dual Interface§r 

§6Locking Card:§r 

The Locking Card allows an interface to optionally block new crafts from being started for one of the following conditions:

§cWhile Redstone is low
While Redstone is high
After a craft has been pushed, until a redstone pulse is received
After a craft has been pushed, until the results have returned to the same network§r

§6Advanced Blocking Card:§r

The Advanced Blocking Card is able to ignore non-consumables in a subnet for more complicated automations. 

In a standard subnet, where two interfaces are facing each other, the Advanced Blocking Card is to be §9placed on the §lsubnet interface.§f

Here is another one requiring ingredients you'll want to passively generate. The Sequencer needs one (1) Fluorescent Dye per gene it sequences. Each one is made from one of each tossed into a Mixer:

* redstone
* glowstone
* orange dye
* yellow dye
* molten blaze (from blaze powder)

Given how many bees you'll end up sequencing to get all the key genes you want, expect to need at least some hundreds or even thousands of these. Yes, there are only so many actual genes, but you're going to be hitting duplicates.

By making a scythe you are now able to clear 3x3 blocks of vegetation, and to harvest 5x5 tiles of crops! The harvesting ability works on most non-magical crops, including crops on cropsticks!

§6The quest should accept the tool whatever materials you used.

To turn your mechanical exoskeleton from a hunk of useless metal into a power suit, you'll need a core and a frame.

The basic energy core will allow your armor to charge at HV voltage and equip tier 1 augments.

The first three frames all give 3 augment slots spread among the categories. Choose based on what augments you need to equip!

betterquesting:10.name:8: Trigger: Boots of the Traveller Skip

betterquesting:10.desc:8:
Ender Fluid Conduits are an advanced fluid transport system available at HV tier. They have many useful abilities, such as filtering specific fluids and routing them by color channel.

Their main advantage is the ability to create a large unified fluid network, which makes complex setups much easier to manage. As you use them, you’ll quickly see how convenient they are at this stage of the game.

[note]However, be careful: large conduit networks with too many nodes can cause TPS lag. Use them wisely, avoid overbuilding, and consider switching to AE2-based fluid handling for large-scale systems.[/note]

This plasma needs Helium Plasma to be crafted. That's right, this entire powergen chain builds on top of Helium Plasma!

The Boron Plasma step is much slower than the Helium one, so if you match the number of reactors and their tier, you will end up with a large excess of Helium Plasma. As you know, it's very useful for power in Large Plasma Turbines, so you could use this excess to power all the other reactors. As you scale up, however, this alone will probably not be enough.

You will need 3.75 reactors with this recipe to feed 1 reactor with the next step.
No Description

No matter how much of a crack shot you become it doesn't help when your twitchy fingers shoot your crossbow before your eyes can notice the tell-tale red lines on one particular type of spider's body. Usually incredible amounts of pain follow...

With your new wand you are able to craft Red Heart Canisters. A total of ten of them can be put in their own dedicated inventory slot, increasing your maximum health by one heart per.

It might not be enough, but if it ends up making the difference between standing upright and standing horizontally in a box, you'll be thankful you made these things.

During your travels, you've heard about a forest filled to the brim with magic. In that forest, there is a rumor about an interesting little fellow who can trade magical artifacts, including infused shards! Supposedly, they scour the world for gems and gold, but are cold to wanderers who have no valuables to their name.

You wonder if you can find this merchant and obtain their wares. If only there was a tool that could help find this... §5§o"Magical Forest"§r.

[note]Note: This quest accepts meeting any type of Pech, not just Pech Foragers.[/note]

Stabilizing the neutron star of the Godforge was successful, but now you need something new to extract the power out of it into something usable. Your experiments lead you to using the newly discovered Mellion with a Transcendent Metal Nanite to create what seems like a crystal seed of some type, which exhibits perfect thermal conductance.

Processing this seed further into a solution, you realize you can grow this crystal into a slurry-like solution, which you decide to name [note]Phonon Transfer Medium[/note]. This incredible material displays exactly the properties you were looking for, and decide that now you can move forward with the second module of the Godforge.

Finally, you are ready to assemble these new circuits. This is a UV-tier circuit.

[note]It's highly recommended that you invest in a NAC before starting with Optical Circuits[/note]
A planar gateway from Thaumic Horizons lets you travel to a pocket dimension. Setting up multiple gateways (up to 4) to the pocket dimension even allows for travel to other dimensions!

The modern offhand slot has been backported.

This feature also works with any item that opens a GUI, like a backpack for example. This makes inventory management easier and helps with certain tedious tasks.

Default Keybind to swap between mainhand and offhand: §9F§r

[note]You can also toggle various Torch Tweaks in Backhand's mod client configs. They are disabled by default, but you may find them useful if you love holding torches in your offhand.[/note]

With total mastery of the Forge of the Gods achieved, it is possible to begin a new universe-spanning initiative. It is now possible to quantize and extract graviton shards for use outside the Forge in powerful new technological endeavors; produce the most exotic plasmas beyond merely periodic elements; and most importantly, begin to understand the immense power of magmatter, a form of matter made entirely of magnetic monopoles with density and stability billions of times that of conventional bosonic matter. It is with this development you realize that the completion of the Forge was not the end goal, but merely a stepping stone to universal transcendence.

[note]Required for UXV components, Magmatter is the second material the Heliofusion Exoticizer can create, and will require a second module. Read the Godforge Information in the UI for more information on how to automate this.[/note]

[note]The creation of Magmatter requires the EE upgrade.[/note]

[note]Congrats! You can now move on to the UXV tier![/note]

With Briar starting to consume you might also want to increase your sugar production.

Sweeds are planted on grass, not farmland, and will spread to propagate themselves. Once fully matured they can be harvested for sugar as well as sugar cane.

Should you require a formidable former, for formatively forming formal forms, you'll want to create an §5§lIndustrial Forming Press§r. It grants §2§l6x§r the speed and §6§l6§r parallels per voltage tier compared to the singleblock.
betterquesting:10.name:8: §8§lThe Form of the Former Former: Reformed

betterquesting:10.desc:8:
Now that you've unlocked the BHC & started Creon / Mellion production you can finally upgrade your §nExo-Foundry§r!

These §6§lEternal Magnetic Chassis§r will allow your Foundry to have a maximum of three modules.

[note]Check out the Wiki if you need ideas on which modules to choose [url]https://wiki.gtnewhorizons.com/wiki/Exo-Foundry[/url][/note]

Lots and lots of food crops. While they may be less useful than other species you can grow, when compared to basic food crops the ability to stat these guys should make them pretty nice no matter the reason you need them.
Has 64 parallels and consumes ~30b EU/t per module, expensive to run but absolutely worth it.
I mean, it's technically a grass, but close enough.
It's a shame to kill something so adorable... oh well, do it anyway.

At last... salvation from the egregious EoH hatch input limitations!

This will reduce the waiting time between cycles to a fraction of what it was before.
The final multi-amp hatches for IV, 64A!

As soon as you've got some endstone to grow it above, Enderblooms can be a great source for passive Nitrogen.

[note]If you're wondering how to get this crop through deterministic mutations, (as End Stone Lily also requires Enderbloom to breed deterministically) consider taking a look at the End Stone Lily quest for a quick primer on quasi-deterministic breeding through random pools.[/note]

The Trinium bee allows you to obtain Trinium.

[note]There is no planet named Trinium, but this bee still provides a very useful ZPM material.[/note]
While being significantly more expensive than a gold chest, the steel chest has less capacity but it can be used in some specialized crafting recipes.

The Synthetic Elven Gateway is an advanced and easily automatable version of the normal Elven Gateway. As a result it is much quicker, less TPS intensive, and AE2 compatible.

Much like the Mana Fountain, the controller can be given mana via a mana spreader or spark & item input can happen from any face, while item output is restricted to the bottom.

[note]While running, this uses more mana passively than a normal Elven Gateway does, so be sure you have adequate mana production![/note]

EFR adds with it vanilla Barrels (not to be confused with JABBA barrels). These are essentially like chests, but they can be placed next to each other and opened with a block above them. And you can upgrade them! Great for those compact machine setups.

As your factory grows, you will need to use your tools to build, configure, and dismantle machines. Crafting a toolbox to hold your tools will help.

The Field Engineer's Toolbox allows you to use a tool inside for building and configuring without taking the tool out of the box. Right click to open the toolbox and put tools in. Then, press the Pick Block bind (default: middle mouse button) to open a radial menu and select a tool. You can then use the toolbox as if it was that type of tool. Pressing Pick Block while looking at a block will also choose an appropriate tool for the job, skipping the radial menu. Sneak and press Pick Block to deselect a tool quickly.

Later on, you can upgrade the toolbox with a battery. This allows the toolbox to recharge electric tools and unlocks the ability for machines and wireless chargers to charge the entire toolbox.

Toolboxes can also fix maintenance hatches, using the tools inside. Deselect the equipped tool (if any), then right click the maintenance hatch with the toolbox. All of the tools inside will be applied to the maintenance hatch, fixing any problems it might have.

The toolbox requires polyethylene, which is a fluid you likely haven't made before. It's up to you to figure out how to get it. Here's a hint: the black gushers of oil found around the world may be the key...

[note]Math for the curious:

To clear up what exactly happens in the background, here's an explanation on how the extra catalyst values are calculated using an example:

The example recipe of choice is the molten neutronium recipe using prosaic catalyst, running at 64A UMV (8,589,934,592 EU/t).
The recipe uses 14,753L of Prosaic catalyst and 36,484,545,600 EU per recipe without OCs or the catalyst discount. With the discount, the catalyst amount gets cut in half, meaning 7,376.5L of catalyst, which are rounded to 7,376L, and due to the 64A UMV the machine is supplied with the recipe overclocks 3 times, meaning each recipe actually uses 36,484,545,600 * 2^3 = 291,876,364,800 EU.

Knowing the amount of OCs and the base voltage of the recipe, the difference of the needed EU per recipe with and without perfect OC can be calculated, that being 291,876,364,800 - 36,484,545,600 = 255,391,819,200 extra EU due to imperfect OCs.
To get the value of needed extra catalyst, this extra EU value has to be divided by the energy density of the relevant catalyst, prosaic in this case.

The division equates to 255,391,819,200 EU / 66,768,460 EU/L = 3,825.037 L, rounded to 3,825L extra prosaic catalyst per recipe. For the final step, this value has to be multiplied by 0.5 as it's affected by the discount, meaning the total extra catalyst that gets added to the recipe is 3,825L * 0.5 = 1,912.5 L, rounded to 1,912L.

To summarize it all in a formula:
Amount extra catalyst per recipe = (B * ((2^x) - 1))/2L
where:
B is base total EU of the recipe
x is the number of overclocks
L is the EU/L of the relevant catalyst [/note]

This is the advanced assembly line from §6GigaGram§rFab.

It supports item pipelining. That is, it will mimic a real assembly line by consuming ingredients one by one instead of all at start. In effect, it offers a parallelism up to however many item inputs this recipe requires. You can think of an advanced assembly line as a collection of slices which are capable of processing each step independently from other slices. It will start processing once the input bus contents align with any stored data stick. The first slice will consume the input in Bus #1. After (recipe time/number of inputs) time, the first slice's work is concluded and will start the second slice. At the same time, first slice will look for input in input bus #1. If there are still enough input there slice #1 will start working again.

The terminal slice (the n-th slice, where n is number of item input in recipe) will put the recipe output in output bus when it has concluded its work. Whenever a non-terminal slice finished its work, it will try to pass the work onto next slice. If the next slice cannot find the materials in its input bus, the just-finished slice will remain in [warn]STUCK[/warn] state and hang the assembly line. To help locate these [warn]STUCK[/warn] assembly lines, the controller's front face will have its status light turned orange.

The EU/t cost of this machine is number of slices active multiplied by the original recipe EU/t. [warn]STUCK[/warn] slices do not consume power. It will use the worst energy supplying hatch's input voltage for recipe tier calculation and normal 2/4 OC. With exotic energy hatches, it can overclock beyond usual voltage tier, but will consume even more power than usual 2/4 OC. Every §2laser overclock§r will add 0.3 to the power exponent. 1 §2laser overclock§r will have 50% recipe time and use 430% power. 2 §2laser overclocks§r will have 25% recipe time and use 1978% power. Machine first tries to parallelize, then normal 2/4 OC, then §2laser overclock§r.

In GTNH, the lootbags are quite useful tools for boosting your resources. There are a wide variety of lootbag types, and those types all have upgrade paths to get better resources.

There are two paths you can take when it comes to upgrading your lootbags, you can either enchant it with fortune, or you can upgrade the bag itself. Enchanting the lootbag with fortune will increase the chances of more rare drops being given to you on opening, while upgrading the bag itself will change the item pool to that of the upgraded bag. Notably, if you uptier the bag itself, it will cost 3 of the previous bag tier, so make sure it's worthwhile to upgrade before you do so!

§2If you're looking to maximize your advantage it's recommended you both uptier your lootbag AND apply the fortune upgrade. 
§r
[note]Be sure to use NEI to see all of this information. Use 'U' on your lootbag and you will be able to see the potential drops, the drop chances based on fortune levels, and you will be able to see recipes for uptiering the bag.[/note]

You still need MORE recipe slots for the crafting modules?

Here is the final tier of chassis: Chassis Mk5. Instead of incrementing the number of modules it can hold by 1 compared to the last tier, it straight up doubles the slots. Hopefully you think it is worth it.

The §5Universal Collapser§r (UC) module is the final module unlock for the §nExo-Foundry§r.

The UC module quadruples power consumption and processing speed, allows §9§lUIV+§r recipe processing, and increases the minimum number of casings by 15, leaving space for only 10 inputs (without an SCB module installed). Only one UC module can be installed per Foundry.

This becomes much more powerful if paired with the §5Hypercooler§r (HC) module to achieve "§6Realized Potential§r", allowing Eternity to be used as a coolant. Using Eternity as a coolant grants an additional §23§r overclocks. The pairing also doubles both power consumption and processing speed.

Precipitate samarium ions with oxalic acid. Samarium oxalate is then washed with hydrochloric acid; you get Impure Samarium Chloride as a result. This Samarium chloride dust is the base material for the extraction of samarium.

Propagating your plants is as easy as placing a double crop-stick adjacent to a mature plant and waiting. 

As long as there are no other plants adjacent to the double cropstick, your plant should simply grow into it.

[note]Just like crossbreeding, spreading also applies the usual stat variation to new offsprings. This can be especially useful when statting up crops.[/note]

Multiblock machines enforce input separation based on hatch color. Inputs from Input Buses and Input Hatches will only interact if they share the same color. Un-dyed inputs act as wildcards compatible with any color.

Color can be applied using a Spray Can and removed with a Spray Can Solvent. An Infinite Spray Can becomes available later in progression.

[note]There are a few other items which paint inputs. Check out [quest]Making Sense of Spaghetti[/quest] in the §lBuilding Better Bases§l§r tab for a complete list.[/note]

[note]For more advanced users, note that the priority of dyed hatches is ordered exactly how the vanilla dyes are in NEI, from highest (black) to lowest (white).[/note]

It will also allow the Vending Machine access to coins in your AE network. When purchasing, it will prioritize using the coins in the wallet first, but then it will pull from AE. Some easy tin for your steam age machines.

You're starting to get tired of having to build everything like some kind of fortress just to make sure no unwanted guests come in. Sure, that's just the nature of living in a world where infinite hoards of restless undead haunt every other dark corner, but is having a secure entryway that isn't conveniently door-shaped too much to ask?

Not anymore. Paving Stone of Warding, assuming nothing sits on top of it, will project a two block tall invisible force-field above itself that block non-player mobs from passing through, at least the common riff-raff. As a bonus spiders cannot climb the force-field, so no need for overhangs to keep them out too.

That said, since the force-field cannot tell an arrow fired by you from one fired §oat you§r, mundane objects will still pass through regardless. And the force-field does as much to block line of sight as the term §oinvisible§r would suggest.

Of course, you're not concerned about that part. Being able to shoot things with your crossbow while they can't reach you is very much in §oyour§r favor, all told.

You've mastered antimatter production, but raw antimatter alone won't run your machines. To turn that potential into unparalleled power, it's time to [warn]harness the chaos[/warn] itself!

[quest]Introducing the Shielded Lagrangian Annihilation Matrix![/quest]

The SLAM creates raw energy by reacting the Semi-Stable Antimatter with normal matter in a controlled environment.

Every cycle, the generator will react all antimatter and matter in hatches instantly, converting it all into energy directly. The EU output is based on the equal amounts of antimatter and matter annihilated. Therefore, imbalance between the amounts will waste your precious energy.

Depending on the matter used to annihilate, the antimatter amount gets an exponent applied to it, directly increasing the amount of energy produced from 1L of antimatter - this means the more you annihilate in one go, the more efficient it is!

The maximum EU for a cycle is limited by the capacity of all laser source hatches on the structure (limited to 64), even on wireless mode.

[note]It can't output more than 9.22e18 EU in a cycle, or just below 43 16M UXV Laser Sources (If you're crazy enough for it)[/note]

The Formula and the exponents for each of the possible matters are:

Generated EU = (§3Antimatter§r^§6exponent§r) * 1,000,000,000,000

Molten Copper - §61.00§r
Molten Superconductor Base UIV - §61.02§r
Molten Superconductor Base UMV - §61.03§r

Logistics Pipes have automation capability in place, but first, it needs to know what inventory that items inside can be used for requests.

The Provider module does this job nicely. When you open the interface of the module, there is a 3*3 grid. You can pick what items that the module can provide, or you can leave it empty as "everything in the inventory can be provided for requests".
Allows for parallelization of a single interface, you don't have to copy patterns for multiple interfaces anymore.

In LuV, you can make the Industrial Autoclave. This is a huge multiblock with many scaling factors - it is also extremely powerful. You'll definitely want to pick one of these up to process crystal chips quickly for the crystal circuit line.

[note]Coils, pipe casings, and item pipe casings are all extremely important to this multi's scaling. Use the best ones you have![/note]
Another tier, another energy hatch. You can use these to overclock your assembly lines to UIV voltage and speed them up.
The Apprentice Striders are good, but as the name implies, you can do better...

The Torchberry! 
Does it make sense? 
Not at all! 

Is it helpful? 
Certainly!

Now that you have the bioware mainframe, you have unlocked the first of the stargate trophies!
Yes, there's multiple of them, one for each major iteration of the stargate recipe.
These trophies are just that, trophies, and you can try to craft them if you want to compare the costs to today's stargate standards.
To complete these quests you have to submit two stargates' worth of materials.

§3Now, let me bestow upon you a short history lesson about this point in GT:NHs past.

The year is 2020. The bio mainframe was pretty much the end of GTNH progression at the time, not much above UHV existed or was craftable. This was also the point in the pack where you'd start scaling for stargate, as that too was tiered at UHV. Technically UEV parts were craftable, but their only uses were singleblocks for PAs (which only held up to 16 UEV machines) and the Deep Dark Portal. UEV-UMV energy hatches were craftable, but their recipes were simple hull + wire crafting table recipes
...and that was about it for UHV+ content.
With the recent addition of void miners, the previously thought to be impossible started to seem actually attainable, a set of stargates. Specifically, to §ocraft§3 a set of them, not just find them like others have before.

One group in particular, known as the §aGigaplex§3, gave it their all and actually managed to do it, to prove that crafting stargates is possible with enough determination.

Thus, on the §a16th of February, 2021§3, the first set of crafted stargates had been born.

P.S.: If you want to be as faithful to the challenge as possible, try completing this quest without using any of the modern functionality that didn't exist back then.
Here's a non-exhaustive list of major things that didn't exist (in no particular order):
-PCB Factory, Space Elevator, Component Assemblyline, AAL, PrAss, EEC, EIG, Compact Fusions, MCR, MABS
-Any bee related GT machines
-Any UEV or above multis
-XL Turbines, Naq fuel, LEG
-Sub 1-tick OC, Batch Mode, inbuilt Void Protection on multis
-Level Maintainer, AE Fluid Crafting, Stocking Buses/Hatches, Crafting Input Buses, ME Output Buses/Hatches, non-recursive AE component recipes
-Shift-clicking recipes into AE patterns (pain)
-Early-Midgame QoL such as ghost circuits, visual prospecting, reprogramming circuits with a screwdriver, seeing Assline recipes in NEI before having crafted them, and more

P.P.S: This quest is missing the chaotic capacitors on purpose, because the chaotic core recipe requires spacetime now, but the chaotic capacitor recipe did not change at all since then. All in all the cost for these banks was completely negligible back then and still is today, they only serve as a magic gate for SG.

display:10.Name:8: Obtain this item to get your trophy

betterquesting:10.desc:8:
It's a mirror, it reflects stuff. Should this only work for Photons? 

Maybe. 

[note]But it works for all particles.[/note]

The MKIII is the final upgrade in the Matter Manipulator series, and grants you access to it's most heightened capabilities. With §210x§r the EU storage as the MKII, it also boasts an §5§lunlimited§r block range and can handle placing §21024 Blocks / Second§r.

The MKIII comes with all of the features of the MKII, except now with the ability to also use the §5§lQuantum Uplink§r, though you won't be able to build that multiblock until UV.

 §3§lAdvanced Copy Options:§r

The MKIII unlocks an additional toggle in the §5§lAdvanced Options§r sub-menu:

- §5§lAuto-Proxy CRIBs§r: Replaces Crafting Input Buses in the copied region with Crafting Input Proxies linked back to the original CRIB.

Getting annoyed trying to reach pipes and conduits around your base? Look no further than the §5§lMagLev Harness§r!

With the MagLev, you can have creative flight whenever you are within range of a MagLev Pylon and have the Harness equip.

This will work at half of the range when unpowered, you unlock the full range when it's given §21A§r of it's corresponding tier of power. The MagLev will only draw power while you are in-range, not passively. A Harness can only be tethered to one Pylon at a time, but a Pylon can attach to any number of Harnesses. Will only consume 1A §nregardless§r of how many Harnesses are tethered to the Pylon§r.

The §6MV Pylon§r has a §c16§r block radius (33x33x33 cube centered around the pylon)

The §5HV Pylon§r has a §c32§r block radius (65x65x65 cube centered around the pylon)

The §8EV Pylon§r has a §c48§r block radius (97x97x97 cube centered around the pylon)

Congratulations on your first EBF!

Throughout your GTNH gameplay you will end up creating hundreds of multiblocks, and will very likely run into a multitude of power failures at some point. 

Fortunately, we have a dedicated system for helping you stay informed of exactly when and where these power failures occur §3(though the 'why' portion is up to you to figure out!)§r.

When a multiblock powerfails, you will receive a notification in §5chat§r, in addition to a visible icon on §5screen§r, and an icon visible on your §5map§r. 

§lYou can clear these notifications by§r:
- Clicking into the multiblock that has powerfailed
- Deleting the notification in JourneyMap
- Typing §4/powerfails clear§r

For those playing §2multiplayer§r, anyone who is on your §2team§r will receive the §2same notifications§r. §2§nOne person§r clearing a notification should clear it for§2 §nall players§r.

[note]This feature uses the same team system as wireless EU. Use <§c/gtnhteam invite§r §1[Player Name]§r> to team up.[/note]

All of these features can be turned off in the gregtech config. If you want the on screen icon to disappear use §4§l/powerfails hide§r. For all in-game options use §4§l/powerfails help§r.

In ZPM, you now have the ability to construct very powerful mega machines. These absolute titans will boost your production to levels never-before-seen, at a price.

[note]To get real benefit from these multis, you will want to use lots of power and take advantage of their extreme parallelization.[/note]
No Description

The portable equivalent of the Diamond Barrel, you'll need to either upgrade your wand or take advantage of the Gold to Diamond Shulker Box Upgrade.

Has §n108§r slots.

[note]Can be dyed![/note]
Easy birch wood!
No Description

So how do you actually destroy tainted land?

These Ethereal Blooms will remove Tainted Lands within a small area around themselves, which in turn kills off any Fibrous Tendrils. They cannot cleanse Tainted Nodes, nor will they necessarily return tainted biomes back to what they were before, but they will provide a barrier.

The Shimmerleaf they are made from have a recipe in an LV Assembling Machine if you're having a hard time finding them around Silverwood trees. There is also a CropsNH version of them.

The Sashes from Botania improves your speed passively along with a jump boost and provide Step assist all while fitting in your belt slot, how convenient is that?

You will need a method of powering them with either the mana tablet or the mana mirror linked to a pool.

The Soujourner Sash provides the basic speed boost, jump boost and step assist while the Globetrotter provides double the jump height and speed boost.

The Planestrider is special since it provides a slowly increasing speed boost as long as you are moving. You can even reach up to 11 times the Soujourner Sash speed boost!

[note]You only need to make one Sash to complete the quest.[/note]
The Fox can be found in colder biomes. Make sure you're properly equipped, they're quite quick!
Easy acacia wood!

One such improvement is the Advanced Redcrystal.

It allows you to set a threshold with your wand to define how strong a signal needs to be in order to pass through. This can come in handy when checking fill level of tanks or power storage.

[note]One caveat for redstone experts: The Advanced Redcrystal checks the signal strength in the block it is in, not in the previous block like a comparator would.[/note]

Once you've gathered enough froth, it can run through a §5§lVacuum Furnace§r to get a number of useful resources. Most importantly though, this is where we extract §4Poor Nether Waste§r; a quite valuable fluid to the Netherite line.
The Enceladus bee allows you to obtain resources found on Enceladus, one of Saturn's moons.

A great source of titanium!

Titania leaves will 4x your titanium ores (including Bauxite!).
You need to use this for the higher-tiered Fluid Cells.

The §5Advanced Concrete Backfiller§r has the same general functionality as the regular one except it boasts an impressive §364§r block radius and operates at §24x§r the speed. 

It's a good idea to consider using one of these as your base continues to expand across more area. Filled space saves TPS!

Are you tired of storing Shapes and/or Molds near your Extruders and Solidifiers instead of inside them? Today must be your lucky day, because these item holders let you do exactly that!

They allow your machines to hold a small number of extra items, though each slot can only store one item at a time. There are three versions of this cover, each offering a different amount of storage:

Basic Item Holder: 9 slots
Good Item Holder: 12 slots
Advanced Item Holder: 15 slots

[note]If that's still not enough space and you are already using the highest tier, you can simply attach multiple holders to your machine of choice.[/note]

2 Modules are still not enough? Need more recipe slots for machines?

Here is the Mk3. It can hold 3 modules.
The Saturn bee allows you to obtain resources from Saturn.

The Wand Focus: Flux Scrubber is an incredibly useful focus for the messy or insane thaumaturge. It creates a beam that sucks up flux goo and gas.

[note]This focus accepts the following upgrades in the Focal Manipulator:[/note]
§5Frugal§r: Lowers vis cost to cast by 10% per level
§5Potency§r: Speeds up flux cleanup
§5Crystallization§r: Drops Crystallized Potentia when cleaning up flux at level 1. Drops Crystallized Essence of a random aspect at level 2. Mutually exclusive with §5Warping§r and §5Calming§r
§5Warping§r: Gives its user temporary warp when used to clean flux. Mutually exclusive with §5Crystallization§r
§5Calming§r (level 5, requires §5Warping§r): Negates the effect of §5Warping§r. Removes some temporary or sticky warp when used to clean flux. Mutually exclusive with §5Crystallization§r

The final external structural upgrade to the Forge requires the most advanced understanding of graviton shards and their applications in extreme environments. With this, the last 4 module slots of the Forge of the Gods are available to construct, ascending your operation to unseen heights of technological mastery.

[note]Adding a third and final ring to your Godforge allows for 4 additional modules, as well as allowing you to pick all three paths in the split paths part of the upgrade tree, allowing for a fully upgraded Godforge.[/note]

[note]Usage of a third ring requires the END upgrade.[/note]

Ztones is another mod which adds loads of new building blocks. Each craftable block also has many variants which can be made using a chisel.

§cUnlike many other decorative blocks, Ztones blocks do not prevent mob spawns. Make sure you are spawnproofing your builds when using them!

The §6Perfect§r Spacetime Compression Field Generator allows for up to §lT7§r recipes which produce §l1152L§r of §5Universium§r per successful batch.

The §6Perfect§r Time Dilation Field Generator grants a §298.4375%§r time reduction for any recipe ran in the EoH, but reduces the likelihood of success by §c55.5%§r.

The §6Perfect§r Stabilisation Field Generator will boost the success chance of the EoH by §230%§r, but will decrease the yield by §c30%§r and increase the power cost by §c10%§r.

This multiblock will allow you to use all that UU-Matter that your Matter Fabricator makes, not that you don't have anything else to do with it...

[note]This multi is traditionally UV, but can technically be made in ZPM.[/note]

The Decay Warehouse stores a single type of radioactive isotope and allows it to decay over time. 

The decay speed of the isotope is §adependent§r on its half-life.

Isotopes will decay §9regardless§r of whether the warehouse is on or powered. 

The Warehouse's capacity equals the chest's capacity divided by §c400§r.

Capacity of the multiblock for each chest:

§6Super Chest I:§r §c10,000
§6Super Chest II:§r §c20,000
§6Super Chest III:§r §c40,000
§6Super Chest IV:§r §c80,000
§6Super Chest V:§r §c160,000
§6Quantum Chest I:§r §c320,000
§6Quantum Chest II:§r §c640,000
§6Quantum Chest III:§r §c1,280,000
§6Quantum Chest IV:§r §c2,560,000
§6Quantum Chest V:§r §c5,368,000§r

[note]Right click the controller with a §aScrewdriver§r to dump stored isotopes into an output bus.

Right click the controller with a §aPlunger§r to empty it. [/note]

[warn]The Warehouse's contents are §nvoided§r when the controller is broken[/warn]

At the top of your map screen (J by default) there are multiple tabs, some of them will be very useful and will save you a ton of searching!

GT Oreveins - this tab will keep track of the veins for you, to save a vein to map right-click a naturally generated ore (some tools can't right-click)
GT Underground fluids - this will help you later (MV)
TC Nodes - this tab will keep track of thaumcraft nodes for you (you need to scan them first)

[note]Small Ores are not part of veins and thus do not uncover a vein on the map. However veins generate extra small ores related to the vein in their chunks, so they can still be useful in your search (though not all small ores are related to a nearby vein so don't be fooled).[/note]

[note]Another great interaction is that you can use the NEI search bar in highlight mode (double-click it) and then go to the map screen to get the matching uncovered ore veins highlighted![/note]

Absolute Baryonic Perfection! This multiblock allows you to create water that is pure even on the subatomic level. Not a single quark is out of place in Grade 8 Purified Water. Thanks to this purity, even more advanced processes are possible, starting with reducing the processing time of Optical Boules and increasing yield on Optical Chips.

While the tooltip is certainly a lot less intimidating than the one of the Degasser, automating this process will not be an easy challenge. Have fun solving the puzzle!

Hello there! If you've unlocked fusion, you can start this questline, but keep in mind that it's divided into three segments (the three fusion chains): one for each tier of Fusion Reactor, from Mk1 to Mk3.

There are more fine details surrounding plasma power generation you can access by using the following Wiki link: [url]https://wiki.gtnewhorizons.com/wiki/Fusion_Reactor[/url]

These quests follow the process of creating some truly powerful plasmas that are useful for power generation at the beginning of endgame, when you've scaled up your setup to a Compact Fusion Reactor and XL Plasma Turbines. As you might have seen before, those huge turbines can go very fast with good materials, like Trinium or Infinity, but they will apply EU/t penalties according to the fuel value of the plasma used. This means that Helium and Tin Plasma are both much weaker there than they were in Large Plasma Turbines.

The end product of this whole process is Celestial Tungsten Plasma, which has no penalties even at Spacetime and can somewhat match what Helium Plasma would have produced, per compact reactor. The last step is the slowest, but, if there are no other bottlenecks, you can expect around §2§lover 8 billion EU/t§r assuming a single compact doing the last step with huge infinity turbines in a plasma XL.

However, getting there won't be easy. This whole process uses 15 fusion recipes in total, and a lot more material automation than any of the simple fusion setups. This questline will help explain what is simple, not simple, or possibly a bottleneck. If you complete this, you will be sustained in powergen until the Dyson Swarm, or whatever other option appears later on, and it will continue being useful later on!

Reinforcing your casings with matter from white dwarfs was a good idea.

You can now accelerate a solar system until a black dwarf forms. This material will likely be key to observing and understanding what happens next.

This is the second of your three EOH materials. Use it to upgrade your casings to T7.

[note]The EOH becomes power positive once all the casings are Tier 7.[/note]

Sometimes people have a storage system that contains a lot of different items, or they have a large quantity of the same item.

Here comes the Polymorphic ItemSink. It assigns inventory space to the kind of items already in the inventory.

Very handy especially when you have a storage controller connecting to a lot of drawers.
There are two different species of crop able to produce the products of those pesky spiders. Definitely easier than building a two-block wide mob farm chute if you ask me.

It's easy to lose Ore Drilling Plants. You're a busy engineer, you know? You can't be bothered to remember trifling things like "where, in what galactic backwater did I last place my miner." You could do something boring like "write down the location of the miner" or "put up a sign with the miner's location in my ore processing area," but there's a better way.

Enter the Metrics Transmitter Cover. This cover, when attached to a multiblock miner (or any GregTech machine), spawns in a GregTech Advanced Sensor Card paired to the host machine. This card, when inserted into a NuclearCraft Industrial Information Panel, will receive runtime information transmitted by the host machine, including its current location. Additionally, it returns the same information that its lower-tech sibling, the GregTech Sensor Kit, provides. Unlike the GregTech Sensor Kit, the Metrics Transmitter Cover §nworks interdimensionally and at any range without the need of range upgrades.§r In addition, since covers remain on machines when they are dismantled, the paired sensor card §nwill continue to work even if the host machine is relocated, and never needs to be recalibrated.§r This makes it perfect for the Ore Drilling Plant and Oil/Gas/Fluid Drilling Rig, which are deployed in the field and often have to be relocated.

However, like always, there's a catch. If the Metrics Transmitter Cover is detached from its host machine, §nthe paired sensor card will be destroyed.§r Maybe you shouldn't be using a crowbar around sensitive electronics...

Now that you got your first paper, it's time for a better way to get more. With paperbark you can do just that.

Once grown you can obtain paper by right-clicking the logs of the tree. The bark regrows in due time.

More advanced Thaumcraft recipes require larger and larger amounts of vis that your initial wands can't handle. You need to progress bit by bit to increase your capabilities. The progression is two-fold:

First, you need to craft more advanced wands, the Greatwood Wand is next. And secondly, you need to improve your crafting discounts. They reduce the vis cost of crafts and thus also let you craft higher vis recipes.

In your progression you will need to rely on both aspects. Better wands and higher discounts. However, as you progress, there are many different ways on how to proceed. Some ways focus more on discounts, others more on wands. Therefore, the questbook can only give you some general advice.

For example, when making a new wand type, it is always cheapest to first make it with iron caps and then try to improve it afterwards. One way you can improve your wand is by swapping the cores & caps for higher tiers as you unlock them §3(see "Substitution" research)§r. However, if you are able to obtain enough discounts you can directly make the wand with gold caps or better, skipping the iron capped wand altogether.

But before all these options really open up, let us work on that Greatwood Wand!

A great source of bauxite.

Bauxia leaves will 4x your aluminum ore.

When you need to polarize magnets or separate magnetic materials, look to the MFE! This multiblock requires an electromagnet to be inserted into its housing - better magnets, better bonuses. In IV, you'll be stuck with an Iron Electromagnet, though.

[note]At the final tier of electromagnet, you can use TecTech multi-amp hatches. Might be good to remember when you're processing a certain magnetic material...[/note]

Do you ever wish that you were able to place 16,000 blocks with the click of a button? No??..

Well now you can!

[note]It's unbreakable too![/note]

The most dense steam available. Check the XL Steam Turbine quest above for an explanation of the mechanics shared across all turbines.

This turbine has unexpected bugs related to the integer limit, when using the best turbine materials in the pack. There might also be other limitations when trying to move billions of SC Steam per tick from one place to another. Be wary of bugs when trying to use this XL turbine with endgame turbine materials.

You've gotten this far, you know the drill. You've made more circuits than you can count, but what if that isn't enough? It's time to stop scaling the old way, and start manufacturing like the late game engineer you are.

The Nanochip Assembly Complex isn't just a fancier CAL or Assembly Line - it is the core of your entire operation. For the low price of a small craft* for your machines to chew on, you can be the proud owner of the latest innovation in circuit crafting technology! 

§oNote*: "Small craft" may not accurately reflect the state of your industrialization and the company holds no accountability or liability for professional mishaps like "that's way too much UHV Superconductor" or "we need to scale our HILEs yesterday"§r

§oNAC™ sold as-is. Functionality available via separately crafted modules

You have mastered both interdimensional transportation and wallsharing, why not combine them?

You can link both crafting input bus/buffer to proxies with data sticks and use it to process patterns with multiple machines, as if you are wallsharing them, but without actually wallsharing them.

[note]Maybe this can reduce lag?[/note]

Mutated Living Solder has become far too weak for your assembly needs. You need something more... cosmic.

Boundless Cosmic Solder is the final tier of soldering alloy, and you will need it in large quantities.

[note]Hopefully your Beamcrafter can keep up...[/note]

The §dPrimitive§r Spacetime Compression Field Generator allows for up to §lT2§r recipes which produce §l4608L§r of White Dwarf Matter per successful batch.

The §dPrimitive§r Time Dilation Field Generator grants a §250%§r time reduction for any recipe ran in the EoH, but reduces the likelihood of success by §c9.25%§r.

The §dPrimitive§r Stabilisation Field Generator will boost the success chance of the EoH by §25%§r, but will decrease the yield by §c5%§r and increase the power cost by §c35%§r.
No Description

At long last, you have all the tools to smelt items into Essentia, keep it stable, and store it for later use.

The last step was creating Warded Jars, relatively simple creations that keep Essentia in a quasi-liquid state, which makes it easier to keep Essentia from turning into Flux. Unlike phials, which must hold 8 Essentia exactly to keep it stable, Warded Jars can store anywhere from 1 to 64 Essentia.

These Warded Jars are safe to pick up and carry around, which you suspect will not be the case for most objects storing much more Essentia than these jars do. Right-click them with a label to filter that jar to a specific type of Essentia. Use a preset label if the jar is still empty.

Sneak-right-click with an empty hand to remove a label from a jar, or void the Essentia it contains if it doesn't have a label. Voiding Essentia from jars will not generate Flux, because... magic, I guess. It's very convenient, so just politely don't question it too much.
Mana for all of your needs, endless amounts of mana.

Tairitsu, Shijima, and Churitsu are sister materials, all requiring similarly colored materials to make. A hidden conection between all of them allow some strong protective forces to appear.

Try putting their bond to good use.

[note]Technetium dust is needed Shijima, which can be fused with Fluorine and Selenium. The latter can be obtained with the Selenium line, by processing Platinum Froth, or from Miessite in the Toxic Everglades.[/note]
Same as the EV Multi-amp hatches, use these to extract and insert many amps from your LSC.
Easy slime blocks and therefore easy glue and rubber, no need to horse around anymore.
Barnarda F - Press F
How much oil do you need? Maybe you're after Naquadah Fuel or Radox. Either way, this massive structure can handle it, boasting §6§l256§r parallels.
Cinderpearls make for a good source of blaze powder.

While the GT EU Meter can inspect one cable or machine at a time, troubleshooting a large power network that way quickly becomes rather tedious. If only there was a dedicated tool for that...

The Network Analyzer displays the entire connected EU network directly in the world, allowing you to follow power from generators to machines and identify dangerous sections before they become craters.

Right-click a GT cable to bind the Analyzer to its network, then keep it in your hand to display the overlay. You can also use it on a multiblock controller to inspect the networks connected to all of its Energy and Dynamo Hatches.

You can shift-right-click to cycle through its five modes:
- §9Topology§r displays the complete network and its worst case condition.
- §cCritical§r displays only overloaded or otherwise dangerous sections.
- §2Active§r displays cables that are currently carrying amperage.
- §6Amperage§r compares the expected load with each cable’s capacity.
- §5Voltage§r displays expected cable loss and warns about cables or machines receiving excessive voltage.

Orange nodes are power sources, cyan nodes are consumers, and green nodes are forks in the network. Gray indicates an idle or unknown section, green is safe, yellow warns of significant voltage loss, and red indicates an overload, a cable that may burn, or a machine that may explode.

Look directly at a node to see more detailed information about amperage, voltage loss, and any detected problems.

[note]Amperage mode displays the potential load of the connected machines, while Active mode shows what is actually carrying power at that moment.[/note]

[warn]Machines from other mods cannot always report their real amperage requirements. The Analyzer must estimate their consumption, so readings for IC2 machines, reactors, and other non-GT consumers may be inaccurate.[/warn]

As I'm sure you've figured out by now, some of the Cutting Machine recipes take quite a long time to complete. Fortunately, the MV Cutting Machine should help speed that process along nicely compared to the LV version.

[note]This will also be required later in the questline for cutting up ULPICs![/note]
The Dark Steel barrel holds 135 items! And is also immune to explosions.

Every system takes power. A Logistics Pipes network is no exception.

The Logistics Pipes system runs on an energy called LP, but there are no generators that generate LP.

Instead, Logistics Pipes has a power adapter called the Logistics Power Junction that converts EU into LP. Use a Basic Logistics Pipe to connect the Power Junction to the whole network.

The Power Junction can receive power from all 6 sides while a Basic Logistics Pipe can only connect to the sides in the 4 cardinal directions.

Living bio chip can perform multiple tasks at once and will make your ZPM circuits cheaper!

[note]This does cost quite a bit of hypogen, perhaps hold off on using these until you can make hypogen easily.[/note]

The portable equivalent of the Copper Barrel.

Has §n45§r slots.

[note]Can be dyed![/note]

The ME Level Maintainer is another cool addition of AE2FC. Choose an item or fluid and an amount to maintain, and the Level Maintainer will attempt to call patterns to keep crafting the item until it reaches the threshold you configured. You can also configure the crafting batch size.
No Description
Somehow this plant has developed the ability to produce a number of different types of meat. Don't ask me how it does it, or how it smells.

You've created a chest that allows you to see what's inside, isn't that useful?

[note]Just as with the previous chests you can also upgrade with a fitting upgrade item.[/note]
Only the most advanced memory chips will do when working with optical computers.

Ever thought to yourself "man, why does everything have to use primal aspects so much?" Well now you won't have to worry about that anymore!

Meet the Rosa Mysteria. When the sprout is planted on a Crystal Block, it will use that block's essence to grow into an Aspect Shard of the same type! These shards can then be thrown into your Cauldron or Alchemical Furnace, or used as Knowledge Fragments to gain Research Points. Even Mixed Crystals can be used as a catalyst!

[warn]Warning: Planting Rosa Mysteria on Tainted Crystal Blocks will lead to unf§ko§rrs§ke§re§kn   §rco§kn§rs§ke§rq§kue§rnc§ke§r§ks.§r[/warn]

Ethyl Cyanoacrylate, commonly known as Super Glue is the best glue there is. But with great power comes... great complexity. It's not needed now and probably for the next few tiers, but it will make your recipes more efficient and will be necessary in the lategame.

[note]Technically this line is available in IV, but only optional. Show your true skills by searching the recipes in NEI yourself![/note]
These special berries somehow have gained the atomic properties of UU-Matter. Due to their inherent genetic instability, they will require the Industrial Farm to harvest with high tier seed-beds.

If you want to process your Europium-Doped Wafers with a significant speed boost, this machine is for you. Using the pH neutral water you get from this machine, you can process wafers twice as fast.

This is the first real complex automation challenge in the waterline, it's up to you to figure out how you want to deal with the pH neutralization process. Have fun!

[note]This multiblock is very picky about where its hatches for acids and bases go. If you can't figure out why it's not forming, chances are you forgot to place these hatches in the correct location. Use the hologram projector to see where they go.[/note]

Tired of your magnet picking up everything? Fortunately, with the advent of Dark Steel this no longer needs to be an issue.

The Dislocator Inhibitor will restrict the function of the Draconic Evolution Item Dislocator within a customizable range of up to 16 blocks. You can stop it from picking up items entirely, or configure a whitelist or blacklist of your choosing. Additionally, you can choose whether it is always active or only enabled by a redstone signal.

So you've created the Chemical Plant, and an Algae Farm, excellent! Time to make some use of it instead of letting it sit there collecting. There's quite a few recipes you can make with Algae, but we'll start with a more simple one.

For this you'll need some Brown Algae and some Green Algae. This means you need at minimum HV machine casings for the bottom of the Algae Farm. HV will produce up to 8 brown algae every 35 seconds, but can at worst case produce 2 in 105 seconds, while EV will produce at best 20 every 30 seconds, and at worst 12 in 90 seconds.

Once you have some Green and Brown Algae, you'll have to put them in a tier 2 Chemical Plant (steel based) with some distilled water, and you'll get back Sulfuric Acid. Cheap to produce once you have it all set up, a bit expensive to get there though! There's another Sulfuric acid recipe you can use as well later on, but it'll cost higher tier Algae and a higher tier Chemical Plant.

The Ender IO mod adds one of the handiest enchantments in the game: Soulbound. An item enchanted with it stays in your inventory when you die, while everything else drops into your grave.

The best part: it works on almost anything, even items that normally reject enchantments:

- Backpacks (both normal and adventure backpacks) - including everything inside them
- The Mantle of the Raven and the Rod of the Skies
- Even Tinkers' Construct tools, which normally ignore vanilla enchantments completely

How to get it:

1. The Ender IO Enchanter crafts soulbound books from a Book and Quill and an Ender Crystal. See the [questlink]AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAqg==[/questlink] quest.

2. Loot bags regularly drop enchanted books, soulbound among them - higher tiers give better chances. See the "Do You Feel Unlucky?" quest.

3. Found an item that already has soulbound? Strip it off with the Draconic Evolution Disenchanter to get the book. See the [questlink]AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAIFA==[/questlink]quest - surrounding the Disenchanter with bookcases reduces the damage it deals.

Applying it is easy: use a vanilla anvil, just like any other enchantment.

[note]PS: Put soulbound on your backpack itself - the backpack and everything inside it stays with you on death.[/note]

The Advanced Level Emitter is a valuable upgrade to the traditional Level Emitter. It allows for up to 6 types of items to be monitored at once.

The redstone signal will output depending on which item slots are toggled on, whether inverted mode is triggered, and which logic mode it's in. It can toggle between using both AND & OR.
No Description

This multiblock is the perfect solution to high-speed tree farming. Do you need wood for charcoal or benzene power? Nuts for seed oil? Leaf blocks for decoration? Look no further!

The Tree Growth Simulator can farm almost any tree in the game, and produces all the items you would get by chopping it down normally. It does all this in a compact area, without any lag from growing a real tree.

First, place any sapling in the controller slot of the multiblock. Then, insert tools appropriate for the part of the tree you want to harvest in an input bus. Give the machine power, turn it on, and be ready to get flooded by the outputs.

Different tools are required to gather different parts of the tree:
 - Saw for logs
 - Branch Cutter for saplings
 - Shears for leaves
 - Knife for fruit
Better versions of the tools (Chainsaw, Grafter, ...) will increase the yield! Check the tooltip of the controller block for details.

You can even use multiple different tools together, and the machine will harvest several different products at the same time!

Note that the tools used will slowly lose durability, so for long-term operation you might want to set up an automatic replacement system.

[note]You can optionally use grass in place of the dirt blocks during construction.[/note]

[warn]While this machine only requires IV, it is quite expensive to make early in the tier. You will need 16 ZPM circuits and some fancy alloys.[/warn]

You may need a second anvil! 

One would have been for the Forge Hammer and another for general repairing or renaming!

The framework of the Stargate. You wouldn't want it held together with glue, would you?

Right, maybe you would...

Finally, you can combine the §2Radiation-Proof Composite Sheet§r with §2Netherite Foil§r and §2Manyullyn§r in the §5§lForming Press§r to create §3Naquarite Universal Insulator Foil§r. This incredibly strong foil can be used to bind ingredients to all of your future coils due to its unrivaled radiation and heat resistance.

After creating the §2Prismarine-Rich Nitrobenzene Solution§r, you'll need to process it using a §5§lChemical Plant§r with §2Strontium Hydroxide§r. Once processed, you can successfully obtain your first §3Prismarine Precipitate§r.

[warn]This line produces excess Strontium, so no need to worry about its continuous injection.[/warn]

[note]If you have not gotten Strontium yet, you can obtain it from Strontium Oxide based on Rare Earth 3 or from Spessartine Froth.[/note]
The Silver barrel has 72 slots.

Your attempts to improve your dimensional catalyst have been futile so far, but with the Raw Stellar Plasma from your Eye of Harmony, you can finally create a stable and more powerful catalyst.

You will need some higher-tier plasmas to help maintain its stability as well.

[warn]Handle with care. We are not responsible for your base turning into supermassive black holes. /s[/warn]

Redstone Dust is a wonderful substance, but it has several limitations that only true Minecrafters can handle.

Luckily, with a bit of magic the dust crystallizes and becomes much easier to handle.

Redcrystal can be placed directly against a wall or ceiling, and also allows you to use a wand to toggle whether a given side sends/receives any redstone signals. This allows for nice and compact builds in places regular redstone couldn't even exist in the first place.

Maybe it is possible to improve these redcrystals further to allow them to manipulate or process the signal they're receiving in some way...

Woah, another Energy Hatch.

You should probably consider upgrading your Assembly Lines and Precise Assemblers first.

Well get ready for a processing line.

First you need to react Thorium Dust with Hydrofluoric Acid and eight buckets of Nitric Acid. I hope you have a Nitric Acid setup.

Then react the Thorium Nitrate with Sodium Hydroxide to produce Thorium Hydroxide. Then react with even more Hydrofluoric Acid to get Thorium Tetrafluoride.

Then pump it into a Centrifuge to separate the normal Thorium away from the Thorium 232. Sadly it is still in a liquid form so you will need to blast it with Zinc Chloride and Calcium.

Then finally use your Blast Furnace again for the Zn-Th alloy ingot to separate the Zinc from the Thorium 232 to obtain the Thorium 232 Dust and even get your Zinc back in fluid form.

Well I hope you enjoyed the processing line for Thorium 232 EBF edition.

With the project finally completed, and a new material capable of harnessing the power of a neutron star, you decide the natural first application of this immense power could be used for a far superior Blast Furnace. With a little tinkering, you decide a second may be necessary, since this module could easily be retrofitted into an ordinary Furnace as well.

[note]The first module of the Godforge, Helioflare Power Forge can perform EBF recipes and Furnace recipes in separate running modes, toggleable in the UI. Note that the Furnace mode does NOT contribute towards the Conversion milestone![/note]

[note]Usage of this module requires the START upgrade.[/note]
No longer will sand be such a difficult resource to obtain in bulk. Thank Greg.

The §cG§6a§el§al§bi§9f§dr§ce§6y§ea§an§r Spacetime Compression Field Generator allows for up to §lT10§r§r recipes which produce §l18432L§r of Universium per successful batch.

The §cG§6a§el§al§bi§9f§dr§ce§6y§ea§an§r Time Dilation Field Generator grants a §299.609375%§r time reduction for any recipe ran in the EoH, but reduces the likelihood of success by §c74%§r.

The §cG§6a§el§al§bi§9f§dr§ce§6y§ea§an§r Stabilisation Field Generator will boost the success chance of the EoH by §240%§r, but will decrease the yield by §c40%§r.

[note]If you want to run a T10 EoH that is power positive, the best setup to use is a T9/T8/T9 (Using Tipler Time Dilation Field Generators).[/note]

To get this schematic you don't need to defeat any boss. You will still need to invest some time.

After researching a T8 Rocket Schematic you are able to build the Shuttle Schematic in the Assembly Line.
These crops will all collect and produce certain mineral dusts from the soil like pollen for B**s.

Arrange Nanites in P-507 and label them with target particle information in the high-energy laser beam environment of a laser engraver. Then we get the Extracting Unit called "Nano Resin".

These Nanites automatically capture the target particles in solution and store them in the resin. It is worth noting that the actual production rate will be limited by the number of Nanites. So if you want to use this method to produce lanthanides in large quantities, you need to prepare more extra Nano Resin.

Here are all 15 types of Extracting Nano Resin.

If you've ever needed to wait on a Canning Machine to fill up your supply of tin cans, or to make mountains of coolant, consider the TurboCan Pro. This multiblock performs both operations with significant bonuses.

To run the DTPF, you will need to feed it excited catalyst. There are four tiers of catalyst you can make right now, and one more to unlock later. Making these catalysts requires a lot of power and time, so you will almost certainly want to passive this with many machines.

In UIV, you will unlock the §p§oplasma mixer§r, a dedicated multiblock that can make catalyst much faster than you currently can, although this comes at an enormous power cost. Either way, it's probably a good idea to get this as soon as you can.

The reinforced spade will do everything the basic spade does, but better. It further increases your chances of bonus seeds based on the resistance stat. Every ten points of resistance increases the MINIMUM seed drop by one. That means:

1 Resist = 10% seed drop
10 Resist = 1 guaranteed seed drop
15 Resist = 1 guaranteed seed drop + 50% chance for a second seed drop!
31 Resist = 3 guaranteed seed drops + 10% chance for a fourth seed drop!!

Time to scale up farmhand.

[note]If you're removing a crop with your spade, sneaking will let you remove the crop without having to worry about the spade breaking the crop stick.[/note]
betterquesting:10.name:8: Tools of the Trade 4 - Reinforced Spade

betterquesting:10.desc:8:
When you get poisoned or withered a bit of milk solves the problem. Why not create something akin to milk, but for Warp effects?

Briar gives a bit of an answer to that. These two block tall plants, which require good light to grow, will produce Briar Seed Bags when harvested. Those can be combined with sugar and a suitable container in an Arcane Workbench to create Rosehip Syrup.

Rosehip Syrup stacks up to 16 and can be used the same as milk, also removing some (though not all) Warp effects as well as Flux Flue and Flux Phage.

The plant has a strange life cycle where the seed pods will first appear as yellow dots, turn pink as they start to mature, then §odisappear§r, only to return fully matured. Still, if it works, it works.
No Description
No Description

Eventually, your LHC will start making rarer and rarer particles. You may find that they appear in large bursts as single particle packets with very high Amounts, but not very often. The Beam Stabilizer allows you to capture these large packets and redistribute them over time as a continuous series of smaller packets with a lower Amount.

[warn]This is particularly useful to ensure recipe checks work consistently for beam-consuming machines.[/warn]

Space Flowers can be used to synthesize and 4x some intergalactic materials:
- Meteoric Iron and Steel
- Desh
- Mytryl
- Oriharukon
- Ledox
- Callisto Ice
- Deep Iron
- Mysterious Crystal
- Black Plutonium

The §5§lHypercooler§r (HC) module is the first §9§lUIV§r tier module you unlock for the §nExo-Foundry§r.

The HC module will require one of three different types of coolant be supplied to it via input hatch in exchange for giving overclock bonuses to the Foundry. The input hatch can be set in replacement of any Cryogenic Casing.

Allowed Coolant Types:
1. Supercoolant (§c100L/s§r) -> §21§r Overclock
2. Spacetime (§c50L/s§r) -> §22§r Overclocks
3. Eternity (§c25L/s§r) -> §23§r Overclocks

[note]Eternity can not actually be used as a coolant unless paired with another module unlocked later in UXV.[/note]

[warn]Only one of these modules may be installed per Foundry.[/warn]
The Mothership Navigation Console is used to select the Mothership's destination.
betterquesting:10.name:8: Don't Tell Me I Need To Read A Paper Map!
