The steam machines you have been using until now have served you well, but there will be a time when you need to process even more items. That's where the so-called multiblocks come in. There's a variety of steam multiblocks available to you - go have a look at the Mass Processing quest tab!

This tab introduces you to a wide range of extremely powerful multiblock machines that can replace your old, worn-out singleblocks (and some that can replace your old multiblocks!). Many of these new machines will require you to handle additional mechanics and requirements, but it will be worth it!

Here are some terms you should be familiar with as you enter the world of multiblocks:

§lOverclock (OC):§r
Whenever a machine is running a recipe of a lower tier than it's energy hatch it will gain a speed boost at the cost of more energy usage.

§lImperfect Overclock§r (aka. Normal, 2/4 OC):
For each tier above recipe machine will be 2x faster at the cost of 4x energy (2/4 OC)

§lPerfect Overclock§r (Often phrased as "Does not lose efficiency when overclocked", 4/4 OC):
Some machines conditionally (or unconditionally) perform perfect overclocks. In this case, the machine will be 4x as fast, but it will run at 4x the EU/t (4/4 OC), leading to both increased speed and no net increase in the total EU usage!

§lParallel§r (Often phrased as "Processes x items"):
Machines which parallel act as if they are running multiple of themselves - that is to say, they are able to perform multiple of the same recipe at the same time, using the recipe's EU/t multiplied by the number of parallels. Machines which parallel will [warn]PRIORITIZE[/warn] this behavior over overclocking, which is good for you! Parallels are more efficient.

§lInput Separation:§r
Refers to a machine's behavior when choosing inputs for a recipe. With Input Separation on, you must have all required items for a recipe in one bus. With Input Separation off, you can split item inputs of a recipe between multiple busses.

[note]When working with multiblocks, if power is interrupted during operation, your inputs will be lost forever... careful![/note]
The most powerful version of the Laputa shard. Using its power you can raise entire islands at a whim!

Almost as expensive as the real one, right? Not to worry, this stargate and the current are only just the beginning.

[note]Our journey reaches the current end, entering the UXV, aka EOH era.

The year is 2023, and the game continues to be pushed further and further. The EOH exists now, along with machine parts up to UXV. Multiblocks have gained endless amounts of quality of life, including sub 1-tick OC, batch mode, void protection, and numerous AE2 additions like Crafting Input Buses, Stocking Hatches, Level Maintainers and more. Automation has never been easier, yet the goal has never been placed farther. Naquadah Fuel now has many tiers and can compete into the late-game, even competing with (now fixed) Dyson, but outclassed by the huge amount of power a maximized EOH can make (12.8 TEU/t!).

Initially the stargate recipe seemed impossible, requiring months of runtime on hundreds of maximized EOHs, requiring some adjustments to be more realistic to attain. After this was changed, the race began again, this time between §aJohny709§r and §aGDCloud§r. §aJohny§r burned out towards the end, and §aGDCloud§r was surpassed by a silent contender, §aStarStack§r, being the first to conquer this challenge on the §a26th of June, 2023§r.

Beyond just the first, this era marked the beginning of the Group Run Era, with large runs such as §aBallers Run§r (setting this era into motion), §aBee Run§r (affecting wide change on the NH project and its management as a whole), and §aCell Run 2§r (the fastest ever Stargate run at the time, only 73 days, popularizing many automation techniques like Level Maintained lines).

Additionally, this version saw the first player achieve GTNH Gods, reaching Stargate in a 3rd run, earned by §aGDCloud§r as a part of §aCell Run 2§r on the §a23rd of June, 2024§r. Later this Stargate would see three others reach this goal, §aRamspace§r on the §a29th of September, 2024§r, and §aStaffiX§r and §aserenibyss§r in a group run on the §a17th of November, 2024§r.

P.S.: Here's the list as usual:
-Many new processing multiblocks like HILE, Fluid Shaper, Industrial Autoclave, etc.
-Forge of the Gods, Black Hole Compressor, Antimatter power generation, Precise Assembler T4
-DTPF Convergence, Component Assembly Line tiered bonuses, Mega Vac Subspace Cooling, MK5 fusion skips for Metastable Oganesson
-Wireless Data Hatches, Wireless Optical Hatches, Uncertainty Resolution
-Artificial Universe Cells, smart blocking mode[/note]

display:10.Name:8: Obtain this item to get your trophy

betterquesting:10.desc:8:
The Transcendent nanite has the required complexity and speed to create most nanites, but lacks the strength required to handle the exotic, hyper-dense, magnetic forms of matter you need to manipulate in order to advance. Fortunately with Eternity, you have found an ample replacement that should be up to the task... But you suspect that you'll need a far more complicated structure to be able to contain such a process.

[note]Grants the ability to create §lMagmatter Nanites§r in addition to a greater speed at the cost of assembling a more expensive structure.[/note]

SpaceTime is quite a challenge, isn't it? You should definitely consider upgrading your Component Assembly Lines to save on some of it.

[note]Did you know you can wall-share the component casings? Just turn one CoAL upside down.[/note]

It's time to upgrade your wooden sword a little.

You only need one stick, one bone, and one flint to create the new weapon. However, it's recommended that you gather extra flint since it can be used to repair the sword.

You won't be able to kill a Wither with it now, but you can upgrade and improve this tool later.

There are even more NEI search options!

If you are scrolling through recipes, you might have noticed the magnifier symbol on the top, left to the page number. Clicking it opens the §lrecipe search field§r. A search term you enter here will filter all the current recipes to the ones where an input or output matches the term. An easy way to narrow down all screwdriver recipes to just the one from a particular material you want!

If you use "extended+" search mode the recipe search becomes even more powerful!

Here backticks `` are used around the search queries, but you don't need them when searching.

By default the search works like in the extended mode, searching in §lany§r of the inputs and outputs of a recipe. So if you search a recipe by `§1-§rdust`, it will return all recipes where there's at least one item that doesn't have §o"dust"§r.

Let's say you want to search only in §linputs§r. Put §a<§r before your search query to do that. For example: `§a<§riron` returns all the recipes with §o"iron"§r in one of the §linputs§r, `§a<§rsteel§5@gregtech§r` returns the recipes with at least one item from any mod containing §9Gregtech§r in their name, using §o"steel"§r.

But then, if you search by `§a<§1-§rdust` it still returns the recipes with §o"dust"§r on the left. Why is that? Because §a<§r searches among §lall§r items. So if there's one item that doesn't have §o"dust"§r, then it would still match the recipe, even if the rest of the inputs are dusts.

To solve this, use §a<&§r instead. Like this: `§a<&§1-§rdust`. It returns §lall§r the recipes without §o"dust"§r among the inputs! §a<&§r sets a §lstrict§r condition on §lall§r inputs, unlike §a<§r that sets a condition on §lany§r input.

To filter the §loutputs§r use §a>§r and §a>&§r. They work the same way, but allow you to filter the §loutputs§r of a recipe. So `§a>§rgold` gives you the recipes with at least one §loutput§r with §o"gold"§r. And `§a>&§rgold` gives you the recipes with §o"gold"§r in every outputted item.

Want to combine multiple conditions? Sure, just put them one after another in any order. E.g. you could search for `§a<§riron§a>§rsteel`, `§a<&§r §1-§b$dust§r §a<§r cell`, `§a>&§1-§rdust cell`.

Or even for `dust§a>§rcell`. Here the non-prefixed part works like default, searching among §lall§r items from the inputs and outputs. So this query returns the recipes with §o"dust"§r in one of the inputs or outputs and §o"cell"§r in one of the outputs.

In some recipes you might have items that don't belong to inputs or outputs. In order to filter them use `§a^§r` and `§a^&§r` respectively.

You can add spaces for readability too, because (unless you have space mode on) spaces can be used anywhere while in extended+ mode.

The Crop Gene Extractor and Crop Synthesizers can be made in §5EV§r and allows you to create new seeds using UU-Matter and a few Data Orbs.

§lCrop Gene Extractor§r
The §nCrop Gene Extractor§r is used to extract "Genes" from a crop. You can control which gene is extracted from a crop by using a programmed circuit:
1. Species
2. Growth
3. Gain
4. Resistance

Extracting will usually have a base recipe time of 150 seconds (with the exception of the species gene, taking 300 seconds at base)

§lCrop Synthesizer§r§r
The §nCrop Synthesizer§r is used to create new seeds from the extracted genes at the cost of some UU-Matter.

The UU-Matter cost will depend on the stats and tier of the seed being synthesized.
- 750L per crop tier.
- 100L per stat point on the seed.

[note]Using the Crop Synthesizer is the only way to obtain and replicate maxed out Primordial Berry seeds.[/note]

Congratulations! You have gracefully served your penance; no longer shall you be bound by the woes of hunger. 

With this new trinket (equipable in a baubles slot) you will automatically have your hunger and saturation replenished, so long as the nanobooster stays charged.

Additionally it will do its best to keep you healed, though it cannot ward off death completely on its own.

[note]P.S. Upgrading your wireless charger might be a good idea![/note]

[note]P.P.S. Advanced Nitinol can be made out of blocks of Nitinol 60 with a Quantum Anomaly in a Laser Engraver, or you can go the plasma method once you unlock MKIII fusion.[/note]

Now that you have a frame and a core, you can get to work adding new features to your Mechanical Armor. This quest lists all Tier 1 augments.

Some standouts:

-Optical Brightness Adjuster (§dUtility§r, Helmet): Enable toggleable night vision.
-Protective Lining (§6Protection§r, Any): Gain full hazmat protection.
-Electric Jetpack (§aMovement§r, Chestplate): Jetpack!
-Astronaut's Equipment (§6Protection§r, Any): Gain space suit capability.

Cooling exotic ingots proves to be a much bigger challenge than smelting them.

Fortunately, reinforcing some of the casings with your new materials allows you to inject exotic coolants that capture extreme heat in miniature tears of spacetime, helping to cool your ingots a bit faster.

With Subspace Cooling, you can enable the Vacuum Freezer to achieve Perfect Overclocks… at a cost.

Tier 1 will consume SpaceTime in liquid form at [warn]75 L/s[/warn] and allow for 1 Perfect Overclock.

[note]This cost is very high but static, remaining the same for each recipe being run. So, be selective about cooling your ingots.

The faster the recipes, the more efficient the cost, so find your optimal balance.[/note]

The Infinity Cooled Casings replace the frost proof casings, so you don't need to worry about damaging your setups.
If you somehow don't already have enough netherrack from mining all that sulfur, this should help pad your coffers.

Now that you have your hands on Eternity you can upgrade your §nExo-Foundry§r to the final tier!

The §6§lCelestial Magnetic Chassis§r will allow your Foundry to have a maximum of four modules installed, unlocking the most powerful combinations.

[note]Checkout the Wiki if you need ideas on which modules to choose [url]https://wiki.gtnewhorizons.com/wiki/Exo-Foundry[/url][/note]

Using your new optically enhanced boards and chips, you've managed to create what looks like the perfect CPU! Surely this will be able to handle even the advanced computations you need to perform to breach dimensional boundaries.
These ones can extract and insert 16A.

Are you sick and tired of using the rocket to blast off every time and want an alternative and faster method? The EnderIO Telepad is a 3x3x1 structure that when powered with RF will teleport the player to a set coordinate.

To set the Coordinate you will need a Coordinate selector tool to mark an area by shift-right-clicking to mark. Then shift-right-click the middle of the EnderIO Telepad pad to set the desired location.

Then stand on the pad and click teleport to be sent in style.

The Advanced Harvesting Unit increases the production rate of your Industrial Farm. Only two are allowed per Industrial Farm. Each one increases the number of drops by 20%, and power usage by 50%.

[note]Unlike the bonuses given by the Seed Beds and Fertilization Units, the bonuses given by the Advanced Harvesting Unit is applied as a final multiplier. This means that each Advanced Harvesting Unit will always increase your overall production by 20 to 40% depending on how many upgrades you're using.[/note]

As with all upgrades, the tier of the upgrade must match the tier of the Seed Bed.

Now that you've reached ZPM, you're going to have to resort to means other than mere laser engraving for your photolithography needs.

Of course, we're going overkill right away, requiring a full-on particle accelerator setup to produce the ultra-coherent ultra-high-energy light used to etch more advanced ICs.

To begin with, you'll need a Source Chamber to produce electrons (at pitifully low energies, of course). Check out NEI for the available recipes, you'll want the one with the hand-drawn icon.
MAX circuits huh... Is it really almost over?
So many circuits. Maybe that Assembly Complex should have stayed in the drafts...

These hold 33,554,432 units of essentia.

And can hold 60 types.

Using high amounts of energy and the strange properties of a Quantum Anomaly, Tesseracts can become energised, unlocking hidden potential.

[note]You better love crafting these...[/note]
No Description

A great source of iron.

Ferrofern leaves will 4x your iron ore.
Everything can be beautiful, even the mycolo...logical.

The §5§lQuantum Uplink§r is a multi made specifically for the Matter Manipulator that is unlocked with the aid of UV tech. 

This allows the Matter Manipulator to connect to your ME system over an infinite range, and across dimensions. The tool can be linked by placing it into the controller while the uplink is active. The uplink will take a continuous 1A of ZPM power to function.

Additionally, you can now use it to create fake ME patterns upon selecting an area. This will make it quick to order all of the parts needed for Copy & Pasting in an area. 

[warn]The Uplink is powerful, but at a cost. Moving all items / fluids from the AE system will cost a small amount of plasma per transfer. 

Specifically: 16k EU of plasma per item / per 1000L of fluid[/warn]

Welcome to the current penultimate tier of New Horizons, Mega Ultimate Voltage.

This tier is the tier for upgrading everything and provides access to better parts to help you scale up.

Good Luck.

[warn]This tier is not fully complete. Expect stuff to change.[/warn]

Is the Water Tank not cutting it anymore? Have you set up in a dry biome and are in desperate need of more water? Fear not, for the Steam Water Pump can solve your issues! This Multiblock is able to produce large amounts of Water if fed with Steam (1500L/s).

Like other Steam Multiblocks, it can be upgraded by using Steel Frame Boxes instead of Bronze ones, which doubles the Water output at no additional Steam cost.

§4It is, however, still dependent on how humid the Biome you are in is, so keep that in mind.§r

§9Hint: You can find small lead ore in the Nether or full ingots on the lowest floor of roguelike dungeons if you're lucky!§r

[note]P.S. The optional quest item count includes the cost for the controller. [/note]

There are a plethora of ways to acquire gold, but here's one more for the dedicated apiarist. This breeding chain will eventually allow you to reach Sunnarium. You'll need a Block of Gold and a biome with a hot temperature. Breed them from Copper and Lead.

The Remote Comparator makes it significantly easier to get comparator signals out of whatever block you want, but looking at your storage chests you can't help but see no reason to bother. So what if they're nearly full? You want to know what they're nearly full §oof§r.

Tally Boxes can be pointed at a container - either directly or, using a Remote Comparator, remotely - and given a Runic Whitelist that specifies conditions where you want a Tally Box to send a redstone signal. Quantity, metadata and NBT matching are options, as is using a basic name filter.

Note that the redstone side is always opposite the reading side, and Remote Comparators must be placed on top of Tally Boxes to work together, meaning redstone is always output on the down face in that case.

[note]Runic Whitelists don't let you use NEI ghost items to set their filters, unfortunately.[/note]

The BOP Berry crop plays a nice role as the fastest growing crop you will get access to.

This makes it the perfect crop for breeding up stats with before crossing to other species which share pools.

Like its predecessor it can run 4 different recipes at once, but this time each recipe has 64 parallels.

A good solution for your Hydrogen and Helium problems.

[note]This also requires Eternity to craft.[/note]

A great source of mica.

NEI search got improved even further!

Select a search mode extended+ to try it out!

Extended+ works pretty much like extended, but it doesn't support * and ? expanding in the names. Also the following symbols have to be escaped with a `\`: `-` (dash) `<` and `>` (less-than and more-than) `^` (caret) `{` and `}` (curly brackets) `|` (vertical bar) `\` (backslash) ` ` (space) `"` (quote) alongside with the prefixes that you have enabled like §5@§r or §b$§r.

Examples: §5@§oElectro\-Magic§r, §oiron\ ingot§r, §oPB\&J§r.

Extended+ adds some QoL to your everyday search experience and an improved recipe search (next quest). In the following backticks `` are used around the search queries. You don't need them when searching.

Want to search for something without having to put a backslash before every other symbol? Use quotes! You could use a quote inside quotes too, but you would have to escape it. Like this: `§6"§r\"§6"§r`.

Use curly brackets §7{}§r to group conditions. Searching for `§7{§rmytryl§7|§rmanasteel§7}§r hammer head` would show you hammer heads made out of mytryl or manasteel.

Space is no longer necessary to use. So `§7{§rmytryl§7|§rmanasteel§7}§rhammer` works too!

There's a space mode support, so if you want your spaces to work literally turn it on!

Quotes no longer require a closing quote. So you could search for `§6"§riron ingot` and it would work! You still do need a quote if you want your quotes to end though.

Regex syntax got simplified (though the old one is still supported). Now instead of `§br/§rsome regex§b/§r` you could search for `§b/§rsome regex` and it would work too! You still do need a slash if you want your regex to end. Regex doesn't require escaping, the same way quotes don't, with the only exception being the `/`. So to find a slash with a regex you would search with `§b/§r\/`.

You can use quotes or regex after prefix to search with them instead of a plain text. For example, use `§5@§6"§5chest minecarts§r` to search for items from the §9Iron Chest Minecarts§r mod. Or `§5@§b/§5chest minecarts§r` to do the same with a regex.

[note]Be sure to read the tooltip of the Eye of Harmony controller, it explains everything in detail! Depending on your GUI scale it might have multiple pages.[/note]

[note]Well... it explains mostly everything. The Eye of Harmony has an inbuilt pity system to make sure you don't lose your mind. Here's a quick rundown on how it operates:

(All chances are decimals here)
There is a counter C that starts at the current recipe success chance P. If a recipe fails, (1-P)*P is added to C. If C reaches >= 1, the next roll is guaranteed to succeed and C resets to P. 
If a recipe succeeds before C reaches >= 1, it resets in a similar manner.
If you switch recipes, C will be reset to P of the new recipe, even if the next roll would be a guarantee.
The guarantee can be canceled out by overflow penalties as they apply after the pity does. However, they do not reset C, so the guarantee is shifted to the next recipe cycle.
If parallels are > 1, pity doesn't apply.[/note]

With your research now complete, you have finally constructed it - the Forge of the Gods.

The Forge of the Gods is an immensely powerful structure constructed around a stabilized neutron star - it is so advanced that its full capabilities are not yet understood. However, through continued use, one can slowly upgrade and expand the range of abilities of the Forge, and learn the power hidden in the most extreme parts of the universe: [note]Graviton Shards[/note].

This esoteric material can only be found where conventional matter and degenerate neutronium crust matter on the surface of a neutron star meet. At this point in space, gravitons are far more common and irradiate this material mixture to create highly unstable graviton shards, which can be used to internally upgrade the Forge. While these shards cannot yet exist outside the extreme conditions of the Forge, with continued research and utilization it may be possible to eventually isolate and extract them outside the Forge - but for what purpose?

So you were looking at Thorium 232 and wondering how to make it?

You could centrifuge it using a long recipe with a horrible output chance, but there are better ways to obtain it.

There are three processing paths, although the third is not unlocked until after you unlock Fusion and gain access to the Neutron Activator.

The first path requires the Chemical Plant multiblock, which you may not be familiar with. It is the fastest path, requiring only two steps to obtain Thorium 232, but it requires borax. You can obtain borax by mining salt veins (as a byproduct), from bees, or through CropsNH.

The second path is a six-step processing chain that requires Chemical Reactors, a Centrifuge, and an EBF. Although it is longer, it offers a much better conversion ratio (75%, rather than 25% in the Chemical Plant). Instead of borax, it requires 100 L of fluorine per dust; the nitric acid can be fully recycled, so this path scales better than the borax route.

The Industrial Farm (IF) is a long term, scalable, solution to Crop production. At its most basic, it will grow, harvest, and hydrate your crops, but with several upgrades and tier based size scaling, it is not a simple machine to make use of. The IF has three modes:

§lInput§r - Pulls seeds and sub-soil blocks into the machine from an Input Bus.
§lFarm§r - Grows the seeds and pushes products into an Output Bus.
§lOutput§r - Exports the seeds and undersoil blocks from the machine into an Output Bus.

You can cycle through them in the machine menu by clicking on the mode button.

To start, you should construct the most basic IF possible. Once you've done that, place your seeds (and any relevant sub-soil blocks) into the Input Bus. 

[warn]Seeds that have sub-soil requirements won't be inserted into the farm unless a block of the sub-soil is also available to the machine. The sub-soil block doesn't need to be in the same Input Bus as the seeds for it to work.[/warn]§r§r

Once you've input your seeds (and sub-soil blocks), you can begin using Farm mode to grow your crops.

When you wish to switch out seeds, enter Output mode before re-inserting the new seeds via the Input mode.

The length of your IF is controlled by the tier of your Seed Bed. An MV farm will require MV Seed Beds and therefore can only have one row of Seed Beds. This also means you can only insert one upgrade block (by replacing the wooden frame on the top layer). Each subsequent tier of Seed Bed increases the length of the machine, the base power consumption, the number of upgrades you can install and the number of seeds that can be inserted into the controller.

[note]The power, water and fertilizer consumption of the industrial farm do not scale with the number of seeds inside the farm, so there is no benefit to running the farm under capacity.[/note]

Crops grown in the Industrial Farm are assumed to grow in the following environment:
- They have sky access (§l+2 Nutrient Points§r)§r
- They have 200 water (§l+10 Nutrient Points§r)§r
- They have 200 fertilizer when using fertilizer (§l+10 Nutrient Points§r)
- The biome at the location of the controller controls the biome tags and humidity with the biome tags added by the env modules (§lup to +28 Nutrient Points§r)

You have probably already seen the button called §6Optimize Patterns§r when making an order in your AE system, now it's time to put it to good use!

To unlock this feature, just add a Pattern Optimization Matrix block to your AE system (you only need one).

§l# What does it do?
§r
This feature allows you to multiply patterns that are needed in large amounts.

1. After calculating a big order, just click §6Optimize Patterns§r and you will be welcomed by a new window.
2. There you specify how much you wish for a singular pattern to be ordered (maximum amount of steps), we recommend putting it at 1000 or 100, [warn]remember that over-optimizing patterns could lead to longer waiting times[/warn]. At this point, you can also disable singular patterns from optimization by clicking on them, but there shouldn't be any unwanted patterns anyway if you already excluded them by toggling a button in unwanted interfaces.
§

3. Click §6Optimize§r and you are done! Try ordering again to see the changes in pattern steps

All changes are [warn]permanent and can't be reverted automatically[/warn] so make sure that you have excluded all unwanted interfaces (the §6Allow Pattern Optimization§r button is §7GRAY§r) like:
- Single Assembly Line interfaces
- Extreme Crafting interfaces
- And any interface that doesn't have (almost) infinite buffer at the other side (inf. chest/storage cells)
Patterns are only multiplied by powers of 2, so your AAL patterns should be safe.

[note]If you are still confused about maximum order steps here's an example:
Ordering an EOH calculates that it will need 1,000,008 UHV superconductors crafted (41667 steps, 24 UHV SC patterned), now you proceed to optimize patterns and specify that you wish it to do 1000 steps maximum, it will multiply your pattern 64 times to achieve that goal (41667 / 64 ~= 652 which is lower or equal to 1000). After clicking optimize, UHV SC pattern will now output 1536 UHV SC (24 before).[/note]

You may have noticed that Optical Circuits the way you're used to in the CAL and Assembly Line are far more expensive than any other circuit line. The NAC™ has just the solution for you!

We are offering the new §5§nOptical Package§r, allowing for much more efficient production of your optical circuits! See the attached owner's manual for installation instructions.

§oAn external review has been conducted and has found the company §nnot responsible§r§o for changes to other methods of producing optical circuits. The benefits of a NAC™ for optical circuits are merely coincidental.§r§r

§l§nOptically Optimized Organizer Owner's Manual§r

The Optically Optimized Organizer requires two different grades of purified water to function. However, these are not just an extra running cost! Each grade of water 3 and above provides a bonus to the module's running stats:
- Grade 3 (1000L/s): 0.8x Water Cost (applies to both)
- Grade 4 (800L/s): 0.6x Water Cost (applies to both)
- Grade 5 (800L/s): 0.9x Recipe Duration Modifier
- Grade 6 (600L/s): 0.7x Recipe Duration Modifier
- Grade 7 (600L/s): 0.9x Recipe EU Cost
- Grade 8 (400L/s): 0.7x Recipe EU Cost

Water is only consumed while the module is running. Similar water bonuses (such as Grade 5 + Grade 6) can be applied together.

The NAC™ will track the most recent 100,000 circuits crafted, and can be calibrated to a specific circuit type by reaching a certain percentage of circuits of this type. At 60% (60,000) optical circuits crafted, the NAC™ will become "fully calibrated" to optical circuits.

Once that has been met, the bonuses from each chosen water type are applied twice.

The Spinmatron§r comes with a litany of advantages compared to the regular centrifuge multiblock, including a §2§l3x§r Speed boost, a §2§l30%§r reduction in EU usage, and a malleable number of parallels.

Unlike the generic turbine that comes stock in a normal Centrifuge, the Spinmatron§r graciously allows you to choose the quality of the turbines that go into the machine. You can add between §9§l2-8§r turbines depending on the machine tier, each turbine will increase the parallel amount by [§94 * Turbine Material Tier§r]. §3(You'll want to avoid using smaller, non-huge turbines!)§r

This efficiency comes at a cost however, and will require [§9Recipe Tier * 10§r] L/s of §5Kerosene§r in order to run. This can optionally be switched out with §5Biocatalyzed Propulsion Fluid§r for a §2§l1.25x§r parallel multiplier once you've reached §4UEV§r.

Additionally there are three modes that come unique to the Spinmatron:

- §dLight§r -> Gives increased speed in exchange for only being able to process [§9Voltage Tier - 3§r] recipes

- §6Normal§r -> No changes

- §aHeavy§r -> Grants the ability to craft Heavy Mode dependent recipes in exchange for reducing your parallels by §c§l32x§r and consuming §5Biocatalyzed Propulsion Fluid§r.

[note]Checkout the tooltip for more information![/note]

That step only comes after fusing Niobium and Zinc into Krypton Plasma. You get a rarer noble gas here than before, the next one will be Xenon. This recipe matches in speed with the next one, which uses Krypton to make Astral Titanium Plasma, by adding in the final plasma of the previous chain, Force Plasma! That's right, each chain needs everything from before to continue.

Once you have Astral Titanium Plasma, you can move on to the final mk2 step.

As usual, before you can make use of your Americium to make better wafers, you will need better water. This time, we're going to use plasma to rapidly heat up the water and then cool it back down.

Some of the mechanics may seem similar to how you set up the pH neutralization process, maybe you can expand on what you learned there?

[note]This multiblock is very picky about where its plasma and coolant input hatches go. If you can't figure out why it's not forming, chances are you forgot to place these hatches in the correct location. Use the hologram projector to see where they go.[/note]
Thaumium oreberries! No trapdoor-ed crucible required.

With both carrot and potato seeds in hand, you are now ready to deterministically breed your first new species. Sugarcane.

Plant your potato and carrot seeds next to a double crop stick placed on one of the fitting soil types shown in NEI.

[warn]Always check NEI for what soil to use when breeding a new crop.[/warn]

When breeding, it's important to ensure that the crop stick that will contain the new crop meets all the growth requirements of said new crop. [warn]Crops with special growth requirements will not appear unless all their growth requirements are met.[/warn] This includes things like soil, sub-soil, and light level.

Spacetime... separates?? Crazy world we're living in.

You will need a lot of both of these for future crafts throughout the rest of the game, so make sure to set up infrastructure that can handle the demand. Luckily for you, you only need a small amount of it for now.

You will eventually be able to use DTPF and QFT recipes to speed the process up significantly, but for now the Spinmatron should be able to handle production just fine.

[note]In addition to being a crafting ingredient, these can later be used to boost the performance of certain multiblocks, like the LNR, SSASS, & Vacuum Freezer.[/note]

[note]To craft these fluids before UMV energy hatches, overclock the Spinmatron with a high power UIV Laser Hatch

Note, Heavy Mode uses a lot of power.[/note]
You have two options here. Either you followed the NaK quests or you made a vacuum freezer to cool helium.
The next tier of Borosilicate glass is Infinity.

Check out the in-game guide! It'll tell you what's new in each version and has in-depth tutorials, visualizations, and more details than you'll find anywhere else in the pack!

NEI now automatically collapses similar items into one slot making browsing much faster! To collapse/uncollapse a group use ALT+LMB.
You can also create your own presets with custom groups!

[note]You can disable this functionality in NEI settings.[/note]

Also now NEI has JEI-like Advanced Search:

@ - search by mod (@minecraft)

[note]There are even more special characters that you can use but most of them are off by default (e.g. no need to use # to search in tooltip), below are all the special characters, check which ones are on/off in NEI settings.

Space is used as a logical AND between different conditions
# - search by tooltip (#UV-Tier)
& - search by id: (extratrees:door)
$ - search by ore dictionary ($ore)
% - search by subsets (%block)
| - logical or. multi-item search (wrench|hammer)
- - logical not. exclude items that match the following expression (-@minecraft)
" - multiple words wrapped in quotes are treated as one condition rather than several ("White Stained Glass")

Search Mode (apply on search parts, not full string):
Plain - simple string
Extended - allow only ?, * rules (by default)
Regex - allow full regex

In Extended Search Mode:
? - any character (@min?craft)
* - any few characters (@m*ft = @minecraft)
r/.../ - standard java regex (@r/m\w{6}ft/ = @minecraft)[/note]

[note]You can disable this functionality in NEI settings.[/note]

You can add bookmarks with the A key while hovering over an item, also:
Hold SHIFT to bookmark the whole recipe
Hold CTRL to bookmark number of items
Hold SHIFT + CTRL to bookmark both recipe and all the number of all the items it contains

The Fertilization Unit provides a massive boost to production, but requires you to use §2Enriched Fertilizer§r, and disables its 10x potency bonus. You'll need a steady supply of it in order to use this upgrade. It also increases power usage by 50%.

In exchange for the increased cost, the Fertilization Unit will increase the farm's harvest bonus by 50% and §omultiply§r it's growth speed bonus by 50%.

Only one Fertilization Unit is allowed per Industrial Farm

[note]The growth speed increase is applied as a final multiplier. This means that it's even more effective when used in conjunction with other upgrades.[/note]

As with all upgrades, the tier of the upgrade must match the tier of the seed bed.

...but they can be just as industrious as bees. These new electric companions are the perfect partners for Multiblock machines: maintenance, control, management—they can handle it all.

§6§lMaintenance§r
The §5§lDrone Centre§r is a newly developed machine. It requires no power—simply place a drone into the input bus, and it will begin operation.

Replacing the maintenance hatch on your Multiblock machines with a §lDrone Downlink Module§r will connect them to the drone network.

Once activated, the Drone Centre will automatically scan for all Downlink Modules within range and attempt to establish a connection with them. As long as the Drone Centre remains active, all connected Multiblock machines will [bold]never[/bold] suffer from annoying maintenance issues again!

[note]Goodbye, my precious 256x superconductor base ingots that were lost due to maintenance failures...[/note]


§6§lEntity Drones§r
Drones now exist as physical entities, unlocking several new features:

- When a maintenance issue occurs, a drone will deploy from the Downlink Module and perform a circular inspection flight around the affected machine.
- We've equipped drones with cameras! Click the §9§lObserve§r button in the GUI to access a real-time video feed from the drone. As long as you are in the same dimension, you can connect to the drone regardless of distance.
- While in observation mode, the WAILA HUD provides more information than normal. Additionally, aim your crosshair at a machine and press §2§lG§r to remotely open its GUI! This currently supports all GT machines and hatches. However, since drones are not equipped with robotic arms, item and fluid slots cannot be interacted with.


§6§lGroup Control & Statistics§r
The Drone Centre provides a powerful machine management interface, supporting grouping, remote observation, batch power control, and machine renaming:

- Connected machines can be organized into up to §664§r custom groups. Groups can be renamed, and a machine may belong to multiple groups.
- After selecting a group, power control actions will be applied to all machines within that group. Specifically, §6§lShift-clicking§r the shutdown button will set all machine controller covers to "Disable" mode.
- By enabling the built-in §5§lProduction Recorder§r, the Drone Centre can collect real-time statistics from all connected machines, including EU consumption, item throughput, and fluid throughput. All recorded data is stored directly inside the Drone Centre.


§6§lTiered Drones§r
[warn]Drones may crash during operation. The crash probability decreases from Tier 1 to Tier 3, and Tier 3 and Tier 4 Drones will never crash.[/warn]

Don't worry—if a backup drone is available in the input bus, the Drone Centre will consume it instantly.

Using higher-tier drones increases the operating range of the Drone Centre:

  §6•§r §l§3Drone (T1)§r
    - Range: §6128 blocks§r
    - Crash Chance: §61/28,800 per second§r (Average ~8 hours)

  §6•§r §l§3Drone (T2)§r
    - Range: §6512 blocks§r
    - Crash Chance: §61/172,800 per second§r (Average ~48 hours)

  §6•§r §l§3Drone (T3)§r
    - Range: §64,096 blocks§r
    - Crash Chance: §2Never§r

  §6•§r §l§3Drone (T4)§r
    - Range: §64,096 blocks (Automatic) / Infinite (Matching Key)§r
    - Crash Chance: §2Never§r
    - Cross-dimension: §2Yes§r


To enable cross-dimensional connections with a T4 Drone, configure matching keys on both the Drone Centre and the Downlink Module.

The Downlink Module can copy matching keys using a §lData Stick§r.

The residue produced from the DTPFs seems to have an interesting interaction with reality, as if it bends the universe to its will.

What if you combined it with some infinity and hypogen to excite it, and an energized tesseract as a way to fling it back and forth to the 4th Dimension?

Maybe then you could achieve the unachievable, a building block of the entire universe.

The base recipe is horrible, so definitely make the Eternal Coils for your DTPF first.

&g&#008CFF&#FF00E5Congrats on making it this far!§r

A bit expensive, but worth the QoL items you can craft with it.

Let's face it... nobody (sane) wants to do all of their research manually!

Now that you've learned how to collect nodes and create a wand recharging pedestal you can make the research completer. This quest shows the minimum required blocks but the structure can be up to 13 in length.

This machine will consume EU and eat nodes placed in the center of it in exchange for completing research notes given to it. If you're using a long machine it's highly recommended you use node stabilizers underneath your nodes to prevent them from destroying each other.

[note]Of course you need to §lresearch§r the Research Completer, you'll find it in the electro-magic tools tab.[/note]
Bigger, better, faster. The Large Electric Compressor does about what you would expect.
No Description

You might be saying, "So I've just purchased this thing, now what?" We have just the solution for you!

The §5§nAssembling Package§r is the most important upgrade to the NAC™ platform, allowing for the creation of circuits with your processed components. This isn't just another assembler - it's the most important machine you'll ever own.

Provide the Nanochip Assembly Matrix with a Vacuum Conveyor Input (sold separately) containing the necessary components, and all the circuits you have ever wanted will be yours!

§oPower costs may be high. The NAC™ offers a guarantee that modules will not powerfail, but offers no guarantees on your existing power network.
The next tier of Borosilicate glass is Transcendent.
These should help with building more BBFs, your local riverbeds and riparian zones will thank you.

Automating crafting table recipes is a good first step to automate your processes.

To achieve this goal, get yourself a crafting logistics pipe and a logistics crafting table.

You can import a crafting table recipe into a logistics crafting table and you can click the "import" button on the crafting logistics pipes GUI that is connected to the crafting table to import the recipe into the pipe.

You should have quite the collection of single block Steam machines by now. While these may have gotten you through processing small amounts of materials, there will be a time when you will have to process a multitude of items. This is where Multiblocks come in.

While these Multiblocks have a material cost that is way higher than their single block counterparts, they have certain bonuses: they use less Steam, and they can process recipes in parallel, which means that a single recipe cycle can craft multiple items at once, if the Steam provided is enough to sustain it.

They do however have some quirks that need to be taken care of:

-These Multiblocks require §4§lvery specific§r I/O blocks, use only those that are part of the quest
-They process up to 8 items, where the Basic Tier is made of Bronze and High Pressure Tier is made of Steel (checkout the Multiblock Preview in NEI which will show you different levels of tiers)
-The Tier and amount of parallel processing can be seen via WAILA if you are looking at the Controller Block

[note]With this quest, you have started your journey with Mass Processing. However, don't get too excited quite yet. While there are some Multiblocks accessible in the Steam Age, most of them only unlock in EV or later, including better versions of these Multiblocks.[/note]

Stocking bus but better!

This one can pull first 16 types of items automatically from ME network, which can be useful for some automations. Minimum stack size and refresh time can be configured in the GUI.

[note]Using this on your main network is probably not a very good idea.[/note]

If you want to go further than Mars you need a better rocket fuel. From here on out, there is only one choice: the ExxonMobil Chemical Plant. If you don't have one yet, you should have a look at it. It has 4 separate tiering systems and might be a bit overwhelming at first. 

[note]Check out the quest for the Chemical Plant in the [quest]Multiblock Goals[/quest] quest tab for more information.[/note]

§6If you already automated one of the upcoming rocket fuels, simply hold 64 cells of it to skip all quests leading up to it!

The next tier of Borosilicate glass is Neutronium.

This magnificent breed of Bee produces a whole plethora of useful resources, including endless amounts of Lapis, Energium, and Lapotron Dust. However, they are somewhat picky when it comes to breeding; you'll need Energium and Lapis Bees as parents, and the process must take place on the Moon under icy temperatures.
No Description

The §5§lThermic Heating Device§r is the multiblock edition of the Fluid Heater, offering §6§l8§r parallels per voltage tier at over §2§l2x§r the speed and for only §3§l90%§r of the EU cost.

This can be useful now for Bauxite and Ruthenium processing but if you choose not to use it then definitely keep it in mind for later as you will eventually want it for Growth Catalyst!

The Draconic Fusion Crafted has 5 tier of casings, each an upgrade of the previous tier.

Each new tier of casings allows you to make better Cores, eventually ending at the Chaotic Core.

[note]Each casing tier above recipe tier grants one perfect (4/4) overclock![/note]

After unlocking Carbon Nanites, we can now use it to extract the needed lanthanide resources in large quantities.

Of course you better be ready. It's expensive until you got the Nano Forge.

As a bonus, there's even a §2§l50%§r chance that you get your Netherite Scrap Seed back to run the recipe over again.

And can hold 24 types.

A great source of §mstargates§r naquadah.

Stargatium leaves will 4x your naquadah ore.

The Mark of the Falling Tower is among the most powerful magic you can achieve in GTNH. It allows you to summon a huge meteor full of various GT ores right where you want it. All you need is a particular catalyst item and a good amount of LP. Even better, you sometimes get access to ores before you could get them normally! Check out NEI for all the possible meteors. For example you can start by looking at the uses of a Pufferfish.

The meteor requires at least a singular block to see the sky above the master ritual stone. You can use the alchemical component Terrae to increase the radius of the meteor by 1. Using Orbis Terrae increases the radius by 2.

The meteor deals some damage but it does not deal environmental/block damage. Just be weary if you have villagers or important mobs nearby. The size of the meteor also increases the damage & radius by an enormous amount.

Multiblock miners can mine out the various ores spawned from the meteor, but there are other options too!

While the Forge Hammer is quite fast already, why not build this upscaled version and make it even faster? With the Steam Presser, you can unleash the full force of steam on whatever material you feed it. Watch blocks break apart and rods get smashed together faster than ever-at least until you gain access to more advanced technology.

§3The Steam Presser can only process recipes up to LV Tier.

UEV Superconductors, another great Infinity sink. You can make the Celestial Tungsten and Advanced Nitinol in a laser engraver directly, but this is quite slow. Perhaps consider using the Celestial Tungsten plasma line?

The advanced machines you are now creating require more advanced materials, as well as more advanced ways to process them. In ZPM, you can construct the Hot Isostatic Pressurization Unit, an upgrade to the Large Electric Compressor. This multiblock heats material to extreme temperatures under extreme pressure, allowing it to create superdense plates with minimal imperfections.

The HIP Unit heats up while it is running, and must be given some time to cool off. If it reaches its maximum heat threshold, it will significantly slow your recipes or even void the inputs. Use better coils to increase how long it will take to overheat, and use Heat Sensor Hatches to automate it properly.

[note]Can perform compression recipes which say "Requires HIP Unit" in NEI.[/note]

The Ring of the Sky is a very powerful ring. In its highest form, it grants mastery over all three Sky Rings at once, a three-for-one combo!

[note]These infusions are more powerful. They won't destroy your pearl, but they will drain it, requiring a separate infusion to recharge it before it can be reused.[/note]

§5§lDehydrating§r this §2Prismatic Naquadah Composite Slurry§r over the top of §2Tungsten Carbide§r & §2Lead foil§r creates a completely §3Radiation-Proof Composite Sheet§r. This will prove to be very useful in protecting your environment from radiation-emitting structures.
No Description

Now for something a bit more complicated, Stone Lilies.

This species from the clade §oLilium§o §rproduces stone dust from its petals.

To determine how you can breed it, just check the NEI page for Stone Lily Seeds. The required prerequisite species can be obtained either by breeding, or directly from the overworld (if you are [warn]boring[/warn])

[note]Remember that deterministic breeding will always take priority over pool based breeding[/note]. So unless you have access to a small pool including the Stone Lily, it will likely be quicker to follow the direct path.

One of the last wires you have to make for now.

[note]Hope you're not using these for hooking up power to your pre-existing machines. Consider the Infinity Wire.[/note]

You want to start using your new Europium to make even better wafers, but it turns out that your old methods of creating purified water are no longer enough. You will need to use the Flocculation Purification Unit to make even better purified water first. To run this machine, you will need large amounts of Polyaluminium Chloride, but luckily you can get all your Chlorine back if you properly recycle the waste liquid.

These flowers reach beyond the basics of the initial 12, and may have some slightly more niche uses.

[warn]Necrobloom's poisonous thorns aren't the only thing you'll have to worry about, it also starts spreading weeds when its growth stat is above 7.[/warn]

You want to rush this as soon as possible.

Every L of Universium matters.

Works like stocking input bus but for fluids.

[note]You need only one to complete the quest.[/note]

[quest]Overflow Void and Sticky Cards[/quest]

§6Overflow Void Card:§r 

Overflow Void Cards will cause the ME Storage Cell to void excess inputs.

§6Sticky Card:§r 

Sticky Cards are useful if you want your ME System to only store a filtered item in one location across your entire network.

[warn]Be careful where you use sticky cards, as they can cause your passive systems to jam.[/warn]

The Binnie's Genetics machines will rely on Growth Medium in either a little, or a lot. If you can't make too much of it, then you'll need to rely on other passive generation to keep the machines constantly supplied for researching genes. If you can make a lot of Growth Medium, then you can use it in a closed loop in Incubators to duplicate some of the mod's resources you have previously produced just once.

It requires:
* Sugar: The easy one here, and remember multiple bee species can produce it too.
* Bones (whole bones, not meal): mob farm, animal traps, goofy conversions.
* Wood Ash: Smelt some saplings.
* Mulch: There are a lot of ways to do this, but consider Peat bees since you're already going for the bees.

This quest is just a little nudge that you should passively produce Growth Medium, which means being able to passively produce all of these ingredients.

After embracing the dark side you get access to the new even bigger dark steel chest... perhaps another upgrade will be available in the future?

[note]Just as with the previous chests you can also upgrade with a fitting upgrade item.[/note]

The IndustrialCraft2 Teleporter allows for teleportation between 2 connected teleporters.
It requires energy storing block right next to it due to the massive power demand.

[note]The energy required is determined by the distance between the teleporters and amount of items in the inventory.[/note]

[note]The teleporter is quite buggy according to the official wiki.[/note]

The Wireless Connector also has a HUB upgrade! These Wireless HUBs can be linked to many wireless connectors at once so you won't need to spam a chunk of 1:1 connectors into one spot. Keep in mind there is still a 32 channel limitation.

[note]Great for placing on controller faces![/note]

If you ever thought that the standard super tanks or quantum tanks were still too small then the YOTTank is the next option.

The YOTTank compared to the TFFT might only be able to store one fluid instead of 25 fluids. However it makes up for this downside by not having to share any of the fluid storage space with any other fluids. It also does not require any energy input or maintenance requirements.

If all you want to do is store a large amount of one fluid type then look no further then the YOTTank. It has a special ME input hatch for ae2 connections while having expandable storage blocks. The tank can be both upgraded with the fluid storage blocks and can be increased in height to hold any more fluid.

So if you want to store your fluid in style then look no further then the YOTTank.

[note]If you're having issues searching for the fluid storage blocks for the YOTTank in NEI then search for: fluid cell block[/note]
