Once you have the two plasmas from before, fuse them together into a new one, Neon Plasma. If you were to use this directly, you could get Neon! There are other, more useful materials to get later in this process, so keep a lookout for those.

However, this is not the final plasma in mk1 recipes. To get it, you need to do the last activation step, which exists in all three chains, and involves adding a non-plasma related material, of the appropriate GT tier, to obtain the powergen plasma. The material you need here is Arcanite, one you probably have used before. This step requires you to preferably automate it with ABS, and have a steady supply of Thorium 232.

If you look at the last recipe, you'll see it's 144L Neon Plasma input to 1000L Force Plasma output. This multiplying makes it so that step, and all final steps, are the slowest ones. You will need 0.144 Neon Plasma reactors for every Force Plasma reactor, which means that 1 Neon reactor feeds nearly 7 Force reactors (6.9444... reactors, more precisely).

Once you get Force Plasma, this is the end of the mk1 fusion chain. Force Plasma is a 150M fuel value plasma, which means it has a 53.5% penalty with Infinity Catalyst in XL Plasma Generators. This is better than Helium Plasma with its 86.1% penalty but still not great for power generation. You probably don't need this in ZPM, but it'll be a stepping stone for your future progression.

A lot of recipes take fluids. But crafting modules only have slots for items...

Introducing the Fluid Crafting Upgrade. It will allow you to allocate one kind of fluid for the craft. Drag one fluid cell containing the fluid you need into the fluid slot and set the correct amount.

Don't forget to bind it to a fluid satellite pipe. The way it binds is identical to the satellite logistics pipe.

These hold 2,097,152 units of essentia.

And can hold 36 types.

The MV Lathe isn't a completely necessary upgrade (assuming you can get ahold of an Exquisite Green Sapphire), but it will grant you a boost in productivity nonetheless should you choose to invest in one.

§lFinally, you have done it§r! You can now upgrade your QFT to the ultimate tier by replacing your §3Infinity Infused Manipulator§r casings with §3SpaceTime Continuum Ripper§r casings. This final upgrade unlocks all skips, including the §6bio cell skip, the kevlar skip and the radox + xenoxene skip§r.

Even with all previous upgrades, the final leap remained out of reach. Chemical skips for foundational components used in the earlier stages of the QFT, such as bioware circuits, were still impossible - §ountil now§r. Reaching the theoretical limit of the QFT demands a material far beyond anything seen before, hidden deep within the second half of the Naquadah line.

The material you require will be your magnum opus - the §3Black Body Naquadria Supersolid§r. This extraordinary substance acts as a perfect black body - absorbing all radiation without reflection - and behaves as a supersolid, flowing like a fluid with zero viscosity. Combining these properties in a single material ensures stable, effortless quantum energy flow at any voltage level, even at the MAX tier!

With this breakthrough, your QFT is fully unlocked, capable of creating components up to the UHV tier.

Reinforced Components can only take your EoH so far. Another upgrade is needed to assemble its stronger parts.

By incorporating Black Dwarf Matter into their structure, Refined Components remain stable beneath even greater spacetime distortions.

First available in LV, the Mob Repellator prevents mobs from spawning in its radius. It works without power, but with it has a higher range.

[note]You only need one to complete the quest.[/note]

A great source of lead.

Plumbilia leaves will 4x your lead ore.

Once you get ZPM tier power (2 LuV energy hatches), this method is much better.

Melt the Samarium Chloride and reduce it with Lanthanum in a Distillation Tower. Then recover Lanthanum Chloride by electrolysis.
Coppon fiber, while it won't make a nice sweater, it will 4x your copper ore. It can also be processed directly to copper dust.

Now that you've enjoyed your exotic cookies, let's keep going, shall we?

Welcome to Insanely Ultimate Voltage, a very fun tier with many new large multiblocks to play with! At first, this tier is mainly about solving your DTPF catalyst problems and getting to Eternal Coils. Afterward, you are introduced to late game content like the Forge of the Gods, the Bose-Einstein Condensate Apparatus, and the Black Hole Compressor that you will use until the end of the modpack!

This tier also introduces a few QoL additions, like the Crafting Input Proxy, Uncertainty Resolver, and the Thaumometric Essentia Cell.

You also gain access to the Dyson Swarm and the Semi-Stable Antimatter Stabilization Sequencer, two incredibly powerful ways to generate power.

With Shirabon now acquired, you can finally create catalysts to use in your Tier 4 QFT.

[note]These are extremely expensive, you may want to look into DTPF convergence, and faster means of creating Metastable Oganesson before you can make many of these.[/note]

Maintaining multiblocks can be a pain, especially if you prefer performing other tasks around your base.  
To solve this, a certain engineer developed the Magical Maintenance Hatch — a simple maintenance hatch that fixes all your maintenance problems using centi-vis.

Simply attach the hatch to any multiblock and keep it within reach of a centi‑vis network. The device will consume 2500 centi‑vis of each primal aspect to resolve any maintenance problems the multiblock may develop.

[note]The hatch stores 5000 centi-vis of each primal aspect. This means it takes on average 1000 ticks (50 seconds) to reach the internal buffer.[/note]

[warn]If you're having trouble making it work, make sure you place the hatch near a Vis Relay or an energized node with each primal aspect.[/warn]

The Conduit Probe is an incredibly useful tool for managing and troubleshooting your Ender IO conduit networks.

It features two modes:

• §lProbe Mode§r
Right-click an Energy Conduit to view detailed network information
Right-click an Item Conduit to simulate item transport using the item in your hand
Right-click a Redstone Conduit to see connection details, including signal levels sent and received

• §lCopy/Paste Mode§r
Shift + Right-click a conduit connection to copy its settings
Right-click another conduit to paste those settings

This is especially useful when configuring multiple machines with identical setups and helps prevent mistakes.

You can switch between modes by: Using Shift + Mouse Wheel, or pressing the §nYeta Wrench Mode§r keybind (unbound by default) while holding the probe.

Sick of having to swap out lenses or make tens of laser engravers for your cleanroom? The Hyper-Intensity Laser Engraver is here for you. This multiblock can handle all of your engraving needs.

By using more powerful §lLaser Source Hatches§r in the structure, you can gain more parallels and run higher tier recipes.

[note]Laser source hatches are usually used for power transmission, but not here! No matter what laser hatch you use, it will NOT change the power input of HILE - it is determined by the standard energy hatch as usual.[/note]

GregTech now makes &z&qice creams§r§r. Yes, really.

Somewhere out there is a machine that turns... something... into ice cream. Lots of flavors. Some good, some weird, some questionable.

Go find it and see what you get.
Some easy copper for your steam age machines.
Expensive but worth it. These will allow you to create powerful machines like the QFT and the Foundry.

Created by all tiers of the Eye of Harmony, Raw Stellar Plasma can be used for several things including Stellar Catalyst.

[note]You may want to be careful with this material, as later running EOHs with Astral Arrays requires this instead of Hydrogen and Helium, so make sure to never fully run out![/note]

Tired of all those mob noises coming from the depths? Consider making the §5Concrete Backfiller§r. This multiblock will fill the area underneath it with concrete in a §316§r block radius; patching all caves and air spots that might be lying underneath. 

Simply provide it with Light Concrete and let it do the rest!

If you have a stable Samarium resource acquisition, refining Samarium Ore should be the best way to get Samarium.

As the first step, dissolve some Samarium Ore Concentrate Dust or Crushed Samarium Ore (you probably don't have access to this option yet) in Nitric Acid in a Digester to get Muddy Samarium Rare Earth Solution. Thorium and Phosphate are retained in the form of a solid slag powder.

Then transfer the muddy solution to a Dissolution Tank and continue to soak it in nitric acid. The undissolved powder is then meticulously filtered out, yielding some Cerium.

Then dilute the result with water to adjust the pH.
No Description

If you want to pursue the breeding path toward Lapotron and Pyrotheum Bees, you'll need to start by breeding some Furious Bees. They can be bred in the nether using Fiendish and Embittered Bees, with the latter found in the wilds of the Nether.

Beware: Furious Bees spawn fire charges downward, so make sure your breeding area is fireproof!
No Description

From now on, you'll be dealing with extremely slow recipes.

Consider finishing up your QFTs and upgrading or replacing your old infrastructure to save on TPS.

You should definitely upgrade your power generation and infrastructure to handle millions of recipes.

The Eye of Harmony will be consuming most of your power before it starts generating more than it uses.

May Colen have mercy on your soul.

[note]Welcome to the waiting lounge.[/note]

With access to even more advanced materials, you can upgrade your QFT to tier 3 by replacing the §3Cosmic Fabric Manipulator§r casings with §3Infinity Infused Manipulator§r casings. This tier unlocks two powerful new skips: the §6final naqline skip§r and the §6stem cell skip§r.

This new casing requires even more advanced materials still, including the §3Superconductor Rare-Earth Composite§r, which can only be crafted in a tier 2 QFT. Unlike §3Hyper-Stable Self-Healing Adhesive§r, which focused on structural integrity, this composite is designed purely for energy transmission. With automatic self-repair now fully handled, we can shift our focus to increasing the energy flow between components and into the multi itself.

Standard superconductors break down under quantum stress - but this composite eliminates all resistance across the outer shell. Its precisely layered rare-earth elements create such gradual transitions that quantum flow moves effortlessly, with no losses or destabilizing effects.

§oWhat will you discover next?!

After seeing how slow Shirabon is to make, you might want to upgrade your Fusion setup.

Like its predecessor, the MK4, this version also supports 4/4 OC. Hopefully, this will make your Metastable Oganesson issues a bit more manageable.

[note]You can specify the batch amount in the GUI if you don't want it to handle one-tick recipes.[/note]

The Overclocked Growth Acceleration Unit allows for the overclocking of the Industrial Farm as with other Multiblocks, and enables the use of a single Multi-Amp Energy Hatch. Each overclock doubles production and input costs.

[warn]You cannot use regular Energy Hatches when using a Multi-Amp Energy Hatch.[/warn]

You may only install one of these units per Industrial Farm.

The Overclocked Growth Acceleration Unit will not work if a Growth Acceleration Unit is installed.

As with all upgrades, the tier of the upgrade must match the tier of the seedbed.
No Description
Too blue blueberries. Probably wouldn't want to eat these.
The Precision Laser Engraver does not have many functions in LV, but is needed to create Cut Firestone which can later be filled with lava.
In case you needed to mass produce witchery crops... for some reason

The §aSuperb§r Spacetime Compression Field Generator allows for up to §lT5§r recipes which produce §l4608L§r of Black Dwarf Matter per successful batch.

The §aSuperb§r Time Dilation Field Generator grants a §293.75%§r time reduction for any recipe ran in the EoH, but reduces the likelihood of success by §c37%§r.

The §aSuperb§r Stabilisation Field Generator will boost the success chance of the EoH by §220%§r, but will decrease the yield by §c20%§r and increase the power cost by §c20%§r.
Ice Cream Trophy
This is the last capacitor so we can't get much higher unfortunately.

The Electric Jetpack may be useful for flight, but it doesn't seem to last very long. 

If only there was an integrated upgradable battery pack you could keep on your player to extend its range...

Oh wait, there is!

The §5§lCharge Pack§r can be used as a battery pack for charging items both in your hotbar and armor equip to your person. Simply place it in the belt bauble slot and it should be fully functional! The HV one should serve you nicely for now.

[note]You can upgrade the Charge Pack as you unlock items that require higher voltages for charging. The Charge Pack will charge anything of-tier or lower- but not higher.[/note]

You can find amethyst blocks, crystals, and calcite blocks in underground geodes. 

During the Steam Age, calcite blocks become incredibly useful because you can put them into a Forge Hammer to obtain valuable calcite dust, which is used for crafting the Bricked Blast Furnace. They can usually be found between Y-levels 5 and 46.

Amethyst can also be mined and used as a source of silicon dioxide. One amethyst block drops 9 amethyst dust, making it a great option for obtaining silicon dioxide.
[note]
You can use an Ore Finder with calcite dust inserted into it to locate calcite deposits more easily.[/note]

Fabricating Crystal SoCs with LuAG is so much faster than directly engraving crystal chips! They can also be used for Raw Advanced Crystal Chip.

Remember to keep some LuAG gems for growing more crystals.

You might already have a Steam Multiblock or the Large Sifter. But in EV, IV, and the following tiers you unlock multiblocks for (almost) every GT machine. And some more on top of that!

Most of them are made to do the same GT processing as the singleblock machines you've been using, but much faster. The multis can have up to three bonuses: energy savings, faster recipe time and parallels, which mean that a single recipe cycle can craft multiple items at once, if the power provided is enough to sustain it.

The variety of structures and intricacies of these new multis can go far beyond simpler multis like the EBF, LCR or VF. While some are simple cuboids, others come with more diverse mechanics and conditions to work properly. In return, they can be extremely powerful, so keep an eye out for them!
This is an all-in-one solution to generate oxygen. Just provide power (continuous) and Seeds (once).
betterquesting:10.name:8: A Better Way To Generate Oxygen

betterquesting:10.desc:8:
Definitely consider this for the improved Magnetohydrodynamically Constrained Star Matter recipe. You'll also need it to make MHDCSM parts.

Kickstarting the loop is expensive and RNG-based. You need 20,736 L of Universium for the first 5 attempts and a catalyst.

The QFT recipe has a 25% chance of yielding Eternity per attempt. You should probably boost the QFT with plasmas and focus on producing Eternity.

[note]Did you know the QFT has a fluid mode? It could be useful for extracting molten Shirabon. Just right-click the controller with a §ascrewdriver§r.[/note]

[note]Building a full beacon out of Eternity Blocks might be a bit extravagant, don't you think?[/note]
Let's make some NaK coolant!
Another way to automatically chisel blocks to your heart's content, this time sponsored by GregoriousT himself!

Now that you have an Algae Pond, why not create Golden-Brown Algae for some cheap Ammonia? The ratio is about 50 mB of Ammonia per Golden-Brown Algae. At EV, each cycle has a 90% chance to produce 4 Golden-Brown Algae and takes 60 seconds.

This process does not require a Chemical Plant, but it does require an MV Assembler and an MV Fluid Extractor at minimum.

Ever take a deep breath while roaming the nether and start to feel lightheaded or dizzy? Turns out that's from the highly toxic air. There may be no saving our lungs, but at least we can take advantage of this dense air for our own material gain!

If you haven't already been taking advantage of the Nether Air for it's sulfurous properties, (talking to you, Nitrobenzene lovers) you'll need to take advantage of it now for making §4Nether Semifluid§r.

Setup a §5§lVacuum Freezer§r in the nether and attach an§2§l Air Intake Hatch§r to start collecting the Nether Air. You can move onto the next step once you've started Semifluid production.

This is a multiblock acid generator available at EV and above. It takes in volatile acids and bases to produce energy through a highly exothermic chemical reaction. These include hydroxides of various alkali metals, giving your LNE a boost of efficiency from 150% up to 500%! Using higher-tier bases also has a reduced rate of consumption, but producing them at a passive rate may prove to be a challenge.

However, you can't just get away with burning acids like that! Burning any acids will produce Toxic Residue based on the fuel value and liters burnt for each tick. Acids with a higher fuel value will produce more Toxic Residue per liter, but overall they still produce less residue than acids with a lower fuel value for the same amount of EU. When Toxic Residue gets too high, the engine will EXPLODE! (As compensation, the engine supports TecTech Dynamo Hatches)

How do you avoid that, then? Firstly, the Toxic Residue will naturally decay. The rate of decay is based on the existing amount of Toxic Residue and also acts every tick. However, it is not very fast, so you will want to boost it. This is done through robot arms as they can help clean the surface of the LNE. Using higher-tier robot arms and multiple robot arms can help clean it faster, though be careful as they may be consumed! The rate of decay and the overall capacity of Toxic Residue is based on the tier of your multiblock, which are unlocked at EV, IV and LuV respectively. Using alkali to boost your multiblock also does not affect the rate of Toxic Residue build-up, so make sure to select the highest tier you can get! Finally, Toxic Residue increases randomly, so you can use a Toxic Residue Sensor Hatch to help detect a sudden increase and automate your engine accordingly.

After finally getting the §2Prismarine Precipitate§r, the logical next step is to crystallize the Prismarine into a §3Prismatic Crystal§r. Using a §2Magneto-Resonance Lens§r we can do this in a §5§lLaser Engraver§r with the assistance of §2Molten Crystalline Alloy§r.

The Beam Crafter allows you to craft items using two beam-like inputs! If you are familiar with the Target Chamber, this works the same way, but with two beams instead of one.

Each Beam Crafting recipe requires two particle inputs. You must provide enough of both types of particles to finish the craft. The progress of a craft in the Beam Crafter depends entirely on the number of provided particles, but will draw power the entire time. 

[note]This also means that the speed of the craft is entirely dependent on how quickly you can provide particles, and as a result the WAILA estimate is likely inaccurate.[/note]

Failing to provide particles consistently is not an issue! The machine will continue to draw power while it waits for more particles, but you will not lose crafting progress.

[note]If enough of one of the input particles is provided, providing more of that particle has no effect on the progress of the craft.[/note]
No Description
No Description

After meddling with the 4th Dimension, you've finally discovered a way to access its unlimited Essentia supply. The Thaumometric Essentia Cell is your tool for extracting Essentia from this boundless source—think of it as your unlimited magic credit card.

The Growth Acceleration Unit increases the growth speed of the crops found within the Industrial Farm. Each one increases growth speed by 100% and power usage by 125%.

The Growth Acceleration Unit will not work if an Overclocked Growth Acceleration Unit is installed.

As with all upgrades, the tier of the upgrade must match the tier of the seedbed.

So you want to move essentia from your Alchemical furnace to your warded Jars without getting it all gunked up with different essentia types?

Well you came to the right place, with the use of buffered tubes and your handy wand you can move your essentia in tubes to fill all your jars without having to manually break and replace one jar at a time.

To create a simple setup place the buffered tubes in a main line from your Arcane Alembic with tubes coming out of the main buffered tube line. These standard tubes will then go directly into a warded jar. To get the essentia to flow correctly into the buffered tubes, shift-right-click the output side of the buffered tube with your wand until it is red. This will change the band to a red band which will limit the suction of the Essentia.

The Essentia will be forced from the buffered tube to a normal tube then into your Warded jars. Chain your buffered tubes as needed until all your Warded Jars will fit.
§4
Note: This system will get gunked up with essentia if any of your Warded Jars are full!

§rIf you would like more information please check out the guide 'A Thaumaturge Guide to Laying Pipe' by xlstadal for more in-depth Thaumcraft 4 Tube knowledge.

§9§n[url]https://docs.google.com/document/d/1fMvJ5HbeOdy4UgBMe47cggis02idxWoMDgK81SgowEo[/url]§r
Granite dust has a hefty amount of minerals trapped within it, you just need enough processing power to actually separate them out.

An armor set worthy of a God. This breastplate provides the user infinite creative flight and removes all negative debuffs.

While wearing the complete set, you are completely unkillable.

A buffer of 64 per slot is never big enough. Just look at red alloy ingot for example. It can only hold 16 recipes worth of redstone at once. You don't really want the items to just zoom around the pipes while waiting for the machine to make room... You want to have a big chest buffering items to be processed.

Introducing the Satellite Logistics Pipes. It provides additional input into the recipe incorporating it.

The pipe runs on a numerical frequency system, with the whole server sharing the number pool. This ensures that 2 separate systems can be connected to each other without conflict.

You can "connect" a crafting module with one satellite pipe by selecting the correct frequency of the satellite part. Multiple modules can connect to a single satellite pipe.

Satellite pipe inputs are the 3 gray slots on the right of the 9 slots of the module. Only items in the 3 gray slots will be sent to satellite pipes.

§cNote: Ensure your satellite pipe has any frequency other than 0. A satellite pipe with frequency 0 will not work.
Seems like you really want to swim in essentia?
Shimmerleaf can get you easy quicksilver, no Cinnabar required!

High pressure, superheated loads of energy. Check the XL Steam Turbine quest above for an explanation of the mechanics shared across all turbines.

This XL Turbine is exactly the same as the XL Steam Turbine in the way it upgrades from the regular multi: the only accepted fluid is Superheated Steam, and nothing else works. They are meant to be built together, since any steam setups you might have at this point will surely be using the two.

Pipe some liquid Instrumentum into this bad boy and you can repair anything with Vanilla durability!

§3[note]Doesn't work on Blood Magic potions, TiC tools, GT tools and tools with charge. Every point of Instrumentum equals eight points of durability.[/note]

After you've gotten ahold of some §2Prismarine Solution§r, combine it with §2Nitrobenzene§r in a §5§lChemical Bath§r in order to create a §3rich solution mixture§r. 

Additionally, you will start to receive some §3Prismarine-Contaminated Hydrogen Peroxide§r byproduct.
This tablet holds the power of gaia in your hands, it gives infinite mana to any tool you have...
Are you draining an ocean?

We can process Crystal Processing Units in a Laser Engraver to get the Crystal SoC. But as our demand for circuits gradually increases, this method of production is becoming untenable. We need a more advanced way to mass produce Crystal SoCs!

For that we use a new material, Cerium-doped Lutetium Aluminium Garnet (Ce:LuAG). LuAG has better performance when making Crystal SoCs - in fact it is a laser crystal material.

First, mix Lutetium, Aluminium, Oxygen, and a little Cerium to get the material blend. Then put the blend with Molten Lutetium into an Autoclave to get a regular LuAG gem. If you have already got Oganesson you can also directly use that. As the second step, use the LuAG gem and more of the blend to produce Exquisite LuAG Gems.

After you get the first gem, you can also use your Autoclave to grow crystals. Using the Vacuum Furnace might be a better choice to produce Exquisite LuAG Gems.

Lutetium, Lutetium, it needs a lot of Lutetium. How will you get a lot of Lutetium? Check out the Powerful Nuclear Physics quest tab!
One step closer to your goal, these bees can be bred from Furious and Demonic Bees while inside the Nether. Just like their Furious counterparts, they will spawn fire charges while working.

Once upon a time, these were optional and commonly skipped. Now that UMV CoAL is gated behind BEC, however, it may be worth making a set for cheaper UIV components.

You will also need 20 of them to craft Quantum Circuits in the NAC at UMV.

...or you could just make extra UMV ones.

[note]The UIV CoAL requires Superdense Transcendent Metal Plates, which can only be crafted in the BHC.[/note]
This is a wide ranging category, but each crop here has some amount of utility. Almost all will likely be helpful as you develop.
The Stray is a variety of Skeleton you will find in colder biomes. Watch out for their arrows; they can have a slowness effect!

Now that you're in IV, you can unlock the next set of upgrades for Mechanical Armor, gaining more slots and new augments.

The quantum energy core will allow your armor to charge at IV voltage and equip tier 2 augments.

The frames in this tier provide 5 augment slots. The adaptive frame uniquely has a §6Pri§asma§dtic§r slot that will accept an augment of any category!
No Description

Woah, a new metal?

By combining the forces of your newly created §2Enriched Naquadah§r and §2Prismatic Acid§r in the §5§lAlloy Blast Smelter§r, you find that a new metal forms; §3Prismatic Naquadah§r. 

[warn]This extremely strong, yet shockingly pliant material will be used in quite a few different structures and materials going forth.[/warn]
The Oberon bee allows you to obtain resources from Oberon.

Those Digital Singularities, while offering a vast amount of space, felt constraining with their ability to store only one type of item... So you came up with something different this time. Having reached the peak of technology, you managed to create and contain an Artificial Universe within a Storage Cell. This allows you to store up to 63 different types of items without the universe collapsing in on itself.

Using Hypogen's strange slime-like properties, and Bio Catalyst Medium, a new wafer can be manufactured.

[note]These wafers are not that useful currently, only being used for cheaper ZPM circuits, however they will come up again in UIV[/note]

§dWhere were you when these took 60 seconds at UHV...

Did you really think a single chest would suffice for your storage needs? Come back when you've made at least a few.

[note]You can place chests next to each other by chiseling every other chest into a trapped chest![/note]
betterquesting:10.name:8: §9§lThe Beginnings of a Humble Chest Monster

betterquesting:10.desc:8:
Tired of being constrained by augment slots? The constantly shifting properties of Infinity make it an ideal material for a modular frame.

This final frame provides 5 slots of every category, including prismatic.

The Ring of the Earth is a very powerful ring. In its highest form, it grants mastery over all three Earth Rings at once, a three-for-one combo!

[note]These infusions are more powerful. They won't destroy your pearl, but they will drain it, requiring a separate infusion to recharge it before it can be reused.[/note]

At long last... the final ingredient needed before making Netherite materials.

Through the combination of the Netherite Nanoparticles and Hellish Metal in the §5§lEBF§r, you can create §4Intensely Bonded Netherite Nanoparticles.§r As an added bonus for those who have invested in bees, using the combs from a Netherite Queen, will reward you with §2§l2x§r the product.

These are not only the primary pre-requisite ingredients for the Dense Netherite Plate that you need for the §3§lFusion Reactor§r, but also the pre-requisite material for making the rest of the Netherite parts after you have created one; so be sure to stockpile and manufacture as many of these nanoparticles as you can. 

[note]Keep in mind this recipe does require Naquadah coils![/note]

You didn't think we were going to force you to use the Mass Solidifier for the rest of the game, did you? Imagine being compelled to make hundreds of those for gate... that would just be cruel!

§lIntroducing the Exo-Foundry!§r 

The §5§lExo-Foundry§r is a direct upgrade to the §5Mass Solidifier§r, and just a few of them will be powerful enough to support your infrastructure for the rest of the game. But let's start off with one for now.

There are three separate tiers, and seven different modules. Each tier allows you to place more modules on the machine, starting with two at T1 and ending with four at T3. Each module has its own special set of abilities, and you can combine them in unique ways to get a Foundry that best fits your infrastructure.

The questbook will explain the function of each module type, but the best way to view all of the information together is to use the GUI of the Foundry itself and the tooltips visible on the individual blocks. 

[note]For even more information regarding the precise mathematics of module combinations and interactions, you can also check out the Wiki: [url]https://wiki.gtnewhorizons.com/wiki/Exo-Foundry[/url][/note]

Now that you've created the Neutronium Compressor, you finally have access to the Elastic Singularity for enhancing your §5§lL.A.T.E.X.§r cable coater.

With it, you will receive a §2§l25%§r rubber discount, §2§l2x§r the parallels, and the ability to use multiamp hatches. 

You are now truly a cable master.

If you have been processing the ores you have gathered until now, you will have come across a variety of crushed ores. Since these are quite dirty, you will have to clean them up to get certain byproducts. But how do you clean up this multitude of crushed ores? By using a Steam Purifier, of course! With a steady flow of Steam and a bit of Water, you can wash away impurities and get Purified Crushed Ores in no time.

If you're tired of waiting forever for your ores to clean up, this is your fix!

§3This Multiblock has two modes, the default Washer Mode and a Simple Washer Mode. Simple Washers process ores considerably faster, but they do not give byproducts. Like other Multiblocks, the mode can be toggled by the respective button inside the GUI or by right-clicking the Controller with a Screwdriver. Since all ore washing recipes are LV, this Multiblock can run all of them.
An Infinity Catalyst bee for your late-game Infinity needs.

Another Stargate recipe, another trophy. You know the drill by now: submit two legacy Stargates' worth of materials and receive one cute little trophy. 

[note]Our journey reaches its latest stop, entering the era of refinement.

The year is 2025, and the game has become more refined than ever before. So refined, in fact, that we may have added a little too much quality of life and accidentally earned this Stargate the nickname "EZ Gate." Easy is relative, of course; it was still a Stargate, after all.

The Matter Manipulator has transformed base building and infrastructure expansion, allowing entire structures to be planned, copied, and moved, while NEI autocrafting has made early progression considerably faster. Et Futurum has brought Netherite and Prismarine to the pack alongside their new processing lines. At the end of progression, the T4 Nano Forge has provided a much needed alternative to endless T3 spam, while the EoH pity system has made its worst streaks of RNG more manageable.

Automation has continued to improve, and years of accumulated knowledge have transformed problems that once took entire teams months to solve into well-understood production challenges. Outside the pack, the community has created countless calculators, planners, visualizers, and specialized programs for automation, base design, optimization, or simply for fun.

The results have been difficult to ignore. More Stargates have been completed during this period than in any previous era, with the recorded gate count on Discord passing 1,000 before the release of 2.9.

A team composed of some of the pack's most talented and experienced players completed a full Stargate run in only 22 days, 16 hours, and 45 minutes on January 26, 2026, setting a new speedrun record. §aPxx500§r and §aAdam§r achieved the first documented Gatelympics (quintuple) gate during that very same speedrun. 

On the solo end of things, the very first singleplayer GTNH: Gods (triple) gate was achieved by §aSintken§r on July 2, 2025 and the second was achieved shortly after by §aLordPeverell§r on July 24, 2025.

P.S.: Here's the list as usual:
-Matter Manipulator
-Spinmatron
-Large Hadron Collider
-LATEX
-Nanochip Assembly Complex
-Bose-Einstein Condensate Line
-Exo-Foundry
-Solar Factory
-Nano Forge T4
-EoH pity system
-Super Stock Replenisher[/note]

§2P.S. In case you were wondering, 2.7 was the last version where you needed to craft two Stargates in order to qualify for a completed run. This requirement was brought down to one Stargate in 2.8, but for purposes of this quest you will be making the equivalent of two since the recipe didn't change between versions. 

Sorry Questmasters :P§r

display:10.Name:8: Obtain this item to get your trophy

betterquesting:10.desc:8: The very first tier, tier zero. This chapter will introduce you to the basic mechanics of this modpack. Mods covered: Vanilla, Pam's Harvestcraft.
This tab continues the basics until you make your first steam machine, and are ready for the real GT stuff
Steam to electricity (EU) is the progression of this tab. Most of the machines you make in this tier you'll use the whole game, if in an upgraded form.

The first "voltage" tier of this pack. Things should be a little easier with some of the machines you can now make, and almost every type of machine is now available, try not to be overwhelmed. You can get away with using LV machines for automating processing of things like polyethylene or electrolyzing water the whole game, so consider setting that up when you need it.

Your second voltage tier. Don't mix different voltage levels, or you'll have a fancy new crater. Start thinking about how to expand your base.

BTW, for OCing purposes, this counts as tier 2, ULV doesn't count.
Finally some real power to work with. This tier is all about getting to the moon to gather more rare resources to build even more advanced machines.
Welcome to EV! You have successfully gone to the moon and processed Titanium. You are now getting extreme levels of energy. In this tier you will unlock Nuclear energy, and Applied Energistics 2.
This tier is all about the platline, and making the assembly line. They're both super hard, but necessary. This is probably where most people drop out. Good luck!

If you have made it this far, you should walk with your head held high - you are nearing the start of the midgame. Endgame is still a long road ahead of you, but you are now becoming an expert at GTNH and most of the mods it comes with. Congrats, and be proud of yourself.

Once you're done being proud, start making CALs for better circuits, and work towards making power with the Fusion Reactor, you'll need it.
If there's a way to generate EU, it'll be on this tab, so check back after a new milestone to see if anything became available.
Don't worry. Papa-G will fix it.
In order to not die constantly, you'll need weapons and armor. There's also utility stuff, adventure backpacks, and static defenses for your base.
This set is a global tracker for multiblock structure goals. As you can build several parts of many multiblocks way earlier than the respective tier. Check back often.
Tired of torches everywhere making your base look like a loser built it? Make your base look like a winner with these quests.
Steve's Carts and ProjectRed automation, for your auto-farming and auto-crafting needs, lag included!
A questline about oil refining, oil byproducts, and oil based power generation.
This tab showcases new high-speed multiblocks to replace your old machines as they become available. Check back regularly!
Automated Farms, tree breeding, and more.....
Breeding Bees for Better Bling (experimental, may cause honey leakage)
A non-tiered quest set that is meant as an in game, quest based tutorial and guide to bees. Since they are a really helpful tool to advance forward.
Questline about powergen that comes from plants and trees.
Magic lies beyond. Great achievements, but also a lot of work. I shall be your guide. Follow my instructions, and you shall become a great wizard, like me.
Warp included.
Ultimate (magical) POWER!!!
Do you know which wand focus is useful and which not? Also, some EMT stuff.
A series of questlines dedicated to nuclear fission and fusion, both for power and useful items.
Granny Weatherwax would approve.
When regular magic just won't cover it, pay demons to do it for you! The cost might scare some people... But no risk no fun!
Collection of endgame objectives, good luck and thanks for playing so far.

Congratulations, you've completed the platline, assline, CAL, §oand§r fusion reactor and made it to the Zero Point Module tier. You're well into the late game now, but there's still a lot of stuff to do. Good luck!
SFM and OC have your back for assline automation! And automating other stuff too complex for AE2, like infusion or blood altars. You can do a lot of cool stuff with OC, feel free to give it a try.
A treatise on magical herbology and Botania
You can find ways to store EU here and ways to transform between voltages.
A guide to help you start Galacticraft to reach the Moon and beyond

AE2 focuses on creating a compact, easily accessible, considerably extendible storage system called an ME Network. You can use it to autocraft items as well, and if you want to finish the pack, you will.
This world is full of nasty things. Time to kill some and improve your reputation.
Treasure of lands far beyond the vast sea of the Void and very angry rune spiders await you!
